scope: Pending refresh-versus-expansion clarification; whole active roster captured for an explicit baseline.

concepts.title: Abel's summation formula
concepts.description: If Aₖ=∑ⱼ₌₁ᵏaⱼ, then ∑ₖ₌₁ᴺaₖbₖ=A_N b_N+∑ₖ₌₁ᴺ⁻¹Aₖ(bₖ−bₖ₊₁).

concepts.title: Abelian category
concepts.description: An additive category with kernels and cokernels in which every monomorphism is a kernel and every epimorphism is a cokernel.

concepts.title: Abelian group
concepts.description: A group whose operation is commutative.

concepts.title: Absolute continuity of measures
concepts.description: A measure ν is absolutely continuous with respect to μ on the same σ-algebra if μ(A)=0 implies ν(A)=0.

concepts.title: Absolute Galois group
concepts.description: The group Gal(F^sep/F), with its Krull topology, where F^sep is a separable closure.

concepts.title: Absolute spectral gap of a finite Markov chain
concepts.description: For an irreducible finite transition matrix P, the absolute spectral gap is 1−max{|λ|:λ≠1 is an eigenvalue of P}. Unlike 1−λ₂ for a reversible chain, this definition allows complex eigenvalues and nonreversibility.

concepts.title: Absolute value on a field
concepts.description: A map |·|:K→R_{≥0} that vanishes exactly at zero, is multiplicative and satisfies |x+y|≤|x|+|y|. It is nonarchimedean if the stronger bound |x+y|≤max(|x|,|y|) holds.

concepts.title: Absolutely continuous function on a real interval
concepts.description: A real function f on [a,b] is absolutely continuous if for every ε>0 there is δ>0 such that any finite disjoint family of intervals (a_i,b_i) with ∑(b_i−a_i)<δ has ∑|f(b_i)−f(a_i)|<ε.

concepts.title: Addition theorem for spherical harmonics
concepts.description: For n≥3 and an orthonormal basis Y₁,…,Y_N of degree-k real spherical harmonics under probability-normalized area, ∑ⱼYⱼ(u)Yⱼ(v)=N G_{k,n}(u·v), where G_{k,n} is the normalized zonal Gegenbauer polynomial with G_{k,n}(1)=1. In particular the diagonal sum equals N. For n=2 the corresponding zonal polynomial is the Chebyshev polynomial cos(k arccos t).

concepts.title: Additive category
concepts.description: A category with abelian-group morphism sets, composition additive in each variable, a zero object and finite biproducts.

concepts.title: Adele ring of a number field
concepts.description: The restricted product A_F=∏′_v F_v of all completions of a number field,where almost every finite component lies in the valuation ring O_v.

concepts.title: Matrix height on an adelic linear algebraic group
concepts.description: Fix a faithful F-algebraic representation ρ of G. For g=(g_v), take H(g)=∏_v max(1,max_(i,j)|ρ(g_v)_(ij)|_v,max_(i,j)|ρ(g_v⁻¹)_(ij)|_v), using normalized local multiplicative norms. Almost all factors are1; equivalent faithful choices give comparable polynomial growth conditions.

concepts.title: Adelic points of an algebraic group
concepts.description: For an algebraic group G over a number field F,the restricted product G(A_F)=∏′_v G(F_v),using integral compact subgroups at almost all finite places.

concepts.title: Compactly supported smooth test function on an adelic group
concepts.description: A compactly supported complex function on G(A_F) that is smooth in the archimedean variables and locally constant in the nonarchimedean variables. Factorizable test functions are restricted tensors of local test functions.

concepts.title: Adjoint functors
concepts.description: Functors F:C→D and G:D→C with natural bijections Hom_D(FX,Y)≅Hom_C(X,GY); F is left adjoint to G.

concepts.title: Adjoint of a bounded Hilbert-space operator
concepts.description: The adjoint of a bounded operator T on a complex Hilbert space is the unique bounded operator T* satisfying ⟨Tx,y⟩=⟨x,T*y⟩ for every x,y.

concepts.title: Admissible tuple of integer shifts
concepts.description: A finite set H={h₁,…,hₖ} of distinct integers is admissible if its residue classes fail to cover all classes modulo p for every prime p.

concepts.title: Affine algebraic group over a field
concepts.description: An affine algebraic group over a field F is specified by a finitely generated commutative Hopf F-algebra A: for each commutative F-algebra R its group of R-points is Hom_(F-alg)(A,R), with multiplication induced by the coproduct. Equivalently it is a finite-type affine group scheme over F.

concepts.title: Real affine function on a convex set
concepts.description: A function f:C→ℝ on a convex set satisfying f((1−t)x+ty)=(1−t)f(x)+tf(y) for0≤t≤1.

concepts.title: Affine group scheme of finite presentation over a ring
concepts.description: A commutative Hopf R-algebra A that is finitely presented as an R-algebra, regarded through its group-valued functor B↦Hom_(R-alg)(A,B). This coordinate account defines the affine group scheme without requiring general scheme theory.

concepts.title: Affine map between real vector spaces
concepts.description: A map of the form x↦Ax+b, where A is linear and b is fixed.

concepts.title: Affine representation of an ordered group with order unit
concepts.description: The homomorphism G→Aff(S(G,u)) sending g to the evaluation function τ↦τ(g). Its kernel is the infinitesimal subgroup.

concepts.title: Aleksandrov–Clark probability measures for a Schur function vanishing at zero
concepts.description: For holomorphic f:𝔻→𝔻 with f(0)=0 and |γ|=1, the Aleksandrov–Clark measure μγ is the probability measure on the unit circle satisfying (1−γ̄f(z))⁻¹=∫(1−ζ̄z)⁻¹ dμγ(ζ) for z∈𝔻.

concepts.title: Aleksandrov–Fenchel inequality for mixed volumes
concepts.description: For convex bodies K₁,…,K_d⊂ℝᵈ, V(K₁,K₂,K₃,…,K_d)²≥V(K₁,K₁,K₃,…,K_d)V(K₂,K₂,K₃,…,K_d).

concepts.title: Alexandrov’s inequality for mixed discriminants
concepts.description: For real symmetric A and positive definite real symmetric B,M₃,…,M_n, D(A,B,M₃,…,M_n)²≥D(A,A,M₃,…,M_n)D(B,B,M₃,…,M_n).

concepts.title: Homomorphism of algebras over a field
concepts.description: A linear map of unital associative algebras over the same field preserving multiplication and the multiplicative identity.

concepts.title: Module over an associative algebra
concepts.description: A vector space on which the algebra acts linearly, compatibly with multiplication and the identity.

concepts.title: Invertible element of an algebra
concepts.description: An element with a two-sided multiplicative inverse.

concepts.title: Algebraic character of an affine algebraic group
concepts.description: A morphism of algebraic groups G→G_m over the specified field. Characters form an abelian group by pointwise multiplication.

concepts.title: Algebraic closure of a field
concepts.description: An algebraic extension of a field that is itself algebraically closed. This specifies an object, without including the existence or uniqueness-up-to-isomorphism theorem.

concepts.title: Algebraic element of a field extension
concepts.description: An element α of L/F is algebraic over F if a nonzero polynomial in F[x] vanishes at α.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Base change of an affine algebraic group
concepts.description: For a field extension L/F and an affine F-group with coordinate Hopf algebra A, its base change to L has coordinate Hopf algebra L⊗_F A.

concepts.title: Morphism of affine algebraic groups
concepts.description: A homomorphism defined by regular coordinate functions; in coordinate algebras it is a homomorphism of commutative Hopf algebras in the opposite direction, preserving coproduct, counit and antipode.

concepts.title: Algebraic integer
concepts.description: A complex number satisfying a monic polynomial with integer coefficients.

concepts.title: Algebraic representation of an affine algebraic group
concepts.description: A morphism of algebraic groups G→GL(V) for a finite-dimensional vector space V; equivalently an action with regular matrix coefficient functions. A faithful representation identifies G with a closed algebraic subgroup of GL(V).

concepts.title: Algebraic torus
concepts.description: An algebraic group that becomes isomorphic over an algebraic closure to a finite product of copies of the multiplicative group.

concepts.title: Algebraically closed field
concepts.description: A field in which every nonconstant polynomial has a root.

concepts.title: Almost-everywhere convergence of measurable functions
concepts.description: Measurable functions fₙ converge almost everywhere to f if the pointwise limit fₙ(x)→f(x) holds outside a measurable null set.

concepts.title: Almost-everywhere property on a measure space
concepts.description: A property holds almost everywhere if the set where it fails is contained in a measurable set of measure zero.

concepts.title: Almost holomorphic Jacobi form of half-integral weight
concepts.description: A function with a specified half-integral weight, half-integral nonnegative index and compatible multiplier, obeying the Jacobi transformations, polynomial in 1/(τ−τ̄) and (z−z̄)/(τ−τ̄) with holomorphic coefficients, and with Jacobi cusp growth: after each cusp normalization, |φ(τ,z)|≤C·Im(τ)^N exp(2πm Im(z)²/Im(τ)) in a Jacobi translation strip for some C,N.

concepts.title: Almost holomorphic modular form of half-integral weight
concepts.description: A function obeying the metaplectic modular transformation of a specified half-integral weight and compatible finite-image multiplier, polynomial in 1/Im(τ) with holomorphic coefficients and of at most polynomial growth in Im(τ) after normalization at every cusp.

concepts.title: Almost holomorphic Jacobi form
concepts.description: For integer weight k and nonnegative integer index m, a function with the scalar Jacobi modular and elliptic transformations, polynomial in 1/(τ−τ̄) and (z−z̄)/(τ−τ̄) with holomorphic coefficients, and satisfying |φ(τ,z)|≤C·Im(τ)^N exp(2πm Im(z)²/Im(τ)) in a Jacobi translation strip after each cusp normalization.

concepts.title: Almost holomorphic modular form
concepts.description: For a specified congruence subgroup and integer weight k, a function obeying the scalar modular weight-k transformation, polynomial in 1/Im(τ) with holomorphic coefficients and of at most polynomial growth in Im(τ) after normalization at every cusp. This is the almost holomorphic convention called nearly holomorphic by Larson, and excludes cusp poles.

concepts.title: Almost-sure convergence of real random variables
concepts.description: Xₙ→X almost surely means P({ω:limₙXₙ(ω)=X(ω)})=1.

concepts.title: Alternating tensors in the tensor square of a module
concepts.description: For an R-module M, the submodule of M⊗_R M consisting of tensors t with flip(t)=−t. This is a submodule convention, not the quotient definition of the exterior square; in characteristic 2 these conventions need not agree.

concepts.title: Analytic manifold over a local field
concepts.description: A Hausdorff topological space with charts to open subsets of K^n, for a local field K, whose transition functions are locally given by convergent K-power series. Over R this means real analytic, over C complex analytic, and over a nonarchimedean field its usual convergent power-series notion.

concepts.title: Anisotropic reductive group over a field
concepts.description: A reductive group over F containing no nontrivial F-split torus; an anisotropic torus has no positive-dimensional split subtorus.

concepts.title: ANOVA decomposition on a product probability space
concepts.description: For square-integrable f(X₁,…,X_n) with independent inputs, define f_∅=Ef and f_u=E[f|X_u]−∑_{v⊊u}f_v. Then f=∑_uf_u; nonconstant components have zero conditional mean after integrating any one of their active coordinates, and distinct components are orthogonal in L².

concepts.title: Aperiodic finite Markov chain
concepts.description: A state has period equal to the gcd of its possible positive return times. An irreducible chain is aperiodic when this common period is one.

concepts.title: Finite arithmetic progression of integers
concepts.description: A sequence a,a+d,…,a+(k−1)d with integers a,d and positive integer k; nonconstant progressions have d≠0.

concepts.title: Artin L-function
concepts.description: For an Artin representation ρ factoring through Gal(L/F), the Euler product over finite places L(s,ρ)=∏_v det(1−ρ(Frob_w)(#k_v)^(−s)|V^(I_w))^(−1), initially for Re(s)>1, together with its meromorphic continuation. The local factor uses inertia-fixed vectors, so ramified places are included.

concepts.title: Artin representation of a number field
concepts.description: A finite-dimensional complex representation of the absolute Galois group of a number field that is continuous and has finite image, equivalently one factoring through the Galois group of a finite Galois extension.

concepts.title: Discretely monitored arithmetic Asian option
concepts.description: A contingent claim whose payoff depends on an arithmetic average of asset prices at a specified finite set of monitoring times, for example (n⁻¹∑_kS_{t_k}−K)⁺.

concepts.title: Associative algebra over a field
concepts.description: A vector space with an associative bilinear multiplication and a multiplicative identity.

concepts.title: Asymptotic density of a subset of the positive integers
concepts.description: For S⊆ℕ₊, its asymptotic density is lim_{N→∞}|S∩{1,…,N}|/N when this limit exists.

concepts.title: Asymptotic equivalence
concepts.description: The assertion f∼g along a specified limit means f(x)/g(x)→1, where g is nonzero near that limit. Sequences are the instance x=n→∞.

concepts.title: Asymptotic expansion in a scale of functions
concepts.description: An expansion f∼∑aₙφₙ along a limit means that after every finite truncation at n, the remainder is o(φₙ), where each successive scale function is of smaller order than the preceding one. Convergence of the series is not required.

concepts.title: Aubin–Lions compactness lemma
concepts.description: Let X₀↪X↪X₁ be Banach spaces, the first embedding compact and the second continuous. For1<p<∞ and1<q≤∞, a set bounded in Lᵖ(0,T;X₀) whose weak time derivatives are bounded in Lᑫ(0,T;X₁) is relatively compact in Lᵖ(0,T;X).

concepts.title: Automorphic cusp form on a reductive group
concepts.description: An automorphic form on a connected reductive number-field group whose constant term ∫_(N(F)∖N(A_F))φ(ng)dn vanishes for every g and every unipotent radical N of a proper F-parabolic subgroup. Its square-integrable Hilbert closure on G(F)∖G(A_F)¹ is a separate cuspidal L²-space.

concepts.title: Automorphic form on a reductive group over a number field
concepts.description: A complex function on G(A_F) for a connected reductive F-group, smooth at infinity and right invariant under an open compact subgroup at the finite places, left G(F)-invariant, of moderate growth, K∞-finite for a chosen maximal compact subgroup, and Z(g_∞)-finite.

concepts.title: Automorphic period integral on a Harish–Chandra quotient
concepts.description: For a reductive F-group G, an F-subgroup H, a smooth cuspidal form φ on G(F)∖G(A_F)¹ and a unitary character χ trivial on H(F), the period in this normalization is ∫_(H(F)∖(H(A_F)∩G(A_F)¹))χ(h)φ(h)dh, with quotient Haar measure, when absolutely convergent.

concepts.title: Azuma–Hoeffding inequality
concepts.description: If a real martingale has increments bounded in absolute value by c_i, then P(|M_n−M_0|≥t)≤2exp(−t²/(2∑_{i=1}^nc_i²)) for t>0.

concepts.title: b-fold coloring of a graph
concepts.description: An assignment of a set of b colors to every vertex such that adjacent vertices receive disjoint color sets. The b-fold chromatic number χ_b(G) is the smallest total number of colors permitting such an assignment.

concepts.title: Baire category theorem for complete metric spaces
concepts.description: Every countable intersection of dense open subsets of a complete metric space is dense.

concepts.title: Baire topological space
concepts.description: A topological space in which every countable intersection of dense open subsets is dense.

concepts.title: Balandraud’s uniform stabilizer theorem for sumsets
concepts.description: Fix a finite nonempty subset S of an abelian group. Either |S+T|≥|S|+|T|−1 for every finite nonempty T, or there is a finite nontrivial subgroup H, depending only on S, such that S+T+H=S+T for every T violating that bound.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Complex Banach algebra, possibly nonunital
concepts.description: A complex Banach space with associative bilinear multiplication satisfying ∥ab∥≤∥a∥∥b∥. An identity is not required.

concepts.title: Continuous dual of a normed vector space
concepts.description: The vector space X* of bounded linear maps X→its scalar field, with norm ‖ℓ‖=sup_{‖x‖≤1}|ℓ(x)|.

concepts.title: Banach–Mazur distance between origin-symmetric convex bodies
concepts.description: For origin-symmetric convex bodies K,L⊂ℝᵈ, d_BM(K,L)=inf{t≥1:L⊆TK⊆tL for an invertible linear map T}.

concepts.title: Norm bound for a Banach-valued Riemann integral
concepts.description: For continuous f from a compact real interval into a Banach space, ∥∫f(t)dt∥≤∫∥f(t)∥dt.

concepts.title: Banach space
concepts.description: A real or complex normed vector space complete for the metric induced by its norm.

concepts.title: Isomorphism of Banach spaces
concepts.description: A bounded linear bijection between Banach spaces whose inverse is bounded.

concepts.title: Riemann integral of a continuous Banach-valued function
concepts.description: For continuous f:[a,b]→X with X Banach, its integral is the norm limit of tagged sums ∑f(t_i)(x_i−x_{i−1}) as the partition mesh tends to zero.

concepts.title: Banach-valued simple function
concepts.description: A measurable function with finitely many values in a Banach space, represented as a finite sum∑_ix_i1_{A_i} with measurable sets A_i.

concepts.title: Barycentric subdivision
concepts.description: Vertices are the barycenters b(F) of nonempty faces F; a simplex corresponds to a chain F₀⊊···⊊Fₖ and has vertices b(F₀),…,b(Fₖ).

concepts.title: Base change of an affine group scheme
concepts.description: For R→S and an affine group scheme represented by A, its base change is represented by S⊗_R A with the induced Hopf operations. A residue-field fiber is this construction for S=R/𝔪.

concepts.title: Extension of a linearly independent family to a finite basis
concepts.description: Every linearly independent family in a finite-dimensional vector space can be extended to a basis.

concepts.title: Basis of a free module
concepts.description: A family (e_i) in a module over a commutative ring such that every element is a unique finite linear combination of the e_i with coefficients in that ring. A module with such a family is free.

concepts.title: Benatar’s Goldbach–prime-difference dichotomy
concepts.description: Either successive Goldbach numbers have bounded gaps beyond some point, or the set D of infinitely recurring positive prime differences has full relative density among the even integers, with |((2N)∖D)∩[1,N]|≪N^κ for some κ<1. Differences in D need not be consecutive prime gaps.

concepts.title: Benatar’s density bounds for normalized prime-gap limit points
concepts.description: If L is the set of finite limit points of (p_{n+1}−p_n)/log p_n, then liminf_{T→∞}m(L∩[0,T])/T≥1/4 and m(L∩[0,T])/T≥3/25 for every T>0, where m is Lebesgue measure. Under the specific level-one distribution variant in §5, the first lower bound improves to 1/2.

concepts.title: Bennett exponential-moment bound for a bounded-above variable
concepts.description: If EY=0, Y≤1 and EY²=σ²<∞, then Eexp(aY)≤exp(σ²(eᵃ−1−a)) for a≥0.

concepts.title: Berezin transform on the unit disk
concepts.description: For an integrable weight ψ on the disk, Bψ(z)=∫D (1−|z|²)²|1−zw̄|⁻⁴ψ(w)dA(w), the average against the normalized Bergman kernel density.

concepts.title: Berger–Stampfli numerical-radius mapping theorem
concepts.description: If w(T)≤1 and f∈A(𝔻) has f(0)=0, then f(T)=lim_{r↑1}f(rT) exists in operator norm and w(f(T))≤∥f∥∞.

concepts.title: Bergman projection on the unit disk
concepts.description: The orthogonal projection from area L² of the disk onto its holomorphic subspace; with normalized area its kernel is Qψ(z)=∫D ψ(w)/(1−zw̄)² dA(w), whenever the formula is meaningful.

concepts.title: Bernoulli distribution
concepts.description: The distribution on {0,1} assigning probability p to 1 and 1−p to 0, for 0≤p≤1.

concepts.title: Bernoulli–Laplace urn chain
concepts.description: Two urns hold fixed numbers of red and black balls; choose one ball uniformly in each urn and swap them. The number of red balls in one urn is a birth-and-death chain.

concepts.title: Bethe free energy of factor-graph marginals
concepts.description: For consistent variable and factor marginals p_x,p_a, the Bethe log-partition functional is ∑_a[H(p_a)+E_{p_a}lnψ_a]−∑_x(d_x−1)H(p_x). On a limiting rooted factor-tree law one uses the corresponding expected local terms, normalized per variable node.

concepts.title: Bethe free-energy limit under local Gibbs decorrelation
concepts.description: For a locally convergent sequence of bounded-degree typed factor models with finite spins and positive weights from a fixed finite family, assume every fixed short-cycle-free event has nonvanishing probability in both ordinary and locally conditioned partition-function-biased models. Let p be a consistent limiting-tree marginal assignment. If average two-variable Gibbs marginals converge in total variation to the corresponding products from p, then limsup n⁻¹ElnZ≤B(p). If the same holds in the locally conditioned partition-function-biased model, the limit equals B(p). Non-reconstruction implies the required decorrelation; uniform tree boundary-influence decay yields equality in both models.

concepts.title: Beurling’s invariant subspace theorem for Hardy H²
concepts.description: Every nonzero closed subspace of H² invariant under multiplication by z has the form θH² for an inner function θ, unique up to multiplication by a unimodular constant.

concepts.title: Bézout’s identity for integers
concepts.description: For integers a,b not both zero, there are integers u,v such that ua+vb=gcd(a,b).

concepts.title: Bézout identity for polynomials over a field
concepts.description: The monic greatest common divisor of polynomials a,b, not both zero, is ua+vb for some polynomials u,v. In particular coprime polynomials admit ua+vb=1.

concepts.title: Bi-Lipschitz map
concepts.description: A bijection between metric spaces for which both the map and its inverse are Lipschitz.

concepts.title: Bifunctor
concepts.description: A functor C×D→E from a product of two categories to another category.

concepts.title: Big O notation
concepts.description: The assertion f=O(g) along a specified limit means |f(x)|≤C|g(x)| near that limit for a fixed finite C. Subscripts specify allowed dependence on fixed parameters. For sequences use x=n→∞.

concepts.title: Bijection between sets
concepts.description: A function for which each element of the codomain is the image of exactly one element of the domain.

concepts.title: Bilinear map
concepts.description: A map of two vector-space variables that is linear in each variable separately.

concepts.title: Moment recursion for binary branching Markov processes
concepts.description: For binary rate-β branching with killed-motion semigroup P_tᴰ, set T_t=e^{βt}P_tᴰ and u_n(t,x)=E_x(∑_{v∈N_t}f(X_v(t)))ⁿ for bounded nonnegative f. Then u_n(t)=T_t(fⁿ)+β∑_{j=1}^{n−1}binomial(n,j)∫₀ᵗT_s[u_j(t−s)u_{n−j}(t−s)]ds. This includes repeated particle labels.

concepts.title: Binary expansion of a nonnegative number
concepts.description: For a nonnegative real number, a representation x=∑_kb_k2ᵏ with digits b_k∈{0,1}; integers use finitely many nonnegative powers, while fractional parts may use a convergent series of negative powers. Dyadic fractional values use the terminating convention when uniqueness is needed.

concepts.title: Binary operation on a set
concepts.description: A function S×S→S.

concepts.title: Binary relation on a set
concepts.description: A subset R⊆S×S; writing xRy means (x,y)∈R.

concepts.title: Binomial coefficient
concepts.description: For integers 0≤k≤n, binom(n,k) counts the k-element subsets of an n-element set and equals n!/(k!(n−k)!).

concepts.title: Binomial distribution
concepts.description: The law of the number of successes in n independent Bernoulli(p) trials: P(B=k)=binom(n,k)p^k(1−p)^(n−k),0≤k≤n.

concepts.title: Binomial theorem
concepts.description: For commuting elements a,b in a commutative ring and integer n≥0, (a+b)ⁿ=∑_{j=0}ⁿbinomial(n,j)aʲb^{n−j}.

concepts.title: Bipartite multigraph
concepts.description: An undirected multigraph whose vertices are partitioned into two classes and whose edges join opposite classes.

concepts.title: Finite biproduct in a category
concepts.description: An object with injections and projections making it simultaneously the product and coproduct of a finite family of objects, with the usual compatible identity and zero composites.

concepts.title: Finite birth-and-death chain
concepts.description: A finite Markov chain on {0,…,N} that can move only to neighboring states or remain at its current state; continuous-time versions have jump rates only between neighbors.

concepts.title: Bitwise exclusive-or
concepts.description: For finite binary strings of equal length, exclusive-or adds corresponding digits modulo2. Binary integers are padded with zeros, and binary fractions are aligned by place value before applying the same operation.

concepts.title: Black–Scholes market model
concepts.description: A market with a bank account growing at constant rate r and a stock following geometric Brownian motion with constant volatility σ. Under its pricing measure the stock drift is r.

concepts.title: Block sequence relative to a Schauder basis
concepts.description: A sequence of nonzero finitely supported vectors xₙ such that max supp(xₙ)<min supp(xₙ₊₁); its closed linear span is a block subspace.

concepts.title: Bochner integral
concepts.description: For a strongly measurable Banach-valued f with ∫‖f‖<∞, its integral is the norm limit of the integrals of simple approximants converging in the integral of their norm difference; simple functions integrate by∑x_iμ(A_i).

concepts.title: Completeness of Bochner Lᵖ spaces
concepts.description: If X is a Banach space and1≤p≤∞, the Bochner space Lᵖ(μ;X) is complete for its norm.

concepts.title: Bochner Lᵖ space
concepts.description: For a Banach space X, Lᵖ(S;X) consists of strongly measurable X-valued functions modulo a.e. equality with finite norm(∫‖f‖ᵖ)¹ᐟᵖ for1≤p<∞; use essential supremum for p=∞.

concepts.title: Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem in ℝᵈ
concepts.description: Every bounded sequence in Euclidean space ℝᵈ has a subsequence converging coordinatewise to a point of ℝᵈ.

concepts.title: Bombieri–Vinogradov theorem
concepts.description: For every A>0 there is B>0 such that ∑_{q≤x^(1/2)/(log x)^B} max_(a,q)=1 |ψ(x;q,a)−x/φ(q)|≪_A x/(log x)^A, where ψ uses the von Mangoldt weight and the sum runs over all positive moduli.

concepts.title: Borcherds automorphic product
concepts.description: A meromorphic automorphic form on an orthogonal symmetric domain obtained as a regularized theta lift of a suitable weakly holomorphic vector-valued modular form, with an infinite product expansion and divisor prescribed by its negative Fourier coefficients. The genus-two instances in this paper use the orthogonal realization of the Siegel domain.

concepts.title: First Borel–Cantelli lemma
concepts.description: If ∑ₙP(Aₙ)<∞, then P(⋂ₘ⋃ₙ≥ₘAₙ)=0: almost surely only finitely many Aₙ occur.

concepts.title: Borel σ-algebra on the real line
concepts.description: The σ-algebra on ℝ generated by the open intervals.

concepts.title: Borel σ-algebra of a topological space
concepts.description: The σ-algebra generated by the open subsets of the space.

concepts.title: Borel subgroup of a connected affine algebraic group
concepts.description: Over an algebraically closed field, a maximal smooth connected solvable closed subgroup. Over F, a subgroup is an F-Borel subgroup if its base change to an algebraic closure is such a Borel subgroup.

concepts.title: Boundary of a subset of a topological space
concepts.description: The boundary of A is its closure with its interior removed.

concepts.title: Gaussian exponential displacement moments for bounded-coefficient diffusions
concepts.description: For a Brownian diffusion with globally bounded drift and diffusion coefficients, for every T>0 there are c,C>0 such that sup_{x,0<t≤T}Eexp(c|X_t^x−x|²/t)≤C.

concepts.title: Bounded linear functional
concepts.description: A linear map from a real or complex normed vector space to its scalar field satisfying |ℓ(x)|≤C∥x∥ for one finite C and every x.

concepts.title: Bounded linear operator
concepts.description: A linear map T:X→Y between normed vector spaces is bounded if ∥Tx∥≤C∥x∥ for one finite constant C and every x∈X.

concepts.title: Polar decomposition of a bounded Hilbert-space operator
concepts.description: Every bounded operator J between Hilbert spaces has a factorization J=U(J*J)¹ᐟ² with a partial isometry U whose initial space is the closure of the range of J*. Equivalently J=(JJ*)¹ᐟ²U.

concepts.title: Bounded prime-cluster theorem for admissible tuples
concepts.description: There is an integer k₀ such that every admissible set H of at least k₀ integer shifts has infinitely many translates n+H containing at least two primes.

concepts.title: Spectral theorem for bounded self-adjoint operators
concepts.description: A bounded self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space has a unique projection-valued spectral measure, supported on its real spectrum, representing the operator and its bounded Borel functional calculus.

concepts.title: Braid-group action on a tensor power
concepts.description: For an object V in a braided monoidal category, σᵢ acts on V⊗n as the braiding c(V,V) on factors i,i+1 and the identity on all other factors.

concepts.title: Braid group
concepts.description: Bₙ is generated by σ₁,…,σₙ₋₁, with σᵢσⱼ=σⱼσᵢ for abs(i−j)>1 and σᵢσᵢ₊₁σᵢ=σᵢ₊₁σᵢσᵢ₊₁.

concepts.title: Braided monoidal category
concepts.description: A monoidal category with natural isomorphisms c(X,Y):X⊗Y→Y⊗X satisfying the two hexagon identities.

concepts.title: Branching diffusion killed at the boundary of a domain
concepts.description: Particles move independently as a specified diffusion in D, are killed upon leaving D, and independently branch at rate β into A offspring at their current positions; offspring repeat the same dynamics independently. Start from a specified finite configuration.

concepts.title: Many-to-few lemma for constant-rate branching Markov processes
concepts.description: Let Q_k be the multiple-spine law with unchanged motion, m_j=EAʲ, and let D_s(v) count marks on a skeleton particle v alive at s. For nonnegative measurable F of k terminal particle positions (or their ancestral paths), E_P∑_{(u₁,…,u_k)∈N_tᵏ}F(u₁,…,u_k)=E_{Q_k}[F(ξ¹,…,ξᵏ)exp{β∫₀ᵗ∑_{v marked alive at s}(m_{D_s(v)}−1)ds}]. Offspring moments through k are finite; repeated labels are included. Killed marks contribute zero. This is the unchanged-motion specialization of the full Harris–Roberts lemma.

concepts.title: Many-to-one lemma for constant-rate branching Markov processes
concepts.description: If particles branch independently at rate β with mean offspring m and move by a killed Markov semigroup P_tᴰ, then E_x∑_{u∈N_t}f(X_u(t))=e^{β(m−1)t}P_tᴰf(x) for nonnegative measurable f.

concepts.title: Many-to-two second-moment formula for branching Markov processes
concepts.description: For rate-β branching with offspring mean m and finite factorial second moment q=E[A(A−1)], set T_tf=e^{β(m−1)t}P_tᴰf. Then E_x[(∑_uf(X_u(t)))(∑_ug(X_u(t)))]=T_t(fg)(x)+βq∫₀ᵗT_s[(T_{t−s}f)(T_{t−s}g)](x)ds for bounded nonnegative f,g.

concepts.title: Additive-martingale spine change of measure for a branching diffusion
concepts.description: Weight the branching law up to t by M_t/M₀, where M_t=e^{(λ−β(m−1))t}∑_uφ(X_u(t)). Under the weighted law a distinguished lineage moves by the φ-ground-state transform, branches at accelerated rate mβ with size-biased offspring law kP(A=k)/m, and chooses one child uniformly to continue the spine; other children start independent original branching families.

concepts.title: Brauer's cyclotomic splitting-field theorem
concepts.description: If a finite group G has exponent n, then ℚ(ζₙ) is a splitting field for G: every irreducible complex representation of G has a model over ℚ(ζₙ).

concepts.title: Brouwer fixed-point theorem
concepts.description: Every continuous f:Δⁿ→Δⁿ has a fixed point. The equivalent closed-ball formulation belongs to this same theorem concept.

concepts.title: Brownian bridge on a finite interval
concepts.description: The centered Gaussian process β_t=B_t−(t/T)B_T,0≤t≤T, with endpoints zero and covariance min(s,t)−st/T. A bridge from x to y adds x+(t/T)(y−x).

concepts.title: Brownian-bridge sampling of discrete Brownian paths
concepts.description: Generate a Brownian path on a finite grid by first sampling its endpoint, then recursively sampling an interior value conditional on already generated bracketing values using its Gaussian bridge law.

concepts.title: Standard Brownian motion
concepts.description: A continuous process B_t starting at zero with independent increments and B_t−B_s distributed N(0,t−s) for 0≤s<t. A d-dimensional standard Brownian motion has d independent standard components.

concepts.title: Quadratic covariation of Brownian coordinates
concepts.description: For coordinates of standard multidimensional Brownian motion, [B^i,B^j]_t=δ_{ij}t almost surely, simultaneously for all t≥0.

concepts.title: Reflection principle for Brownian motion
concepts.description: For standard Brownian motion, a≥0 and measurable A⊆(−∞,a), P(max_{s≤t}B_s≥a,B_t∈A)=P(B_t∈2a−A). Reflection of the path after first hitting a preserves Wiener measure.

concepts.title: Strong Markov property of Brownian motion
concepts.description: At every almost surely finite stopping time T, the process B_{T+t}−B_T is a standard Brownian motion independent of the information through time T.

concepts.title: Burkholder–Davis–Gundy inequality in L²
concepts.description: For a continuous local martingale M with M₀=0 and a stopping time T, E[M]_T≤E sup_{s≤T}|M_s|²≤4E[M]_T, with expectations allowed infinite and [M] its quadratic variation. The finite case follows by localization.

concepts.title: Banach space c₀ of null sequences
concepts.description: The scalar sequences tending to zero, with the supremum norm.

concepts.title: C¹ domain in Euclidean space
concepts.description: An open connected subset of ℝᵈ whose boundary near every point can, after a rigid change of coordinates, be written as the graph of a C¹ function, with the domain locally on one side.

concepts.title: Continuously differentiable Euclidean map
concepts.description: A map on an open Euclidean set whose first coordinate partial derivatives exist and are continuous.

concepts.title: C¹,¹ domain in Euclidean space
concepts.description: A C¹ domain whose local boundary graph functions have Lipschitz continuous first derivatives.

concepts.title: C² embedded surface in ℝ³
concepts.description: A subset of ℝ³ that locally, after a rigid coordinate change, is the graph of a twice continuously differentiable real function of two variables.

concepts.title: Càdlàg path
concepts.description: A path from a real time interval into a metric space that is right-continuous and has a left limit at every positive time.

concepts.title: Envy-free interval cake division theorem
concepts.description: For n participants and consecutive pieces of [0,1] parametrized by Δⁿ⁻¹, suppose preferred-piece sets are nonempty and closed and exclude empty pieces whenever a positive-length piece exists. Then some partition admits a bijection assigning every participant a preferred piece.

concepts.title: Calderón reproducing formula for an inhomogeneous dyadic resolution
concepts.description: Let φ₀,ψ₀ be fixed Schwartz kernels and, for j≥1, let φ_j,ψ_j be the standard dyadic dilations of fixed Schwartz kernels with annular Fourier support, with φ̂₀ψ̂₀+∑_{j≥1}φ̂_jψ̂_j=1 and the high-frequency terms supported in dyadic annuli. Then f=ψ₀*φ₀*f+∑_{j≥1}ψ_j*φ_j*f in S′ for every tempered distribution f.

concepts.title: Cameron–Martin space for Wiener measure
concepts.description: The Hilbert space of absolutely continuous paths h:[0,T]→ℝᵈ with h(0)=0 and square-integrable derivative, with inner product ∫₀ᵀh′(s)·k′(s)ds.

concepts.title: Canonical weak Jacobi form φ₀,₁
concepts.description: The weight-zero, index-one weak Jacobi form φ₀,₁(τ,z)=4∑_{(a,b)=(1/2,0),(0,0),(0,1/2)}(θ[a,b](τ,z)/θ[a,b](τ,0))². It begins ζ⁻¹+10+ζ+O(q); its coefficient c(n,ℓ) depends only on 4n−ℓ².

concepts.title: Carathéodory’s approximation theorem by finite Blaschke products
concepts.description: Every holomorphic f:𝔻→ℂ with |f|≤1 is a locally uniform limit of finite Blaschke products. If f(0)=0, the approximating products can also be chosen to vanish at zero.

concepts.title: Cardinality of a set
concepts.description: The size of a set, with two sets having the same cardinality when there is a bijection between them. A set has finite cardinality n when it is in bijection with {1,…,n}; infinite cardinalities are distinguished by the same bijection criterion.

concepts.title: Cartesian product of sets
concepts.description: A×B is the set of ordered pairs (a,b) with a∈A and b∈B.

concepts.title: Trace in a pivotal monoidal category
concepts.description: Closing an endomorphism using evaluation, coevaluation and the pivotal structure gives its left and right traces, which lie in End(1). They are scalars when End(1) is the ground field; the two traces need not agree.

concepts.title: Category
concepts.description: Objects and morphisms with associative composition and identity morphisms.

concepts.title: Equivalence of categories
concepts.description: A functor with an inverse up to natural isomorphism.

concepts.title: Cauchy integral formula on a disk
concepts.description: If f is holomorphic on a neighborhood of a closed disk with positively oriented boundary circle C, then for z inside the disk, f(z)=(2πi)⁻¹∫_Cf(ζ)/(ζ−z)dζ. Derivatives follow by differentiating the kernel.

concepts.title: Cauchy’s integral theorem on simply connected domains
concepts.description: The integral of a holomorphic function around every closed piecewise C¹ curve in a simply connected complex domain is zero.

concepts.title: Cauchy’s projection formula for convex bodies
concepts.description: For a convex body K and unit u, the volume of K projected onto u⊥ equals ½∫|u·v| dS_K(v).

concepts.title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for semi-inner-product C*-modules
concepts.description: For x,y in a semi-inner-product C*-module, |⟨x,y⟩|²≤∥⟨x,x⟩∥⟨y,y⟩ in the order on the coefficient C*-algebra.

concepts.title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for complex inner-product spaces
concepts.description: In a complex inner-product space, |⟨u,v⟩|²≤⟨u,u⟩⟨v,v⟩ for all u,v.

concepts.title: Cauchy sequence in a metric space
concepts.description: A sequence (xₙ) in a metric space (X,d) is Cauchy if for every ε>0 there is N such that d(xₙ,xₘ)<ε whenever n,m≥N.

concepts.title: Center of an associative algebra
concepts.description: The subalgebra of elements commuting with every element of the associative algebra.

concepts.title: Rational forms pass to Drinfeld centers
concepts.description: In the characteristic-zero fusion-category setting, if C_k is a rational form of C_K, the natural functor Z(C_k)⊗_k K→Z(C_K) is fully faithful, dominant, and commutes with induction. Thus Z(C_k) is a braided rational form, with idempotent completion understood.

concepts.title: Induction to the Drinfeld center of a fusion category
concepts.description: For a fusion category C over ℂ, the induction functor I:C→Z(C) is the left adjoint to the functor forgetting the half-braiding. Its underlying object is ⊕_V V⊗X⊗V*, summed over simple representatives V.

concepts.title: Centralizer algebra of a representation
concepts.description: For an H-module W, End_H(W) is the algebra of linear endomorphisms commuting with H; multiplication is composition.

concepts.title: Cesàro convergence theorem
concepts.description: If aₙ→L, then (a₁+···+aₙ)/n→L.

concepts.title: Chain rule for Fréchet derivatives
concepts.description: If g is Fréchet differentiable at x and f at g(x), then f∘g is Fréchet differentiable at x with D(f∘g)(x)=Df(g(x))∘Dg(x).

concepts.title: Change of variables theorem for Euclidean integrals
concepts.description: For a C¹ diffeomorphism Φ:U→V between open subsets of ℝⁿ and a nonnegative measurable or integrable f on V, ∫_Vf(y)dy=∫_Uf(Φ(x))|det DΦ(x)|dx.

concepts.title: Characteristic function of a real probability distribution
concepts.description: For a real random variable X, φ_X(t)=Eexp(itX), t∈ℝ. It is always defined and determines the law of X.

concepts.title: Uniqueness theorem for characteristic functions
concepts.description: Two Borel probability measures on ℝ have the same characteristic function if and only if they are equal.

concepts.title: Uniqueness of finite-dimensional characteristic functions
concepts.description: Two Borel probability laws on ℝᵈ agree if their characteristic functions u↦Eexp(iu·X) agree for every u∈ℝᵈ. Equivalently, equality in law of every scalar linear combination of coordinates determines the joint law.

concepts.title: Chebyshev's inequality
concepts.description: If EX²<∞ and t>0, then P(abs(X−EX)≥t)≤Var(X)/t².

concepts.title: Chernoff bound for sums of independent Bernoulli variables
concepts.description: If S is a sum of independent Bernoulli variables with mean μ, then for δ>0, P(S≥(1+δ)μ)≤[e^δ/(1+δ)^(1+δ)]^μ; for 0<δ<1, P(S≤(1−δ)μ)≤exp(−μδ²/2).

concepts.title: Chinese remainder theorem for integers
concepts.description: For pairwise coprime positive integers m₁,…,m_r and residues a_i modulo m_i, there is a unique residue modulo ∏m_i reducing to a_i modulo every m_i.

concepts.title: Choquet order on probability measures
concepts.description: For Borel probability measures on a compact convex set K, write μ≼ν if ∫f dμ≤∫f dν for every continuous convex real function f on K. A maximal measure has no strictly larger measure for this order.

concepts.title: Choquet simplex
concepts.description: A compact convex set in a locally convex real topological vector space for which each point has a unique maximal representing probability measure in the Choquet order. In the metrizable case this is the unique representing probability measure supported on its extreme boundary.

concepts.title: Envy-free division of an interval of chores
concepts.description: For n participants and consecutive chore pieces parametrized by Δⁿ⁻¹, suppose preferred-piece sets are nonempty and closed and contain only empty pieces whenever an empty piece is available. Then there is a partition and bijection assigning each participant a preferred piece.

concepts.title: C^k map between Euclidean open sets
concepts.description: For a finite integer k≥0, a map is C^k if all component partial derivatives of order at most k exist and are continuous. C^0 means continuous.

concepts.title: Classical Jacobi form
concepts.description: For an integer weight k and integer index m≥0, a holomorphic function φ(τ,z) on H×C with φ((aτ+b)/(cτ+d),z/(cτ+d))=(cτ+d)^k exp(2πimcz²/(cτ+d))φ(τ,z) for γ in a specified congruence subgroup, φ(τ,z+rτ+s)=exp(−2πim(r²τ+2rz))φ(τ,z), and Fourier support 4mn−ℓ²≥0 at every cusp. This is the scalar trivial-multiplier convention.

concepts.title: Clique
concepts.description: A set of vertices of a graph, every two of which are adjacent.

concepts.title: Closable nonnegative symmetric form
concepts.description: A densely defined nonnegative symmetric form E is closable if u_n→0 in H and E(u_n−u_m,u_n−u_m)→0 imply E(u_n,u_n)→0. Equivalently it has a closed extension obtained by completing its graph norm.

concepts.title: Closed subgroup of an affine algebraic group
concepts.description: A subgroup represented by the quotient of its ambient group’s coordinate Hopf algebra by a Hopf ideal.

concepts.title: Closedness of finitely generated cones
concepts.description: The set of all nonnegative real linear combinations of finitely many vectors in R^n is closed.

concepts.title: Closed symmetric form–semigroup correspondence
concepts.description: Densely defined closed nonnegative symmetric forms on a Hilbert space correspond to nonnegative self-adjoint operators and strongly continuous self-adjoint contraction semigroups T_t=exp(−tA), with E(u,v)=⟨A¹ᐟ²u,A¹ᐟ²v⟩ on D(A¹ᐟ²).

concepts.title: Closed linear operator
concepts.description: A linear map A:D(A)⊆X→Y between Banach spaces is closed if x_n→x and Ax_n→y with x_n∈D(A) imply x∈D(A) and Ax=y.

concepts.title: Existence of a closed algebraic-group orbit
concepts.description: A nonempty algebraic variety over an algebraically closed field, acted on morphically by an algebraic group, contains an orbit closed in that variety.

concepts.title: Closed partial order on a topological space
concepts.description: A partial order whose graph {(x,y):x≤y} is closed in the product topology. For metric spaces this is equivalent to preservation of the relation under limits of convergent pairs.

concepts.title: Closed preference correspondence with finite alternatives
concepts.description: For metric X and finite alternatives A, P:X→nonempty subsets of A is a closed preference correspondence if {x:a∈P(x)} is closed in X for every a∈A. Ties are allowed.

concepts.title: Closed range of a bounded linear operator
concepts.description: A bounded linear operator has closed range when its image is a closed subset of its codomain.

concepts.title: Closed nonnegative symmetric form on a Hilbert space
concepts.description: A nonnegative symmetric bilinear form E on a dense vector subspace D of a real Hilbert space H is closed if D is complete for the norm ‖u‖_{E,1}=(‖u‖_H²+E(u,u))¹ᐟ².

concepts.title: Closure of a subset of a topological space
concepts.description: The closure of A is the intersection of all closed subsets containing A; a set is closed when its complement is open.

concepts.title: Cokernel of a linear map
concepts.description: For a linear map f:V→W, its cokernel is the quotient W/im(f).
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Colored operad
concepts.description: A collection of operations with specified input and output types, with associative substitution into inputs and identity operations.

concepts.title: Commutative algebra over a field
concepts.description: A unital associative algebra over a field whose multiplication is commutative, equivalently a commutative ring equipped with a unital homomorphism from that field.

concepts.title: Commutative algebra over a commutative ring
concepts.description: A commutative ring A with a specified unital ring homomorphism R→A; algebra homomorphisms commute with these structure maps.

concepts.title: Commutative Hopf algebra over a field
concepts.description: A Hopf algebra over a field whose underlying algebra multiplication is commutative; its coproduct need not be cocommutative.

concepts.title: Commutative Hopf algebra over a commutative ring
concepts.description: A commutative R-algebra A with R-algebra maps Δ:A→A⊗_R A, ε:A→R and S:A→A satisfying the coassociativity, counit and inverse identities: (Δ⊗id)Δ=(id⊗Δ)Δ and m(S⊗id)Δ=m(id⊗S)Δ=ηε.

concepts.title: Commutative ring with identity
concepts.description: An abelian group under addition, together with an associative commutative multiplication with identity, distributing over addition. The zero ring is allowed.

concepts.title: Commutator subgroup
concepts.description: The subgroup [G,G] generated by all commutators xyx⁻¹y⁻¹ with x,y∈G.

concepts.title: Compact linear operator
concepts.description: A bounded linear operator between normed spaces that maps every bounded subset to a relatively compact subset.

concepts.title: Perron theorem for compact positivity-improving self-adjoint operators
concepts.description: A nonzero compact self-adjoint nonnegative operator on L² that sends every nonzero nonnegative function to a strictly positive function has a simple largest eigenvalue and a strictly positive eigenfunction.

concepts.title: Spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators
concepts.description: A compact self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space has an orthonormal basis consisting of eigenvectors together with a basis of its kernel; every nonzero eigenvalue has finite multiplicity and zero is the only possible accumulation point of nonzero eigenvalues.

concepts.title: Weak compactness of probabilities on a compact metric space
concepts.description: The Borel probability measures on a compact metric space form a compact space for weak convergence; in particular every sequence has a weakly convergent subsequence.

concepts.title: Compact set star shaped about the origin
concepts.description: A nonempty compact set K⊂ℝⁿ such that [0,x]⊆K for every x∈K. It need not be convex, have interior, or have a continuous positive radial function.

concepts.title: Compact topological space
concepts.description: A topological space in which every open cover has a finite subcover.

concepts.title: Compactly supported smooth test function on an open Euclidean set
concepts.description: A smooth function on an open Ω⊂ℝⁿ whose support is a compact subset of Ω; these form C_c^∞(Ω).

concepts.title: Complete bipartite graph
concepts.description: The simple graph K_{s,t} with two disjoint vertex sets of sizes s,t, every edge between the two sets and no edges within either set.

concepts.title: Complete discretely valued field
concepts.description: A field with a discrete valuation v which is complete for the metric defined by any absolute value c^(−v(x)) with c>1, extended by |0|=0.

concepts.title: Complete measure
concepts.description: A measure is complete if every subset of a measurable null set is measurable and has measure zero.

concepts.title: Complete metric space
concepts.description: A metric space is complete if every Cauchy sequence in it converges to a point of that same space.

concepts.title: Complete rational form of a tensor category
concepts.description: A rational form C_k of C_K for which C_k⊗_k K is already idempotent complete, so C_k⊗_k K≃C_K without adding new summands.

concepts.title: Completion of a field with an absolute value
concepts.description: The metric completion of K for d(x,y)=|x−y|, with the field operations extended continuously. A completion is regarded as containing K through its canonical isometric embedding.

concepts.title: Complex conjugation
concepts.description: The complex conjugate of z=a+bi is z̄=a−bi.

concepts.title: Complex derivative
concepts.description: For a complex-valued function on an open subset of C, f′(z) is the limit of (f(z+h)−f(z))/h as nonzero complex h→0, when it exists.

concepts.title: Complex exponential function
concepts.description: The entire function exp(z)=∑ₙ₌₀∞zⁿ/n!; on imaginary arguments exp(it)=cos(t)+i sin(t).

concepts.title: Complex Hilbert space
concepts.description: A complex inner-product space complete in the metric d(x,y)=∥x−y∥ induced by its inner product.

concepts.title: Complex inner-product space
concepts.description: A complex vector space with a positive definite Hermitian form ⟨x,y⟩, linear in x and conjugate-linear in y. Its induced norm is ∥x∥=√⟨x,x⟩.

concepts.title: Complex line integral along a piecewise smooth path
concepts.description: For a piecewise C¹ path γ:[a,b]→ℂ and continuous f on its image, ∫_γf(z)dz=∫_a^bf(γ(t))γ′(t)dt, with real and imaginary parts integrated separately.

concepts.title: Modulus of a complex number
concepts.description: For z=a+bi, its modulus is the nonnegative real number |z|=√(a²+b²).

concepts.title: Complex number
concepts.description: A complex number is a pair of real numbers, written a+bi. Addition is componentwise and multiplication is (a+bi)(c+di)=(ac−bd)+(ad+bc)i, so i²=−1.

concepts.title: Complex partial derivative
concepts.description: The complex derivative in one coordinate of a function of several complex variables, holding the other coordinates fixed.

concepts.title: Complex power series
concepts.description: A series ∑ₙ₌₀∞aₙ(z−z₀)ⁿ with complex coefficients, considered at points where its partial sums converge.

concepts.title: Complex *-algebra, possibly nonunital
concepts.description: A complex vector space with associative bilinear multiplication and a conjugate-linear involution a↦a* satisfying (ab)*=b*a*. A multiplicative identity is not required.

concepts.title: Complex torus
concepts.description: A quotient V/Λ of a finite-dimensional complex vector space V by a discrete subgroup Λ generated over Z by a real basis of V, with the quotient topology and the local complex coordinates induced by translations in V.

concepts.title: Components of a locally path-connected space
concepts.description: Every connected component of a locally path-connected topological space is open and path connected.

concepts.title: Conditional expectation given a σ-algebra
concepts.description: For integrable X and a sub-σ-algebra G, E[X|G] is a G-measurable integrable random variable satisfying ∫_AE[X|G]dP=∫_AXdP for every A∈G, defined up to almost-sure equality.

concepts.title: Pull-out property of conditional expectation
concepts.description: If Y is G-measurable and X,YX are integrable, then E[YX|G]=Y E[X|G] almost surely, when the right side is integrable.

concepts.title: Tower property of conditional expectation
concepts.description: For sub-σ-algebras F⊆G and integrable X, E[E[X|G]|F]=E[X|F]; also E[E[X|F]|G]=E[X|F].

concepts.title: Conditional Jensen inequality
concepts.description: For integrable X and convex φ with φ(X) integrable, φ(E[X|G])≤E[φ(X)|G] almost surely.

concepts.title: Conditional probability given an event
concepts.description: If P(B)>0, the conditional probability of A given B is P(A|B)=P(A∩B)/P(B).

concepts.title: Conditional variance
concepts.description: For square-integrable X, Var(X|G)=E[(X−E[X|G])²|G]=E[X²|G]−E[X|G]².

concepts.title: Configuration model for a prescribed degree sequence
concepts.description: Attach the prescribed number of half-edges to each vertex and match half-edges uniformly at random; collapsing each half-edge bundle gives a random multigraph with those degrees. Bipartite typed versions match compatible half-edge classes.

concepts.title: Congruence modulo an integer
concepts.description: The relation a≡b (mod m) means that m divides a−b.

concepts.title: Congruence subgroup of SL₂(ℤ)
concepts.description: A subgroup of SL₂(ℤ) containing Γ(N)={M:M≡I moduloN} for some positive integer N.

concepts.title: Congruence subgroup of the integral symplectic group
concepts.description: A subgroup Γ of Sp(2g,Z) containing the kernel of reduction Sp(2g,Z)→Sp(2g,Z/NZ) for some positive integer N; its level is the least such N.

concepts.title: Connected component of a topological space
concepts.description: A maximal connected subset, with connectedness understood in the subspace topology.

concepts.title: Connected reductive algebraic group
concepts.description: A smooth connected affine algebraic group whose largest connected normal unipotent subgroup over an algebraic closure is trivial.

concepts.title: Irreducibility of connected smooth algebraic groups
concepts.description: A connected smooth algebraic group over an algebraically closed field is irreducible, and every proper closed subvariety has strictly smaller dimension.

concepts.title: Connected topological space
concepts.description: A topological space that is not the union of two disjoint nonempty open subsets.

concepts.title: Connes fusion of Hilbert bimodules
concepts.description: The relative tensor product of an M–N and an N–P Hilbert bimodule, formed using bounded vectors and completion in the canonical relative inner product, producing an M–P Hilbert bimodule.

concepts.title: Space of continuous affine functions on a compact convex set
concepts.description: Aff(K) is the real vector space of continuous affine functions on a compact convex set K,equipped with the supremum norm and pointwise order.

concepts.title: Density of continuous compactly supported functions in Euclidean L¹
concepts.description: Every function in L¹(ℝⁿ) can be approximated in L¹ norm by continuous compactly supported functions.

concepts.title: Completeness of continuous Banach-valued function spaces
concepts.description: For a compact metric space K and Banach space X, the continuous maps K→X form a Banach space for the supremum norm.

concepts.title: Continuous functional calculus for a self-adjoint C*-algebra element
concepts.description: For self-adjoint a in a C*-algebra, continuous scalar functions on σ(a) can be evaluated at a by the unique isometric *-homomorphism sending the identity function to a and the constant one to the unit of the unitization. Functions vanishing at zero give elements of the original algebra.

concepts.title: Separability of continuous functions on a compact metric space
concepts.description: For a compact metric space K, the Banach space C(K) with supremum norm is separable.

concepts.title: Continuous linear embedding of normed spaces
concepts.description: An injective bounded linear map, usually used to identify one normed space with a linear subspace of another.

concepts.title: Continuous local martingale
concepts.description: A continuous adapted process M_t for which stopping times T_n↑∞ almost surely exist such that M_{t∧T_n} is a martingale for every n.

concepts.title: Continuous map between topological spaces
concepts.description: A map is continuous if the preimage of every open subset of its target is open in its domain.

concepts.title: Quadratic-variation isometry for continuous martingales
concepts.description: If M is a continuous square-integrable martingale with M₀=0, then E|M_T|²=E[M]_T for bounded stopping times T. Localized versions apply when the expectations are finite.

concepts.title: Continuous random dynamical system
concepts.description: Over a measure-preserving flow θ, a measurable cocycle φ_t(ω,x) on a Polish state space, continuous in x, with φ₀(ω,x)=x and φ_{t+s}(ω,x)=φ_t(θ_sω,φ_s(ω,x)).

concepts.title: Riemann integrability of continuous functions
concepts.description: Every continuous real function on a compact interval is Riemann integrable.

concepts.title: Continuous semimartingale
concepts.description: A continuous adapted process expressible as M+A where M is a continuous local martingale and A is an adapted continuous process of finite variation on every bounded time interval.

concepts.title: Nonexplosion of finite-mean continuous-time Galton–Watson branching
concepts.description: For independent rate-β lifetimes and a finite-mean integer offspring law, a continuous-time Galton–Watson process started from finitely many individuals has finitely many individuals and branching events on each bounded time interval almost surely.

concepts.title: Time-homogeneous continuous-time Markov chain on a finite set
concepts.description: A right-continuous jump process on a finite state space whose future conditional law depends only on its current state and elapsed time. Its transition matrices form a semigroup.

concepts.title: Convergence of a sequence in a metric space
concepts.description: A sequence (xₙ) in a metric space (X,d) converges to x∈X if for every ε>0 there is N such that d(xₙ,x)<ε whenever n≥N.

concepts.title: Convergence in probability
concepts.description: Random variables X_n converge in probability to X if P(|X_n−X|>ε)→0 for every ε>0; metric-valued variables use their metric in place of absolute difference.

concepts.title: Convex body in Euclidean space
concepts.description: A compact convex subset of ℝᵈ with nonempty interior.

concepts.title: Convex function on a real interval
concepts.description: A real function φ on an interval I is convex if φ(tx+(1−t)y)≤tφ(x)+(1−t)φ(y) for x,y∈I and 0≤t≤1.

concepts.title: Convex function on a convex subset of a real vector space
concepts.description: A function f:C→R on a convex subset of a real vector space satisfying f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y) for x,y∈C and 0≤t≤1. Unlike the separate interval-convex-function identity, the domain may be infinite-dimensional.

concepts.title: Convex hull
concepts.description: The smallest convex set containing a given set of points.

concepts.title: Convex position
concepts.description: A finite P⊂ℝ² is in convex position if no point of P is in the convex hull of the other points.

concepts.title: Convex subset of ℝᵈ
concepts.description: C⊆ℝᵈ is convex if (1−t)x+ty∈C whenever x,y∈C and 0≤t≤1.

concepts.title: Subdifferential of a convex function on Euclidean space
concepts.description: For a proper lower semicontinuous convex f:ℝᵈ→ℝ∪{∞}, ∂f(x)={v:f(y)≥f(x)+v·(y−x) for every y}; it may contain multiple vectors or be empty.

concepts.title: Convex subgroup of an ordered abelian group
concepts.description: A subgroup H such that h₁≤g≤h₂ with h₁,h₂∈H forces g∈H. The quotient carries the induced order when H is convex.

concepts.title: Convex subset of a real vector space
concepts.description: A subset C of a real vector space is convex if (1−t)x+ty∈C whenever x,y∈C and0≤t≤1. The vector space may be infinite-dimensional.

concepts.title: Convolution on Euclidean space
concepts.description: For functions with an appropriate integrability condition, (f*g)(x)=∫f(x−y)g(y)dy; convolution of a tempered distribution with a Schwartz function is defined by duality.

concepts.title: Convolution of functions on a locally compact group
concepts.description: With a chosen left Haar measure, (f*g)(x)=∫_G f(y)g(y⁻¹x)dy when the integral exists, in particular for compactly supported continuous functions. The order matters for noncommutative groups.

concepts.title: Convolution of probability distributions on Euclidean space
concepts.description: The convolution μ*ν is the law of X+Y for independent random vectors with laws μ,ν; equivalently (μ*ν)(A)=∫∫1_A(x+y)μ(dx)ν(dy).

concepts.title: Coprime integers
concepts.description: Integers whose greatest common divisor is1.

concepts.title: Coquio’s cutoff criterion from a concentrated halting time
concepts.description: For a family of finite irreducible reversible chains with halting sets A_N and irreducible aperiodic killed kernels, let m_N=ET_{A_N}→∞, s_N²=Var(T_{A_N}), and λ_N the largest killed-kernel eigenvalue. If s_N=o(m_N) and (1−λ_N)m_N→∞, there is total variation cutoff at m_N. If also liminf(1−λ_N)s_N>0, s_N is a cutoff window.

concepts.title: Coquio’s total variation halting-set criterion
concepts.description: For a finite Markov chain with stationary law π and specified initial law, the set M={x:Law(X_t)(x)≤π(x) for every t≥0} is halting: d_TV(Law(X_t),π)≤P(T_M>t). The empty set gives only the trivial bound.

concepts.title: Middle halting states of symmetric birth-and-death chains
concepts.description: For an irreducible symmetric monotone discrete-time birth-and-death chain on {0,…,2N+1} started at0, N+1 is halting for total variation. For a symmetric continuous-time irreducible birth-and-death chain on {0,…,N} started at0, ceil(N/2) is halting. Symmetry means reflection invariance of transition probabilities or jump rates.

concepts.title: Counting measure
concepts.description: The measure on all subsets of a set that assigns a finite set its cardinality and an infinite set the value∞.

concepts.title: Coupling of finite probability distributions
concepts.description: A joint probability distribution on a product of finite state spaces whose marginals are the specified distributions.

concepts.title: Levi-Civita covariant derivative on an embedded surface
concepts.description: For tangent vector fields X,Y on a surface in ℝ³ with its induced metric, ∇XY is the tangential projection of the ambient directional derivative DXY.

concepts.title: Critical branching-diffusion survival asymptotic on a C¹ domain
concepts.description: On a bounded connected C¹ domain, let −L be symmetric uniformly elliptic with smooth coefficients and positive L²-normalized principal eigenfunction φ, eigenvalue λ. For rate β=λ/(m−1) branching with mean m=EA>1 and finite second moment, P_x(N_t>0)∼2(m−1)φ(x)/[λE(A(A−1))∫_Dφ³·t].

concepts.title: Yaglom limit for critical bounded-domain branching diffusions
concepts.description: Under the C¹-domain, symmetric elliptic motion and finite-second-moment offspring hypotheses of the critical survival theorem, for measurable E⊆D the conditional law of N_t(E)/t given N_t>0 converges to an exponential law of mean λE[A(A−1)](∫_Eφ)(∫_Dφ³)/(2(m−1)); zero mean denotes the degenerate law at zero. The conditional empirical spatial law converges in probability on each such E to ∫_Eφ/∫_Dφ.

concepts.title: Crouzeix’s numerical-range functional-calculus theorem
concepts.description: There is an absolute finite constant C such that ∥f(T)∥≤C sup_{z∈W(T)}|f(z)| for every bounded Hilbert-space operator T and f holomorphic on a neighborhood of the closure of W(T).

concepts.title: C*-algebra
concepts.description: A complex *-algebra with a complete submultiplicative norm satisfying ∥a*a∥=∥a∥²; an identity is not required.

concepts.title: C*-seminorm on a complex *-algebra
concepts.description: A seminorm γ on a complex *-algebra satisfying γ(ab)≤γ(a)γ(b) and γ(a*a)=γ(a)². It can vanish on nonzero elements and does not imply completeness.

concepts.title: Cups and caps of planar point sets
concepts.description: For planar points p₁,…,pₖ with strictly increasing x-coordinates, a k-cup has strictly increasing successive slopes, and a k-cap has strictly decreasing successive slopes.

concepts.title: Curvature function of a convex body
concepts.description: When the surface area measure S_K is absolutely continuous with respect to spherical area measure, its Radon–Nikodym density f_K is called the curvature function.

concepts.title: Curvature matrix of a smooth support function
concepts.description: At u∈S^{n−1}, restrict the Euclidean Hessian of the1-homogeneous extension of h to u⊥; this equals the spherical Hessian ∇²_Sh+hI. Positive definiteness describes the strictly curved support functions used in the smooth argument.

concepts.title: Cuspidal automorphic representation
concepts.description: An irreducible unitary representation occurring as a closed summand in the cuspidal L²-space of the adelic group, with the chosen central or Harish–Chandra normalization. Its smooth K∞-finite vectors give the usual algebraic automorphic representation.

concepts.title: Cuspidal L²-space of a reductive group
concepts.description: The closed subspace of L²(G(F)∖G(A_F)¹) generated by the square-integrable smooth cuspidal automorphic forms, with the right regular unitary action. It is the Hilbert realization of the cuspidal spectrum.

concepts.title: Total variation cutoff for a family of finite Markov chains
concepts.description: For chosen initial laws, a family has cutoff at t_N if d_N(ct_N)→1 for every 0<c<1 and d_N(ct_N)→0 for every c>1, where d_N is distance to stationarity.

concepts.title: Cutoff window in total variation
concepts.description: A scale w_N=o(t_N) is a cutoff window if lim_{γ→∞}liminf_N d_N(t_N−γw_N)=1 and lim_{γ→∞}limsup_N d_N(t_N+γw_N)=0, with integer times rounded in discrete time.

concepts.title: Cycle graph
concepts.description: The finite graph C_n,n≥3,whose vertices can be arranged cyclically so that each is joined to its predecessor and successor.

concepts.title: Cyclotomic field
concepts.description: A number field ℚ(ζₙ) generated by a primitive nth root of unity.

concepts.title: Cyclotomic integer
concepts.description: An algebraic integer lying in a cyclotomic field.

concepts.title: de Branges–Rovnyak space H(b)
concepts.description: For b holomorphic on the unit disk with ∥b∥∞≤1, H(b) is the reproducing kernel Hilbert space with kernel Kb(z,w)=(1−b(z)b(w)̄)/(1−zw̄). Equivalently it is the range of (I−TbTb*)¹ᐟ² with the induced range norm.

concepts.title: Decomposition group at a prime of a Galois extension
concepts.description: For a finite Galois extension L/F and a prime w above v, the subgroup D_w⊂Gal(L/F) of automorphisms preserving w.

concepts.title: Dedekind eta function
concepts.description: For Im(τ)>0 and q=exp(2πiτ), η(τ)=q^{1/24}∏_{n≥1}(1−qⁿ).

concepts.title: Default intensity process
concepts.description: For a default time τ, a nonnegative predictable process λ_t such that 1_{τ≤t}−∫₀^{t∧τ}λ_sds is a local martingale in the specified information filtration. Cox-model conditional survival is exp(−∫₀ᵗλ_sds).

concepts.title: Dense subset of a metric space
concepts.description: A subset A of a metric space X is dense if every open ball centered in X with positive radius meets A.

concepts.title: Dense subset of a topological space
concepts.description: A subset is dense if its closure is the whole space.

concepts.title: Hölder inequality controlled by b-fold graph coloring
concepts.description: For nonnegative random variables Y_v admitting dependency graph G and every positive integer b, E∏_vY_v≤∏_v(EY_v^{χ_b(G)/b})^{b/χ_b(G)}, with the usual extended-integral interpretation.

concepts.title: Dependency graph for random variables
concepts.description: A finite graph on the indices of random variables such that families indexed by disjoint vertex sets with no edge between them are independent. In particular, a variable is independent of the joint family of all its nonneighbors.

concepts.title: Derivation of an algebra
concepts.description: A linear map D:A→A on an associative algebra over a field satisfying D(ab)=D(a)b+aD(b).

concepts.title: Derivative of a real function
concepts.description: The derivative f′(x) is the finite limit of (f(x+h)−f(x))/h as h→0, when it exists. Higher derivatives are defined by iteration.

concepts.title: Detailed balance for a finite Markov chain
concepts.description: A positive probability vector π satisfies detailed balance for P if π(x)P(x,y)=π(y)P(y,x) for every pair of states.

concepts.title: Determinant of a square matrix
concepts.description: For an n×n matrix A over a commutative ring, det A=∑_{σ∈Sₙ}sgn(σ)∏_{i=1}ⁿA_{i,σ(i)}, with the 0×0 determinant equal to one.

concepts.title: Determinantal point process
concepts.description: A point process whose k-point correlation functions satisfy ρ⁽ᵏ⁾(x₁,…,xₖ)=det(K(x_i,x_j))_{i,j=1}ᵏ for a specified kernel K and reference measure.

concepts.title: Diagonal bounded operator relative to a Schauder basis
concepts.description: A bounded linear operator D satisfying Deₙ=λₙeₙ for a fixed Schauder basis (eₙ).

concepts.title: Diffeomorphism between open Euclidean sets
concepts.description: A bijection between open subsets of Euclidean spaces that is smooth and has a smooth inverse.

concepts.title: Difference body of a convex body
concepts.description: The origin-symmetric body K−K=K+(−K), where−K={−x:x∈K}. Some sources use the normalized difference body½(K−K).

concepts.title: Attraction height for a digit-power sum map
concepts.description: For fixed b,e and target u, the attraction height of x is the least h≥0 with S_{e,b}^h(x)=u, when such an h exists.

concepts.title: Digit-power sum map
concepts.description: For base b≥2 and integer e≥1, S_{e,b}(x) is the sum of the e-th powers of the base-b digits of the positive integer x.

concepts.title: Dimension group
concepts.description: A directed unperforated partially ordered abelian group with the Riesz decomposition property.

concepts.title: Handelman–Roy unperforation criterion for finite-trace dimension groups
concepts.description: Let G be a simple noncyclic dimension group with finitely many pure traces,and H=ker_G Z(H) a subgroup with H∩G⁺={0},where Z(H) consists of normalized traces vanishing on H. If F is the smallest face containing Z(H),then G/H is unperforated iff f(H) is zero or dense inℝ for every f∈F.

concepts.title: Dini’s theorem
concepts.description: If continuous real functions on a compact space converge pointwise monotonically to a continuous limit, the convergence is uniform.

concepts.title: Diophantine equation
concepts.description: A polynomial equation, usually with integer coefficients, whose solutions are required to be integers or rational numbers.

concepts.title: Direct sum of abelian groups
concepts.description: For a family of abelian groups A_i, the subgroup of their Cartesian product consisting of tuples with finite support, with coordinatewise addition.

concepts.title: Direct sum of vector spaces
concepts.description: The algebraic direct sum of a family of vector spaces consists of tuples with only finitely many nonzero coordinates, with coordinatewise operations.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Directed ordered abelian group
concepts.description: A partially ordered abelian group in which any two elements have a common upper bound; equivalently every element is a difference of two nonnegative elements.

concepts.title: Dirichlet character
concepts.description: A group character of (Z/qZ)× with complex values, extended periodically to Z by zero on integers not coprime to q. A character is primitive when it is not induced from a proper divisor of q.

concepts.title: Spectral decomposition of a bounded-domain Dirichlet elliptic operator
concepts.description: For the real divergence-form operator L=∑∂ᵢ(aⁱʲ∂ⱼ), with smooth symmetric uniformly elliptic coefficients and no zeroth-order term, on a bounded connected Lipschitz domain, the L² realization has eigenvalues0<λ₁<λ₂≤⋯→∞ and a real orthonormal eigenbasis φ_n. The principal eigenvalue is simple with φ₁>0 inside. Eigenfunctions are smooth inside and continuous by zero at the boundary, and P_tᴰf=∑_ne^{−λ_nt}⟨f,φ_n⟩φ_n in L².

concepts.title: Nest for a Dirichlet form
concepts.description: An increasing sequence of closed sets F_n such that the union of {u∈D(E):u=0 m-a.e. outside F_n} is dense in D(E) for the E₁ norm. A set is E-exceptional if it is contained in the complement of the union of some nest.

concepts.title: Process existence for quasi-regular symmetric Dirichlet forms
concepts.description: A quasi-regular symmetric Dirichlet form on a Lusin measurable state space is associated with an m-tight special standard process, unique up to the usual exceptional-set equivalence, whose L² semigroup is the semigroup of the form. The resulting process is m-symmetric; conservativeness requires an additional condition.

concepts.title: Quasi-continuity relative to a Dirichlet form
concepts.description: A real function has an E-quasi-continuous version if it agrees m-a.e. with a function whose restriction to every member of some E-nest is continuous.

concepts.title: Quasi-homeomorphism of Dirichlet spaces
concepts.description: A map between full nest unions of two Dirichlet spaces that restricts to a homeomorphism on each corresponding pair of closed nest sets, pushes one reference measure to the other, and identifies the two forms by pullback, including their domains.

concepts.title: Uniform exponential mixing of the ground-state-transformed Dirichlet diffusion
concepts.description: For a bounded connected Lipschitz domain and a smooth symmetric uniformly elliptic killed diffusion, let φ be its positive L²-normalized principal eigenfunction and γ=λ₂−λ₁. Its ground-state transition density K_t satisfies sup_{x,y}|K_t(x,y)/φ(y)²−1|≤C_εe^{−γt} for every t≥ε>0.

concepts.title: Spectral characterization of H₀¹ and the Dirichlet Laplacian domain
concepts.description: Let λ_n,φ_n be Dirichlet eigenpairs of−½Δ on a bounded C¹ domain. A function f∈L² is in H₀¹ exactly when∑λ_n|⟨f,φ_n⟩|²<∞, and then∫|∇f|²=2∑λ_n|⟨f,φ_n⟩|². For f∈H₀¹, its weak Laplacian lies in L² exactly when∑λ_n²|⟨f,φ_n⟩|²<∞. No global H² boundary regularity is asserted.

concepts.title: Dirichlet L-function
concepts.description: For a Dirichlet character χ, the Dirichlet series L(s,χ)=∑_{n≥1}χ(n)n^(−s) for Re(s)>1, together with its meromorphic continuation.

concepts.title: W²,ᵖ regularity of the Dirichlet Poisson problem
concepts.description: On a bounded C¹,¹ domain and2≤p<∞, for f∈Lᵖ the weak solution u∈H₀¹ of−Δu=f belongs to W²,ᵖ and satisfies‖u‖_{W²,ᵖ}≤C‖f‖_{Lᵖ}.

concepts.title: Principal Dirichlet eigenpair of a symmetric elliptic operator
concepts.description: For a connected bounded domain and a symmetric uniformly elliptic Dirichlet operator −L, the smallest eigenvalue λ₁ and its positive L²-normalized eigenfunction φ solve −Lφ=λ₁φ with zero boundary trace.

concepts.title: Vector-valued discrete Fourier transform
concepts.description: For x₀,…,xₙ₋₁ in a complex vector space, its discrete Fourier transform has components ∑ₖ₌₀ⁿ⁻¹exp(−2πimk/n)xₖ, m=0,…,n−1. Sign and scalar normalization conventions may vary.

concepts.title: Discrete orthonormal Haar transform on a dyadic grid
concepts.description: For a vector of length2ᵐ, replace each consecutive pair by its normalized sum and difference, (a+b)/√2 and(a−b)/√2, then recursively transform the sums until a single average remains. Order the average and detail coefficients by scale.

concepts.title: Discrete sine transform of type I
concepts.description: The orthonormal real transform on ℝᴺ given by (Sy)_j=√(2/(N+1))∑_{k=1}ᴺy_k sin(πjk/(N+1)),1≤j≤N. Other discrete sine transform types are separate conventions.

concepts.title: Discrete subgroup of a locally compact group
concepts.description: A subgroup whose induced topology is discrete; equivalently the identity is isolated in the subgroup.

concepts.title: Discrete valuation on a field
concepts.description: A surjective map v:K×→Z satisfying v(xy)=v(x)+v(y) and v(x+y)≥min(v(x),v(y)), extended by v(0)=+∞.

concepts.title: Disjoint sets
concepts.description: Two sets are disjoint when they have no common element; a family is pairwise disjoint when every two distinct members are disjoint.

concepts.title: Disk algebra
concepts.description: The algebra A(𝔻) of complex functions continuous on the closed unit disk and holomorphic on the open unit disk, with the supremum norm.

concepts.title: Biholomorphic automorphism of the unit disk
concepts.description: A bijective holomorphic map 𝔻→𝔻 with holomorphic inverse; these maps are z↦c(z−a)/(1−āz), where |c|=1 and |a|<1.

concepts.title: Distinguished automorphic representation
concepts.description: A representation with a nonzero equivariant period functional for a specified subgroup and character; the subgroup and character are part of the specification.

concepts.title: Distribution of a real random variable
concepts.description: The distribution μₓ of X is defined by μₓ(B)=P(X∈B) for Borel B⊆ℝ.

concepts.title: Distribution on an open Euclidean set
concepts.description: A continuous linear functional on C_c^∞(Ω), where test functions on each fixed compact support converge with all derivatives uniformly. It need not extend to a tempered distribution.

concepts.title: Distributional characterization of superharmonic functions
concepts.description: A locally integrable function with nonnegative distribution−Δu has a unique superharmonic representative equal to it almost everywhere. Conversely every superharmonic function is locally integrable and has−Δu≥0.

concepts.title: Distributional Laplacian
concepts.description: For a distribution T on an open Euclidean set, its Laplacian is defined by (ΔT)(φ)=T(Δφ), with Δ=∑ᵢ∂ᵢ².

concepts.title: Divergence theorem in Euclidean space
concepts.description: For a bounded domain with C¹ boundary and a C¹ vector field F on its closure, ∫_Ωdiv F dx=∫_{∂Ω}F·ν dS, where ν is the outer unit normal.
