concepts.title: Divisor function d(n)
concepts.description: d(n) is the number of positive divisors of n, equivalently the number of ordered positive integer pairs (a,b) satisfying ab=n.

concepts.title: Divisor of a meromorphic function on a complex manifold
concepts.description: The locally finite formal sum of irreducible complex hypersurfaces weighted by the orders of zeros of a meromorphic function, negative for poles.

concepts.title: Divisor summatory bound ∑ₙ≤ₓd(n)=O(x log x)
concepts.description: There is an absolute constant C such that ∑₁≤ₙ≤ₓd(n)≤Cx log x for x≥2; the sum counts positive integer pairs (a,b) with ab≤x.

concepts.title: Lebesgue dominated convergence theorem
concepts.description: If measurable fₙ converge almost everywhere to f and |fₙ|≤g for an integrable g, then f is integrable and ∫|fₙ−f|→0; consequently their integrals converge.

concepts.title: Domination of one basic sequence by another
concepts.description: A basic sequence (x_n) dominates (y_n) if some C satisfies ∥∑a_n y_n∥≤C∥∑a_n x_n∥ for every finitely supported scalar sequence (a_n).

concepts.title: Doob ground-state transform of a killed semigroup
concepts.description: If a positive function h satisfies P_tᴰh=e^{−λt}h, define Q_tf(x)=e^{λt}P_tᴰ(hf)(x)/h(x). This is a Markov semigroup representing the process conditioned by h; for a killed symmetric diffusion and principal eigenfunction h it describes conditioning to stay in the domain.

concepts.title: Doob’s L² maximal inequality
concepts.description: For a right-continuous square-integrable martingale M on[0,T], E sup_{s≤T}|M_s|²≤4E|M_T|².

concepts.title: Doob’s upcrossing inequality
concepts.description: If (X_n) is a submartingale and U_n(a,b) counts completed upcrossings from at most a to at least b by time n, then (b−a)EU_n(a,b)≤E(X_n−a)⁺−E(X₀−a)⁺ for a<b.

concepts.title: Double-dual functor
concepts.description: The covariant monoidal endofunctor X↦X** obtained by taking a chosen dual twice in a rigid monoidal category.

concepts.title: Doubly stochastic matrix
concepts.description: A square real matrix with nonnegative entries and every row and column summing to one. The uniform probability vector is stationary.

concepts.title: Douglas range inclusion and factorization theorem
concepts.description: For bounded maps A:H₁→H₀ and B:H₂→H₀ between Hilbert spaces, Ran A⊆Ran B, AA*≤λBB* for some λ≥0, and A=BC for some bounded C are equivalent. The least possible ∥C∥ is the square root of the least such λ.

concepts.title: Drinfeld center of a monoidal category
concepts.description: For a monoidal category C, its center Z(C) has objects (X,c), where c is a half-braiding on X, and morphisms f:X→X′ compatible with the half-braidings. Tensoring these pairs makes Z(C) braided; C itself need not be braided.

concepts.title: Drury’s teardrop theorem
concepts.description: If w(T)≤1 and f∈A(𝔻) satisfies ∥f∥∞≤1, then W(f(T)) lies in the convex hull of the closed unit disk and the closed disk centered at f(0) with radius 1−|f(0)|². Consequently w(f(T))≤1+|f(0)|−|f(0)|²≤5/4.

concepts.title: Dual even part of a subfactor
concepts.description: For a finite-index II₁ subfactor N⊂M, the tensor category of M–M bimodules generated by L²(M)⊗_N L²(M), closing under finite sums, summands and duals.

concepts.title: Dual extended Haagerup fusion category
concepts.description: The dual even part of the extended Haagerup subfactor, considered as a fusion category over ℂ.

concepts.title: Dual fusion category
concepts.description: For an indecomposable semisimple module category M over a fusion category C, the category Fun_C(M,M) of module endofunctors, with composition as tensor product.

concepts.title: Dual Haagerup fusion category
concepts.description: The dual even part of the Haagerup subfactor, considered as a fusion category over ℂ.

concepts.title: Dual object in a monoidal category
concepts.description: An object paired with another by evaluation and coevaluation maps satisfying the two zigzag identities; left and right duals reverse the order of the factors.

concepts.title: Dual Sperner labeling on a barycentrically subdivided simplex
concepts.description: On a barycentric subdivision of the standard n-simplex Δⁿ, n≥1, label vertices by {0,…,n}. A boundary vertex x must receive a label i with xᵢ=0; interior labels are unrestricted.

concepts.title: Dual Sperner lemma for barycentric subdivisions
concepts.description: For m≥1, the m-fold barycentric subdivision of a simplex satisfying the dual zero-coordinate boundary labeling rule contains an elementary n-simplex with all n+1 labels.

concepts.title: Duhamel formula for an inhomogeneous semigroup equation
concepts.description: If T_t is a strongly continuous semigroup with generator A and u is a classical solution of u′=Au+f with suitably integrable continuous forcing, then u(t)=T_tu(0)+∫₀ᵗT_{t−s}f(s)ds. The integral is a Bochner integral.

concepts.title: Dyadic cube in Euclidean space
concepts.description: A half-open cube 2⁻ʲ([0,1)ⁿ+k), with j∈ℤ and k∈ℤⁿ.

concepts.title: Dynkin’s π–λ theorem
concepts.description: If a family P contains the whole space and is closed under finite intersections, every family containing P and closed under complements and countable disjoint unions contains the σ-algebra generated by P.

concepts.title: Effective dimension in the truncation sense
concepts.description: For a nonconstant square-integrable function of n independent inputs and tolerance ε∈(0,1), the smallest k for which ANOVA components involving only the first k coordinates account for at least 1−ε of its variance.

concepts.title: Ehrenfest urn chain
concepts.description: A chain tracking the number of particles in one of two urns when particles switch urns, equivalently the number of ones in a collection of two-state coordinates. Discrete and continuous rates must be specified.

concepts.title: Eigenvalue of a linear endomorphism
concepts.description: A scalar λ for which a linear endomorphism T has a nonzero vector v with Tv=λv.

concepts.title: Eigenvalue of a densely defined operator
concepts.description: For A:D(A)⊆H→H, a scalar λ is an eigenvalue if there is a nonzero v∈D(A) with Av=λv. The operator need not be bounded or defined on all of H.

concepts.title: ℓ₁ block average in a Banach space with basis
concepts.description: An ℓ₁ⁿ average with constant c≥1 is x=n⁻¹(x₁+⋯+xₙ), where the xᵢ are successive block vectors with ∥xᵢ∥≤1 and ∥x∥≥1/c.

concepts.title: Elliott–Halberstam conjecture
concepts.description: The primes have every level of distribution θ<1, in the averaged arithmetic-progression error sense, with arbitrary logarithmic saving.

concepts.title: Regularity of Dirichlet elliptic eigenfunctions
concepts.description: On a bounded Lipschitz domain, Dirichlet eigenfunctions of the real symmetric uniformly elliptic divergence-form operator L=∑∂ᵢ(aⁱʲ∂ⱼ), with smooth real coefficients and no zeroth-order term are smooth in the interior, bounded, and extend continuously by zero to the boundary.

concepts.title: Holomorphic Eisenstein series for SL₂(Z)
concepts.description: For even k≥4, the modular form E_k(τ)=½∑_(c,d)=1(cτ+d)^(−k), normalized to constant Fourier coefficient 1. The weight-two series E₂=1−24∑_{n≥1}σ₁(n)q^n is quasimodular rather than modular.

concepts.title: Principal eigenvalue theorem for a scalar elliptic operator on a closed manifold
concepts.description: A self-adjoint uniformly elliptic scalar operator with real coefficients on a connected closed smooth manifold, whose principal part is ∑a^{ij}∂ᵢ∂ⱼ with positive definite (a^{ij}), has a simple largest eigenvalue and a strictly positive eigenfunction. Any strictly positive eigenfunction corresponds to that eigenvalue.

concepts.title: Discrete spectral theorem for self-adjoint elliptic operators on closed manifolds
concepts.description: A symmetric uniformly elliptic second-order differential operator with smooth coefficients on a closed smooth manifold, in L² of a smooth positive density, has a self-adjoint extension with domain H² and discrete real spectrum with an orthonormal basis of smooth eigenfunctions.

concepts.title: Strong maximum principle for uniformly elliptic equations
concepts.description: For L=div(A∇)+b·∇+c with uniformly elliptic A, locally bounded lower-order coefficients and c≤0, a nonnegative weak supersolution Lu≤0 on a connected domain is either positive almost everywhere or identically zero.

concepts.title: Sturm’s congruence bound for elliptic modular forms
concepts.description: For a weight-k holomorphic modular form on SL₂(ℤ) with p-integral rational Fourier coefficients a(n), vanishing a(n) modulo p for 0≤n≤⌊k/12⌋ forces all coefficients to vanish modulo p.

concepts.title: ℓᵖ space of scalar sequences
concepts.description: For1≤p≤∞, ℓᵖ is Lᵖ on the natural numbers with counting measure: p-summable scalar sequences for finite p and bounded sequences for p=∞.

concepts.title: Embedded smooth surface in ℝ³
concepts.description: A subset of ℝ³ that near each point is, after a rigid change of coordinates, the graph of a smooth real function of two variables.

concepts.title: Endomorphism algebra of an object in a linear category
concepts.description: The vector space End(X), with multiplication given by composition and unit the identity of X.

concepts.title: Envy-free allocation of finitely many shares
concepts.description: An allocation is envy-free if each participant weakly prefers their own assigned share to every other share, evaluated at that same allocation.

concepts.title: ε-net of a subset of a metric space
concepts.description: A set N is an ε-net of A if every point of A is within distance ε of some point of N. Unless specified otherwise, N need not be a subset of A.

concepts.title: Equivalence class
concepts.description: For an equivalence relation ~ on X, [x]={y∈X:y~x}; the quotient set X/~ consists of these classes.

concepts.title: Equivalence relation
concepts.description: A reflexive, symmetric and transitive binary relation.

concepts.title: Equivalent basic sequences
concepts.description: Two basic sequences are equivalent if each dominates the other; equivalently their coordinate correspondence extends to a Banach-space isomorphism of their closed spans.

concepts.title: Erdős–Rényi G(n,p) random graph
concepts.description: The random simple graph on n labeled vertices in which every possible edge is present independently with probability p.

concepts.title: Erdős–Szekeres convex polygon theorem
concepts.description: For each n≥3 there is N such that every planar set of at least N points in general position contains n points in convex position. The 1935 proof gives N≤binom(2n−4,n−2)+1.

concepts.title: Erdős–Szekeres cups–caps theorem
concepts.description: For r,s≥3, any binom(r+s−4,r−2)+1 planar points with no three collinear and with distinct x-coordinates contain an r-cup or an s-cap. This threshold is sharp for the cups–caps problem.

concepts.title: Erdős–Szekeres monotone subsequence theorem
concepts.description: For integers r,s≥2, every sequence of (r−1)(s−1)+1 distinct real numbers has an increasing subsequence of length r or a decreasing subsequence of length s, both strict. The threshold is sharp.

concepts.title: Esaki’s quasi-regularity theorem for infinite-particle jump forms
concepts.description: For a configuration law μ with locally Lᵖ finite-region particle densities (p>1), consider the closable jump form E(f,g)=½∫μ(dξ)∫ξ(dx)∫dy ν(ξ,x;y)[f(ξ−δ_x+δ_y)−f(ξ)][g(ξ−δ_x+δ_y)−g(ξ)] on local smooth functions. If ν≤Cp(|x−y|), ρ⁽¹⁾(x)=O(|x|ᵏ), p(r)=O(r⁻ᵈ⁻ᵅ) at infinity with α>κ, p(r)=O(r⁻ᵈ⁻ᵝ) near zero with 0<β<2, and Var ξ(B_r)/(Eξ(B_r))²=O(r⁻ᵟ) for some δ>0, its closure is a quasi-regular Dirichlet form.

concepts.title: Esaki’s quasi-Gibbs jump-form closability theorem
concepts.description: For the infinite-particle jump form on local smooth functions, suppose μ is (Φ,Ψ)-quasi-Gibbs and Φ,Ψ are bounded above and below by positive constant multiples of upper semicontinuous comparison potentials Φ₀,Ψ₀, locally bounded below, with Ψ₀ even and its infinite-value set compact. Under the standing symmetric jump-kernel integrability assumptions ∫(1∧|x−y|²)ν(ξ,x;y)dy<∞, the form is closable on L²(μ).

concepts.title: Essential supremum of a measurable real function
concepts.description: The infimum of real a for which f≤a almost everywhere, allowing infinite values when no finite bound exists.

concepts.title: Etemadi's strong law for random arrays
concepts.description: For an r-indexed pairwise independent identically distributed real array with E[abs(X)(log⁺abs(X))ʳ⁻¹]<∞, its rectangular averages converge almost surely to EX as every side length tends to infinity.

concepts.title: Etemadi's strong law of large numbers
concepts.description: If (Xₙ) is pairwise independent and identically distributed with E abs(X₁)<∞, then (X₁+···+Xₙ)/n→EX₁ almost surely.

concepts.title: Euclidean space ℝᵈ
concepts.description: For d≥1, ℝᵈ consists of d-tuples of real numbers with distance dist(x,y)=(∑ᵢ(xᵢ−yᵢ)²)¹ᐟ².

concepts.title: Euler brick
concepts.description: A rectangular box whose edges and all three face diagonals have integer lengths; its space diagonal need not have integer length.

concepts.title: Euler–Lagrange equation for first-order variational integrals
concepts.description: Let Ω⊂R^n be open, L∈C²(Ω×R×R^n), and u∈C²(Ω). If for every φ∈C_c^∞(Ω) the first variation at t=0 of ∫_{supp φ}[L(x,u+tφ,∇u+t∇φ)−L(x,u,∇u)]dx vanishes, then L_u(x,u,∇u)−∑ᵢ∂ᵢL_{pᵢ}(x,u,∇u)=0 throughout Ω.

concepts.title: Euler measure of a surface with assigned corner angles
concepts.description: For a compact surface F with finitely many assigned boundary corner angles θᵢ, its Euler measure is e(F)=χ(F)−∑ᵢ(π−θᵢ)/(2π). Smooth portions of the boundary contribute no corner correction.

concepts.title: Euler totient function
concepts.description: The number φ(n) of integers 1≤a≤n coprime to n.

concepts.title: Exact sequence of vector spaces
concepts.description: A sequence of linear maps is exact at a vector space if the image of the incoming map equals the kernel of the outgoing map; it is exact if this holds everywhere.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Expectation of an integrable real random variable
concepts.description: If E abs(X)=∫abs(X)dP<∞, the expectation of X is EX=∫X dP.

concepts.title: Exponential distribution
concepts.description: The nonnegative distribution with survival function P(T>t)=exp(−rt), t≥0, for rate r>0; its mean is 1/r.

concepts.title: Moment determinacy from a finite exponential moment
concepts.description: A real probability law whose moment generating function is finite in a neighborhood of zero is uniquely determined by its moments. In particular exponential distributions are moment-determinate.

concepts.title: Extended Haagerup planar algebra
concepts.description: The shaded subfactor planar algebra of the extended Haagerup subfactor. Morrison–Snyder use a rescaled generator and lopsided normalization of it.

concepts.title: Extended Haagerup subfactor
concepts.description: The finite-depth hyperfinite II₁ subfactor with the extended Haagerup principal graph pair, of index approximately 4.3772.

concepts.title: Extended nonnegative real numbers
concepts.description: The nonnegative real numbers together with a greatest element ∞. Sums involving ∞ equal ∞, and 0·∞ is taken to be 0 when integrating simple functions.

concepts.title: Exterior power of a module over a commutative ring
concepts.description: The module Λ^n_R M equipped with the universal alternating R-multilinear map M^n→Λ^n_R M; equivalently the corresponding quotient of the tensor power by tensors with repeated entries. This is the alternating quotient convention, not the anti-invariant tensor submodule.

concepts.title: Extreme point of a convex set
concepts.description: A point x of a convex set is extreme if x=(1−t)y+tz with0<t<1 and y,z in the set implies y=z=x.

concepts.title: Extreme value theorem on a compact real interval
concepts.description: A continuous real function on [a,b] attains both a maximum and a minimum.

concepts.title: F-supercuspidal local test function
concepts.description: At a finite place v,a compactly supported locally constant function on G(F_v) is F-supercuspidal if every left or right translate has zero integral along the unipotent radical of each proper F-defined parabolic subgroup.

concepts.title: Face of a convex set
concepts.description: A convex subset F of a convex set K is a face if an interior point of a nontrivial segment in K belongs to F only when both endpoints belong to F.

concepts.title: Finite factor graph
concepts.description: A finite bipartite graph with variable nodes, factor nodes, and a nonnegative function at each factor depending on its adjacent variables. Multiplying the factor functions gives the weight of an assignment.

concepts.title: Factorial domination of fixed exponentials
concepts.description: For every fixed real C>0, the sequence Cⁿ/n! tends to zero.

concepts.title: Farkas’ lemma
concepts.description: For a real m×n matrix A and real row b,exactly one holds: xA≤b for some real row x; or Ay=0 for some nonzero column y≥0 with by<0.

concepts.title: Fatou’s lemma
concepts.description: For nonnegative measurable functions f_n on a measure space, ∫liminf_n f_n≤liminf_n∫f_n, allowing∞.

concepts.title: Fermat's two-square theorem
concepts.description: A prime p is a²+b² for integers a,b if and only if p=2 or p≡1 (mod 4).

concepts.title: Fiber dimension theorem for algebraic varieties
concepts.description: For a dominant morphism of irreducible algebraic varieties, the generic fiber has dimension dim X−dim Y; if all fibers have dimension r, then dim X=dim Y+r.

concepts.title: Field
concepts.description: A commutative ring in which 1≠0 and every nonzero element is invertible.

concepts.title: Characteristic of a field
concepts.description: The least positive integer n with n·1=0 in the field, if one exists, and zero otherwise.

concepts.title: Field embedding
concepts.description: An injective homomorphism of fields preserving the multiplicative identity.

concepts.title: Field extension
concepts.description: An inclusion of one field into another.

concepts.title: Norm in a finite field extension
concepts.description: For a finite field extension L/K, N_(L/K)(a) is the determinant of the K-linear multiplication map x↦ax on L.

concepts.title: Trace in a finite field extension
concepts.description: For a finite field extension L/K and a∈L, Tr_(L/K)(a) is the trace of the K-linear multiplication map x↦ax on L.

concepts.title: Filtration of σ-algebras
concepts.description: An increasing family (F_t) of sub-σ-algebras on a fixed probability space, indexed by ordered time: F_s⊆F_t for s≤t.

concepts.title: Closure of finite Blaschke products under composition
concepts.description: The composition of two nonconstant finite Blaschke products of degrees m and n is a finite Blaschke product of degree mn; composing with a disk automorphism preserves the degree.

concepts.title: Finite Blaschke product
concepts.description: A function B(z)=c∏ₖ₌₁ⁿ(z−aₖ)/(1−āₖz), with |c|=1 and |aₖ|<1. Constant unimodular functions are allowed when n=0.

concepts.title: Positive-power criterion for finite Markov chains
concepts.description: An irreducible finite transition matrix is aperiodic if and only if some positive integer power is entrywise strictly positive; then every sufficiently large power is entrywise positive.

concepts.title: Finite coefficient criterion for integrality of Siegel modular forms
concepts.description: For a degree-g≥2, weight-k Siegel modular form with rational coefficients, if every c(T) with all diagonal entries tᵢᵢ≤(4/3)^g k/16 is integral, then every coefficient is integral. The same implication holds for p-integrality.

concepts.title: Finite-depth subfactor
concepts.description: A finite-index subfactor whose principal graphs are finite, equivalently whose even parts have only finitely many simple objects.

concepts.title: Spectral theorem for a real symmetric matrix
concepts.description: Every real symmetric matrix admits an orthonormal basis of real eigenvectors; equivalently A=UΛUᵀ with U orthogonal and Λ real diagonal.

concepts.title: Finite-dimensional vector space
concepts.description: A vector space having a finite basis.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Finite field
concepts.description: A field whose underlying set is finite.

concepts.title: Frobenius generates the absolute Galois group of a finite field
concepts.description: For F_q, its absolute Galois group is procyclic, topologically generated by x↦x^q; equivalently the integer powers of that Frobenius are dense in Gal(F_q^sep/F_q).

concepts.title: Field with two elements
concepts.description: The field F₂={0,1} with1+1=0 and the usual identities0+a=a,1·a=a,0·a=0.

concepts.title: Finite hypergraph
concepts.description: A finite vertex set V with a family E of subsets of V called hyperedges.

concepts.title: Involution of a finite set
concepts.description: An involution of a finite set X is a map f:X→X with f(f(x))=x for all x∈X.

concepts.title: Convergence to equilibrium for finite irreducible aperiodic Markov chains
concepts.description: Every finite irreducible aperiodic Markov chain has a unique strictly positive stationary law π, and Pⁿ(x,y)→π(y) for every pair of states, hence in total variation from every initial law.

concepts.title: Product distribution on a finite product space
concepts.description: For probability mass functions p_i on finite sets Ω_i, the product distribution on ∏_iΩ_i assigns (ω_i)_i the probability ∏_ip_i(ω_i).

concepts.title: Finite Ramsey theorem for uniform subset colorings
concepts.description: For integers r≥1 and s,t≥r, there is N such that every red–blue coloring of r-subsets of an N-element set has a red-homogeneous s-set or a blue-homogeneous t-set.

concepts.title: Finite-rank linear operator
concepts.description: A linear map whose image is finite-dimensional.

concepts.title: Finite set
concepts.description: A set X is finite if it is bijective with {1,…,n} for some natural number n≥0; its cardinality is n.

concepts.title: Finite simple undirected graph
concepts.description: A finite simple graph is (V,E), where V is finite and E is a set of two-element subsets of V.

concepts.title: Finite-sums set of a sequence
concepts.description: For a finite or infinite sequence (xᵢ) of positive integers, FS(xᵢ) consists of sums over finite nonempty sets of distinct indices.

concepts.title: Finitely generated commutative algebra
concepts.description: An R-algebra A generated as an algebra by finitely many elements; equivalently a quotient of R[X₁,…,X_n] for some finite n.

concepts.title: Finitely presented commutative algebra
concepts.description: An R-algebra isomorphic to R[X₁,…,X_n]/(f₁,…,f_m) for finite n,m.

concepts.title: Finitely supported scalar sequence
concepts.description: A scalar sequence with only finitely many nonzero terms; these sequences form the vector space c₀₀.

concepts.title: Finner’s inequality
concepts.description: If nonnegative Y_e are hypergraph-correlated over a finite hypergraph and φ is a fractional matching with positive weights on the factors considered, then E∏_eY_e≤∏_e(EY_e^{1/φ(e)})^{φ(e)}. Zero-weight factors can instead be controlled by their essential suprema.

concepts.title: First Dirichlet spectral gap
concepts.description: For a bounded-domain self-adjoint Dirichlet operator with ordered eigenvalues λ₁<λ₂≤⋯, the first spectral gap is λ₂−λ₁.

concepts.title: Surface-area integral formula for first mixed volume
concepts.description: For full-dimensional convex bodies K,L⊂ℝⁿ, V(K[n−1],L)=n⁻¹∫_{S^{n−1}}h_L(u)dS_K(u).

concepts.title: First nonabelian Galois cohomology set
concepts.description: For an algebraic F-group H, H¹(F,H) is the pointed set of continuous 1-cocycles of Gal(F^sep/F) with values in the discrete group H(F^sep), modulo c′(σ)=h⁻¹c(σ)σ(h). The distinguished point is the trivial cocycle.

concepts.title: First variation of a functional
concepts.description: For a functional J on a space of functions, its first variation at u in the allowed direction φ is the derivative at t=0 of J(u+tφ), when it exists. A function is stationary if this derivative vanishes for every allowed variation.

concepts.title: Fisher–Kolmogorov–Petrovsky–Piskunov equation
concepts.description: A reaction–diffusion equation ∂_tu=DΔu+r u(1−u), with D,r>0, on a specified spatial domain and with specified initial and boundary conditions. It appears in population models and branching Brownian survival probabilities.

concepts.title: Fixed point of a self-map
concepts.description: A fixed point of f:X→X is an x∈X satisfying f(x)=x. The fixed-point set is Fix(f)={x∈X:f(x)=x}.

concepts.title: Fixed vector subspace of a group representation
concepts.description: For a representation π on V and a subgroup H, the subspace V^H={v:π(h)v=v for every h∈H}. This means pointwise fixed vectors, not merely an invariant subspace.

concepts.title: Flandoli–Gess–Scheutzow synchronization criterion for ordered random systems
concepts.description: Let a continuous order-preserving random dynamical system on a Polish space have closed partial order and one-point laws converging to μ from every initial state. If for every ε>0 there are f≤g with μ([f,g])≥1−ε, then there is a past-measurable invariant random point attracting every deterministic initial point in pullback probability. No normality, admissibility or white-noise assumption is required.

concepts.title: Flandoli–Gess–Scheutzow weak synchronization for stochastic porous media
concepts.description: On a bounded smooth domain in ℝᵈ with d≤4, the zero-Dirichlet stochastic porous medium equation dX=[Δ(|X|^{m−1}X)+X]dt+dW, m>1, with trace-class additive Wiener noise has a singleton weak point attractor whenever its associated random dynamical system has one-point laws converging to one limiting law from every H⁻¹ initial state. The point also attracts deterministic sets contained in order intervals for the usual positive-distribution order.

concepts.title: Florentin–Segal quantitative symmetrization theorem for star-shaped sets
concepts.description: For n≥2, 0<ε<1/2 and a nonempty compact set K⊂ℝⁿ star shaped about 0, at most Cn|log ε| Minkowski symmetrizations produce K̃ with (1−ε)M*(K)B₂ⁿ⊆K̃⊆(1+ε)M*(K)B₂ⁿ, for a universal C.

concepts.title: Formal L² adjoint of a differential operator on a surface
concepts.description: For a differential operator D between Euclidean vector-valued functions on a smooth surface, its formal adjoint D* is specified by ∫⟨Du,v⟩=∫⟨u,D*v⟩ for smooth compactly supported test fields, using the induced surface measure. This identity does not assert a bounded operator on L².

concepts.title: Formal power series over a commutative ring
concepts.description: An expression ∑a_α X^α with coefficients in a commutative ring and multi-indices α in N^n, added coefficientwise and multiplied by the finite Cauchy sums defining each coefficient, without any assertion of analytic convergence.

concepts.title: Fourier expansion of a Siegel modular form
concepts.description: The expansion F(Z)=∑_T c(T)exp(2πi tr(TZ)), with T positive semidefinite and half-integral in the full-level scalar case.

concepts.title: Fourier inversion theorem on Schwartz space
concepts.description: With f̂(ξ)=∫f(x)e^{−ix·ξ}dx, every Schwartz function satisfies f(x)=(2π)^{−n}∫f̂(ξ)e^{ix·ξ}dξ, and the Fourier transform maps Schwartz space continuously onto itself.

concepts.title: Fourier–Jacobi expansion of a Siegel modular form
concepts.description: Expand a degree-(g+1) Siegel form along the last diagonal variable: F([[τ,zᵀ],[z,τ′]])=∑_{m≥0}φ_m(τ,z)exp(2πimτ′), where φ_m are degree-g Jacobi forms.

concepts.title: Fourier transform on Euclidean space
concepts.description: For an integrable f on ℝⁿ, its Fourier transform is f̂(ξ)=∫f(x)e⁻ⁱˣ·ξ dx; extend it to Schwartz functions and tempered distributions by duality.

concepts.title: Cyclotomicity of Frobenius–Perron dimensions
concepts.description: The Frobenius–Perron dimension of every object in a fusion category over ℂ is a cyclotomic integer.

concepts.title: Fractional Brownian motion
concepts.description: A centered continuous Gaussian process Bᴴ_t with covariance ½(|t|²ᴴ+|s|²ᴴ−|t−s|²ᴴ), H∈(0,1), normalized to start at zero. It has stationary increments, generally dependent unless H=½.

concepts.title: Fractional chromatic number of a graph
concepts.description: For a finite graph G, χ_f(G)=inf_{b≥1}χ_b(G)/b, where χ_b is its b-fold chromatic number.

concepts.title: Fractional matching in a finite hypergraph
concepts.description: Weights φ(e)≥0 on the hyperedges such that ∑_{e∋v}φ(e)≤1 for every vertex v. The fractional matching number is the maximum of ∑_eφ(e).

concepts.title: Fractional-matching bound for random independent sets in a hypergraph
concepts.description: Include each vertex v of a finite hypergraph independently with probability p_v. For every fractional matching φ, the probability that the chosen vertices contain no hyperedge is at most ∏_e(1−∏_{v∈e}p_v)^{φ(e)}. For k-uniform hypergraphs and constant p this is at most (1−pᵏ)^{ν*(H)}.

concepts.title: Frazier–Jawerth φ-transform
concepts.description: A discrete analysis map sends a tempered distribution to its scale-normalized convolutions with admissible band-limited Schwartz functions sampled at dyadic cube corners; a dual family reconstructs it by summing the associated atoms.

concepts.title: Fréchet derivative between normed spaces
concepts.description: The Fréchet derivative of f at x is a bounded linear map A with ∥f(x+h)−f(x)−Ah∥/∥h∥→0 as h→0.

concepts.title: Frobenius element at a prime of a Galois extension
concepts.description: The element of D_w/I_w acting on the residue extension by x↦x^(#k_v). At an unramified prime it gives a conjugacy class in Gal(L/F), independently of the chosen w above v.

concepts.title: Frobenius endomorphism in characteristic p
concepts.description: The field endomorphism x↦x^p of a field of characteristic p; over F_q the q-power iterate x↦x^q is the corresponding q-Frobenius.

concepts.title: Frobenius norm of a real or complex matrix
concepts.description: The Frobenius norm of A is (∑_{i,j}|a_{ij}|²)^{1/2}.

concepts.title: Frobenius–Perron dimension in a fusion category
concepts.description: For a simple object X of a fusion category over ℂ, FPdim(X) is the spectral radius of its fusion matrix, whose entries are multiplicities in X⊗Y. Extend this additively to other objects.

concepts.title: Fubini’s theorem for integrable functions
concepts.description: An integrable function on the product of σ-finite measure spaces has integrable almost-everywhere sections, and its product integral equals either iterated integral.

concepts.title: Function between sets
concepts.description: An assignment taking each element of a specified domain set to exactly one element of a specified codomain set.

concepts.title: Function of bounded variation on an interval
concepts.description: A real function f has bounded variation on [a,b] if sup∑_i|f(t_i)−f(t_{i−1})| over finite ordered partitions is finite. Vector-valued paths use the corresponding norm.

concepts.title: Composition of functions
concepts.description: For f:A→B and g:B→C, the composite g∘f:A→C sends x to g(f(x)).

concepts.title: Limit of a function between metric spaces
concepts.description: For f defined near an accumulation point a of a metric space, lim_{x→a}f(x)=L means that for every ε>0 there is δ>0 such that 0<d(x,a)<δ implies d(f(x),L)<ε.

concepts.title: Functor
concepts.description: A map of categories preserving objects, morphisms, identities and composition.

concepts.title: Fundamental theorem of calculus for continuous integrands
concepts.description: If f is continuous on [a,b], then F(x)=∫ₐˣf(t)dt has derivative f on (a,b); any antiderivative G of f satisfies ∫ₐᵇf=G(b)−G(a).

concepts.title: Fundamental lemma of the calculus of variations
concepts.description: If a continuous real function g on an open Ω⊂R^n satisfies ∫gφ=0 for every smooth compactly supported real φ, then g=0 on Ω.

concepts.title: Fundamental theorem of algebra
concepts.description: Every nonconstant polynomial with complex coefficients has a complex root; equivalently it factors completely into linear factors over ℂ.

concepts.title: Fundamental theorem of arithmetic
concepts.description: Every integer n≥2 factors as a product of primes uniquely up to ordering.

concepts.title: Fundamental theorem of Lebesgue integration
concepts.description: If g∈L¹([a,b]), F(x)=∫_a^xg is absolutely continuous and F′=g almost everywhere. Conversely every absolutely continuous F has an integrable a.e. derivative and F(x)−F(a)=∫_a^xF′.

concepts.title: Fusion category
concepts.description: A k-linear semisimple abelian rigid monoidal category with finitely many isomorphism classes of simple objects, finite-dimensional morphism spaces, a k-bilinear tensor product and End(1)=k. Over a non-algebraically closed field, simple objects need not be split.

concepts.title: Fusion matrix
concepts.description: For an object X in a fusion category over ℂ, the matrix (N_X)_{Z,Y} records the multiplicity of the simple object Z in X⊗Y. Rows and columns are indexed by simple isomorphism classes.

concepts.title: Braid generation of the G₂ tensor centralizer
concepts.description: For the seven-dimensional U_q(𝔤₂)-module V over ℂ(q), the R-matrix representation induces a surjective algebra map ℂ(q)[Bₙ]→End_{U_q(𝔤₂)}(V⊗n) for every n.

concepts.title: Lie algebra 𝔤₂
concepts.description: The 14-dimensional complex simple Lie algebra of exceptional type G₂.

concepts.title: Kuperberg's G₂ spider
concepts.description: The ℂ(q)-linear tensor category presented by planar G₂ webs and Kuperberg's local relations. The paper uses its single-edge trivalent presentation generated by the seven-dimensional module.

concepts.title: Kuperberg's G₂ spider equivalence theorem
concepts.description: Over ℂ(q), the G₂ spider is equivalent, as a braided tensor category, to the category whose objects are tensor powers of the seven-dimensional U_q(𝔤₂)-module and whose morphisms are intertwiners.

concepts.title: G₂ web
concepts.description: A planar trivalent graph with specified boundary endpoints, interpreted as a morphism in the G₂ spider; closed loop components are allowed.

concepts.title: Kuperberg's G₂ web-basis theorem
concepts.description: Over ℂ(q), each morphism space in the G₂ spider has a basis consisting of the non-elliptic webs.

concepts.title: Galois conjugate of a fusion category
concepts.description: For a fusion category over ℂ with a complete form over a number field k, apply an embedding k→ℂ to its associativity and other structure coefficients and extend scalars to ℂ. This gives a conjugate tensor category, up to tensor equivalence.

concepts.title: Fundamental theorem of finite Galois theory
concepts.description: For a finite Galois extension L/k, intermediate fields correspond bijectively, with inclusions reversed, to subgroups of Gal(L/k), by taking fixed fields.

concepts.title: Galois field extension
concepts.description: An algebraic field extension that is both normal and separable.

concepts.title: Galois group of a finite Galois extension
concepts.description: The group of field automorphisms of the extension that fix the base field pointwise.

concepts.title: Galton–Watson branching process
concepts.description: A population process Z_{n+1}=∑_{i=1}^{Z_n}A_{n,i}, where all offspring counts are independent with a common nonnegative-integer distribution and are independent of the past.

concepts.title: Congruence subgroup Γ₁(N)
concepts.description: The subgroup of SL₂(ℤ) whose matrices [[a,b],[c,d]] satisfy a≡d≡1 and c≡0 moduloN.

concepts.title: Even moments of a centered Gaussian
concepts.description: For Z∼N(0,σ²), E[Z^{2k}]=(2k−1)!!σ^{2k} and odd moments vanish, with (−1)!!=1. The double factorial counts pairings of 2k labeled elements.

concepts.title: Orthogonal invariance of the standard Gaussian distribution
concepts.description: If X has n independent N(0,1) coordinates and U is a real orthogonal n×n matrix, then UX has the same distribution as X.

concepts.title: Gaussian process
concepts.description: A real or vector-valued stochastic process whose every finite vector of coordinate evaluations has a multivariate normal law.

concepts.title: Gelfand triple of Banach and Hilbert spaces
concepts.description: A reflexive real Banach space V embedded continuously and densely in a real Hilbert space H, with H identified with its continuous dual so that V⊂H⊂V*. The duality V*×V extends the H inner product.

concepts.title: General linear group over a commutative ring
concepts.description: The group GL_n(R) of square matrices over a commutative ring R having a two-sided matrix inverse, with matrix multiplication.

concepts.title: Generalized eigenvector
concepts.description: For an endomorphism T and scalar λ, a nonzero vector v with (T−λI)ᵏv=0 for some k≥1 is a generalized eigenvector; a Jordan chain satisfies (T−λI)v₁=0 and (T−λI)v_{j+1}=v_j.

concepts.title: Generalized happy number
concepts.description: A positive integer x is happy for base b and exponent e if some iterate of the digit-power map S_{e,b} sends x to1; ordinary happy numbers have b=10 and e=2.

concepts.title: Density approximation for the weighted generalized-mean integrability criterion
concepts.description: Let (Λ,μ) be a nonzero σ-finite measure space and N≥2. Symmetric probability densities P on Λᴺ can be approximated in L¹ by strictly positive symmetric densities Q for which Q(·,x)≥γ(x)Q_(N−1) almost everywhere for almost every x in a positive-measure set, with γ(x)>0 and Q_(N−1) the marginal. If 0<μ(Λ)<∞, such densities contain an open dense subset of the bounded symmetric probability densities in the L∞ topology.

concepts.title: Generalized N-mean of a kernel of order m
concepts.description: For 1≤m≤N, set G_{m,N}(u)(x₁,…,x_N)=binom(N,m)⁻¹∑_{i₁<⋯<i_m}u(x_{i₁},…,x_{i_m}). Kernels need not be symmetric; equalities in measure-theoretic applications are understood almost everywhere.

concepts.title: Almost-everywhere convergence of generalized means and their kernels
concepts.description: On a nonzero complete σ-finite measure space, fix 1≤m≤N. A sequence G_{m,N}(uₙ) has an almost-everywhere finite limit U exactly when uₙ has an almost-everywhere finite limit u; then U=G_{m,N}(u) almost everywhere. In particular a generalized mean has a unique kernel modulo null sets.

concepts.title: Measurability and essential boundedness in generalized-mean kernel recovery
concepts.description: On a nonzero complete σ-finite measure space, G_{m,N}(u) is measurable exactly when its almost-everywhere finite kernel u is measurable. Moreover G_{m,N}(u)∈L∞ exactly when u∈L∞, with ∥G_{m,N}(u)∥∞≤∥u∥∞≤C(m,N)∥G_{m,N}(u)∥∞.

concepts.title: Weighted Lʳ equivalence for generalized means under a marginal lower bound
concepts.description: Let P>0 be a symmetric probability density on Λᴺ over a complete nonzero σ-finite measure space. Suppose on a positive-measure set of final coordinates x_N there is γ(x_N)>0 with P(·,x_N)≥γ(x_N)P_{N−1} almost everywhere. For 1≤m≤N and 1≤r<∞, G_{m,N}(u)∈Lʳ(P) exactly when u∈Lʳ(P_m), and the two norms are comparable by constants independent of u.

concepts.title: σ-algebra generated by a family of subsets
concepts.description: The smallest σ-algebra containing that family, equivalently the intersection of all σ-algebras on the ambient set that contain it.

concepts.title: Subfield generated by a subset
concepts.description: For S⊆L in a field extension L/F, F(S) is the smallest subfield of L containing F and S.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Generator of a finite continuous-time Markov chain
concepts.description: The real matrix Q with Q(x,y)=lim_{h↓0}(P_h(x,y)−1_{x=y})/h, nonnegative off-diagonal entries and zero row sums; off-diagonal entries are jump rates.

concepts.title: Geometric Brownian motion
concepts.description: The process S_t=S₀exp((μ−σ²/2)t+σB_t), equivalently the solution of dS_t=μS_tdt+σS_tdB_t for S₀>0.

concepts.title: Geometric character lattice of a reductive group
concepts.description: For a connected reductive F-group, X*(G)=Hom_(Fsep-groups)(G_Fsep,G_m) with pointwise multiplication and its natural absolute-Galois action. It is a finitely generated free abelian group; its fixed elements are the F-rational characters.

concepts.title: Geometric distribution on positive integers
concepts.description: For 0<p≤1, P(G=k)=p(1−p)^(k−1) for k=1,2,…; G counts trials up to and including the first success. Its tail is P(G>k)=(1−p)^k.

concepts.title: Geometrically connected affine algebraic group
concepts.description: An affine F-group whose coordinate algebra after extension to an algebraic closure has no idempotents other than 0 and 1. This is the coordinate-algebra account of connectedness after base change.

concepts.title: Spectral-gap bound for pure drift on randomly rewired cycle arcs
concepts.description: Let k arc lengths be independent Geometric(1/L) variables,with k,L→∞ and fixed 0<ρ_l<log L/log k<ρ_u<∞. For the pure drift chain that moves along arcs and chooses the next arc uniformly at endpoints, every γ>4 gives absolute spectral gap greater than 1/(L(log k)^γ) with high probability; the exceptional probability is O(k^(−c)L^(−d)) for any fixed c,d>0. Conditioning the total number of vertices to be n gives the same high-probability bound for the uniformly cut-cycle model with L=n/k.

concepts.title: Decay of boundary influence for Gibbs measures on trees
concepts.description: On rooted factor trees, the root marginal changes by arbitrarily little in total variation under every possible boundary condition at sufficiently large distance. This uniform condition yields uniqueness of the limiting root marginal.

concepts.title: Gibbs distribution on a finite configuration space
concepts.description: For a finite set Ω, energy H:Ω→ℝ and inverse temperature β≥0, the Gibbs distribution is μ(σ)=exp(−βH(σ))/Z, where Z=∑_{τ∈Ω}exp(−βH(τ)).

concepts.title: Girsanov change of measure for constant Brownian drift
concepts.description: On Brownian paths up to T, changing measure by exp(−νB_T−ν²T/2) makes B_t+νt standard Brownian motion for 0≤t≤T.

concepts.title: Global dimension of a fusion category
concepts.description: For a fusion category over ℂ, the global dimension is the sum of the intrinsic squared norms of its simple objects. For a spherical structure it is the sum of their squared categorical dimensions.

concepts.title: Cyclotomicity of global dimensions of fusion categories
concepts.description: The global dimension of a fusion category over ℂ is a cyclotomic integer.

concepts.title: Goldbach number
concepts.description: A positive integer expressible as the sum of two prime numbers.

concepts.title: Good trace on an ordered abelian group
concepts.description: A positive trace τ is good if for a∈G and positive nonzero g with0<τ(a)<τ(g),there is0≤a′≤g with τ(a′)=τ(a).

concepts.title: Gordan’s theorem of the alternative
concepts.description: For a real matrix A,exactly one holds: Ay=0 for some nonzero y≥0; or xA is strictly positive for some real row x.

concepts.title: Failure of diagonal-plus-strictly-singular decomposition on a Gowers-space subspace
concepts.description: There is a closed subspace Y of Gowers’s unconditional space X_U and a bounded operator T:Y→X_U which cannot be written D|Y+S with D a bounded diagonal operator on X_U and S strictly singular.

concepts.title: Gowers’s unconditional space from the hyperplane construction
concepts.description: The Banach space X_U from Gowers’s 1994 construction, obtained by completing c₀₀ in a norm combining Schlumprecht-type successive-coordinate averages and specially coded functionals using absolute coordinate data. Its unit vector basis is unconditional and tight by support; admissible coding data are fixed in the construction.

concepts.title: Gradient of a scalar function on Euclidean space
concepts.description: For differentiable f on an open subset of R^n, the vector ∇f=(∂₁f,…,∂ₙf), defined by its coordinate partial derivatives.

concepts.title: Graph distance
concepts.description: The distance between two vertices is the minimum length of a path joining them, or infinity if no such path exists.

concepts.title: Girth of a graph
concepts.description: The length of a shortest cycle, with girth infinity for an acyclic graph. In a multigraph a loop has length one and two parallel edges form a cycle of length two.

concepts.title: Path in an undirected graph
concepts.description: A finite sequence of adjacent edges joining successive vertices; a simple path has no repeated vertex. Its length is the number of edges.

concepts.title: Subgraph of a simple graph
concepts.description: A graph obtained from a simple graph by choosing some vertices and some of the original edges between those vertices; an induced subgraph retains all such edges.

concepts.title: Greatest common divisor of integers
concepts.description: For integers a,b not both zero, gcd(a,b) is their greatest positive common divisor.

concepts.title: Existence of a greatest harmonic minorant on the unit disk
concepts.description: A superharmonic function on the unit disk that has a subharmonic minorant not identically−∞ has a greatest harmonic function lying below it.

concepts.title: Greatest lower bound
concepts.description: For a subset A of a partially ordered set, its greatest lower bound is a lower bound of A lying above every lower bound of A, when one exists.

concepts.title: Green function of the unit disk
concepts.description: For z,ζ in the disk, G(z,ζ)=log|(1−ζ̄z)/(z−ζ)|, with value∞ at z=ζ; it is zero at the boundary in the z variable and gives the disk’s logarithmic potential kernel.

concepts.title: Green–Tao theorem
concepts.description: The prime numbers contain nonconstant arithmetic progressions of every finite length.

concepts.title: Gritsenko–Nikulin’s product for the genus-two weight-five theta product
concepts.description: The genus-two modular form Δ₅, the normalized product of the ten even genus-two theta constants, has product (qrs)^(1/2)∏_(n,l,m)>0(1−qⁿrˡsᵐ)^(f(4nm−l²)), where f is the discriminant coefficient function of φ₀,₁.

concepts.title: Gritsenko–Nikulin’s product formulas for Igusa cusp forms
concepts.description: Write q=e^(2πiz₁), r=e^(2πiz₂), s=e^(2πiz₃), and let f(D) be the discriminant coefficients of φ₀,₁. The integrally normalized Igusa forms satisfy X₁₀=qrs∏(1−qⁿrˡsᵐ)^(2f(4nm−l²)) and X₃₅=q²rs²(q−s)∏(1−qⁿrˡsᵐ)^(f₂(4nm−l²)), where f₂(N)=8f(4N)+2((−N/2)−1)f(N)+f(N/4), using the Kronecker symbol and f(N/4)=0 unless 4 divides N. Products range over n,m≥0, arbitrary l when n+m>0, and l<0 when n=m=0; they converge near the standard cusp.

concepts.title: Integral Grönwall inequality
concepts.description: If u is nonnegative and continuous on [0,T], a≥0, b≥0 is integrable, and u(t)≤a+∫₀ᵗb(s)u(s)ds for every t, then u(t)≤a exp(∫₀ᵗb(s)ds) for every t∈[0,T].

concepts.title: Grothendieck ring of a fusion category
concepts.description: For a fusion category, the free abelian group on simple isomorphism classes, with addition induced by direct sum and multiplication by tensor product.

concepts.title: Group
concepts.description: A set with an associative binary operation, an identity element, and a two-sided inverse for each element.

concepts.title: Group action on a set
concepts.description: A map G×X→X, written (g,x)↦gx, satisfying ex=x and (gh)x=g(hx).

concepts.title: Group algebra
concepts.description: For a group G and field k, k[G] consists of finite k-linear combinations of group elements, with multiplication extending the group law bilinearly.

concepts.title: Automorphism of a group
concepts.description: A bijective group homomorphism from a group to itself; automorphisms form a group under composition.

concepts.title: Group homomorphism
concepts.description: A map f:G→H satisfying f(xy)=f(x)f(y) for all x,y.

concepts.title: Linear representation of a group
concepts.description: A group homomorphism from a group G to the invertible linear maps of a vector space, equivalently a linear action of G.

concepts.title: Grüss inequality for finite families in semi-inner-product C*-modules
concepts.description: Let pᵢ≥0 sum to one, and let xᵢ,yᵢ lie in a semi-inner-product C*-module with ∥xᵢ−a∥≤r and ∥yᵢ−b∥≤s. Then ∥∑pᵢ⟨xᵢ,yᵢ⟩−⟨∑pᵢxᵢ,∑pᵢyᵢ⟩∥≤rs; the constant one is optimal.

concepts.title: Grüss inequality for bounded real functions
concepts.description: If m≤f≤M and n≤g≤N almost everywhere on [a,b], with a<b, then the absolute difference between the average of fg and the product of the averages of f and g is at most (M−m)(N−n)/4. The constant 1/4 is optimal.

concepts.title: Drinfeld center of the Haagerup fusion category
concepts.description: The common braided center of the principal and dual Haagerup fusion categories, with the ribbon structure coming from their subfactor construction.

concepts.title: Fields of definition of the Haagerup and extended Haagerup fusion categories
concepts.description: For ℓ=0,1 write Hℓᵖ,Hℓᵈ for the principal and dual even parts and Dℓ for the index. Put n=4ℓ+4, choose q with q+q⁻¹=√Dℓ, and let λℓ²=−[n+2]_q/([2]_q²[n]_q). Both even parts have rational forms over ℚ(Dℓ); for ℚ⊂k⊂ℂ, Hℓᵈ has a complete rational form over k iff Dℓ∈k, and Hℓᵖ iff λℓ∈k. The center Z(H₀ᵖ) has a complete rational form as a ribbon category over k iff ζ₃₉∈k.

concepts.title: Galois conjugates of the Haagerup and extended Haagerup fusion categories
concepts.description: Up to tensor equivalence, the principal Haagerup even part has two Galois conjugates and the principal extended Haagerup even part has three. All the nonoriginal conjugates are nonunitary. The normal closures of their complete fields of definition have Galois groups D₈ (order eight) and C₂×A₄, respectively.

concepts.title: Haagerup planar algebra
concepts.description: The shaded subfactor planar algebra of the Haagerup subfactor. Morrison–Snyder use a rescaled generator and lopsided normalization of it.

concepts.title: Haagerup subfactor
concepts.description: The finite-depth hyperfinite II₁ subfactor with index (5+√13)/2 and the Haagerup principal graph pair.

concepts.title: Haar measure on a locally compact group
concepts.description: A nonzero regular Borel measure on a locally compact group invariant under left translation,finite on compact sets; a right-invariant version is defined analogously.

concepts.title: Haar’s theorem for compact groups
concepts.description: Every compact Hausdorff topological group has a unique left-invariant regular Borel probability measure, and that measure is also right invariant.

concepts.title: Hahn’s simple twisted relative trace formula
concepts.description: Let G=Res_{M/F}G₀ for a quadratic or trivial extension of a number field,with commuting involutions σ,τ,θ=στ and connected G^σ. For a factorizable compact test function having local factors supported on relatively τ-elliptic and strongly relatively τ-regular elements and an F-supercuspidal factor,the weighted sum of relevant regular elliptic twisted relative orbital integrals equals the sum of twisted relative spectral traces over the cuspidal automorphic spectrum of G(A_F)¹.

concepts.title: Half-braiding
concepts.description: For an object X of a monoidal category C, a natural family of isomorphisms c_Y:X⊗Y→Y⊗X, compatible with tensor products and the unit: c_{Y⊗Z}=(id_Y⊗c_Z)∘(c_Y⊗id_Z), with associators inserted.

concepts.title: Jacobi form of half-integral weight with a multiplier
concepts.description: A holomorphic function on H×C of weight κ∈(1/2)Z and index m∈(1/2)Z_{≥0}, with a specified compatible finite-image multiplier, transforming by the metaplectic modular weight factor and exp(2πimcz²/(cτ+d)), and by exp(−2πim(r²τ+2rz)) times its multiplier under z↦z+rτ+s. At every cusp its Fourier indices obey 4mn−ℓ²≥0.

concepts.title: Modular form of half-integral weight with a multiplier
concepts.description: For κ∈(1/2)Z, a holomorphic function on the upper half-plane satisfying f(γτ)=χ(γ,φ)φ(τ)^(2κ)f(τ) on the metaplectic preimage of a congruence subgroup, for a fixed compatible finite-image character χ, and holomorphic at every cusp. The multiplier is specified as part of the data.

concepts.title: Halting set for total variation mixing
concepts.description: For a Markov chain with specified initial distribution, a set A is halting for total variation if d_TV(Law(X_t),π)≤P(T_A>t) for every t≥0.

concepts.title: Hardy space H∞ on the unit disk
concepts.description: The bounded holomorphic functions on the unit disk, with the supremum norm.

concepts.title: Hardy space H² on the unit disk
concepts.description: The holomorphic functions f(z)=∑ₙ≥0aₙzⁿ on the unit disk with ∑|aₙ|²<∞, normed by (∑|aₙ|²)¹ᐟ²; boundary values identify it with the nonnegative-frequency subspace of L² of the unit circle.

concepts.title: Boundary norm formula for Hardy H∞
concepts.description: For bounded holomorphic f on the disk, its radial boundary function f* exists almost everywhere and sup_D|f|=ess sup_T|f*|.

concepts.title: Hardy–Littlewood maximal function
concepts.description: For locally integrable f on ℝⁿ, Mf(x)=sup_{r>0}|B(x,r)|⁻¹∫_{B(x,r)}|f(y)|dy.

concepts.title: Hardy–Littlewood asymptotic formula in Waring’s problem
concepts.description: For every k≥2 and all sufficiently large fixed s, the number R_{s,k}(n) of ordered representations of n as s positive kth powers is asymptotic to Γ(1+1/k)^s·S_{s,k}(n)·n^(s/k−1)/Γ(s/k). The singular series is ∑_{q≥1}∑_{(a,q)=1}(q⁻¹∑_{r=1}^q exp(2πiar^k/q))^s exp(−2πian/q), and is bounded below by a positive constant uniformly in n when s is sufficiently large.

concepts.title: Hardy–Littlewood weak (1,1) maximal inequality
concepts.description: For integrable f on ℝⁿ and λ>0, the Lebesgue measure of {Mf>λ} is at most C_n∥f∥₁/λ, with a constant depending only on n.

concepts.title: Logarithmic boundary integrability of nonzero Hardy H² functions
concepts.description: A nonzero f∈H² has log|f*|∈L¹ on the unit circle, and log|f(0)|≤∫log|f*|dm when f(0)≠0, with m probability-normalized arc measure.

concepts.title: Harish–Chandra subgroup of adelic points
concepts.description: The subgroup G(A_F)¹ of points x satisfying∣χ(x)∣_A=1 for every F-rational algebraic character χ:G→G_m; equivalently the kernel of the logarithmic Harish–Chandra map.

concepts.title: Harmonic function on a plane domain
concepts.description: A twice continuously differentiable real function u on an open Ω⊂ℝ² satisfying ∂₁²u+∂₂²u=0.

concepts.title: Harnack convergence theorem for monotone harmonic functions
concepts.description: An increasing sequence of positive harmonic functions on a connected domain either tends to∞ everywhere or converges uniformly on compact subsets to a harmonic function. A decreasing sequence bounded below by a harmonic function has a harmonic limit if finite at one point.

concepts.title: Continuity of mixed volume under Hausdorff convergence
concepts.description: If each sequence K_{i,j} of convex bodies converges in Hausdorff distance to K_i, then V(K_{1,j},…,K_{n,j})→V(K₁,…,K_n).

concepts.title: Continuity of projection volume under Hausdorff convergence
concepts.description: For a fixed linear subspace E, Hausdorff convergence of convex bodies K_j to K implies convergence of the Euclidean volumes of K_j|E to that of K|E.

concepts.title: Hausdorff distance between compact sets
concepts.description: For nonempty compact sets A,B in a metric space, d_H(A,B) is the maximum of sup_{a∈A}inf_{b∈B}d(a,b) and sup_{b∈B}inf_{a∈A}d(a,b).

concepts.title: Hausdorff measure of a metric space
concepts.description: For s≥0, the s-dimensional Hausdorff measure is the limit as δ↓0 of the infimum of normalized sums of diameters^s over countable covers by sets of diameter at most δ.

concepts.title: Hausdorff topological space
concepts.description: A topological space in which any two distinct points have disjoint open neighbourhoods.

concepts.title: Heilmann–Lieb real-rootedness theorem for matching polynomials
concepts.description: For a finite graph with nonnegative edge weights, the matching polynomial μ_G(x)=∑_D(−1)^{|D|}(∏_{e∈D}w_e)x^{|V|−2|D|} has only real zeros. Equivalently the monomer-activity partition polynomial with positive dimer activities has its zeros on the imaginary axis.

concepts.title: Heine–Cantor theorem
concepts.description: A continuous map from a compact metric space into a metric space is uniformly continuous.

concepts.title: Diffeomorphic approximation of planar W¹,¹ homeomorphisms
concepts.description: For an open Ω⊆ℝ², every homeomorphism f∈W¹,¹(Ω,ℝ²) admits smooth diffeomorphisms and locally finitely piecewise affine homeomorphisms arbitrarily close both uniformly and in W¹,¹. If f extends continuously to ∂Ω, approximants can have the same boundary values.

concepts.title: Hereditarily indecomposable Banach space
concepts.description: An infinite-dimensional Banach space in which no infinite-dimensional closed subspace is a topological direct sum of two infinite-dimensional closed subspaces.

concepts.title: Hermitian angle between nonzero complex vectors
concepts.description: For nonzero vectors x,y in a complex inner-product space, their Hermitian angle is the unique θ∈[0,π/2] with cos θ=|⟨x,y⟩|/(∥x∥∥y∥).

concepts.title: Hilbert bimodule over von Neumann algebras
concepts.description: An M–N Hilbert bimodule is a Hilbert space with commuting normal unital *-representations of von Neumann algebras M and Nᵒᵖ, giving left M and right N actions.

concepts.title: Hilbert C*-module
concepts.description: An inner-product C*-module complete in the norm induced by its C*-algebra-valued inner product.

concepts.title: Hilbert space structure on an operator range
concepts.description: For a bounded map A:H→K between Hilbert spaces, give Ran A the norm ∥y∥=inf{∥x∥:Ax=y}, equivalently transport the norm from (ker A)⊥ through A. This norm can differ from the ambient K norm.

concepts.title: Hilbert-valued Q-Wiener process
concepts.description: A continuous Hilbert-space-valued process with independent Gaussian increments, mean zero and covariance (t−s)Q, where Q is nonnegative self-adjoint and trace class. An eigenbasis expansion is ∑_k√q_kβ_k(t)e_k with ∑_kq_k<∞.

concepts.title: Hilbert–Waring theorem
concepts.description: For every positive integer k, the Waring number g(k) is finite.

concepts.title: Hille–Yosida theorem for contraction semigroups
concepts.description: A densely defined operator A on a Banach space generates a strongly continuous contraction semigroup exactly when it is closed, every λ>0 belongs to its resolvent, and ‖(λI−A)^{-n}‖≤λ^{-n} for every integer n≥1. Its resolvent is the Laplace transform∫₀∞e^{-λt}T_tdt.

concepts.title: Hitting time of a set for a Markov chain
concepts.description: For A in the state space, T_A=inf{t≥0:X_t∈A}, with infinity if A is never visited. The starting state or initial law is specified separately.

concepts.title: Hoeffding’s lemma
concepts.description: If a≤X≤b almost surely and EX=0, then Eexp(tX)≤exp(t²(b−a)²/8) for every real t.

concepts.title: Hölder’s inequality
concepts.description: For measurable functions f_i and exponents p_i∈[1,∞] with ∑_i1/p_i=1, ∫|∏_if_i|dμ≤∏_i‖f_i‖_{p_i}.

concepts.title: Hölder inequality in variable-exponent Lebesgue spaces
concepts.description: For measurable p with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and 1/p(x)+1/p′(x)=1, ∫|fg|≤2∥f∥_{p(·)}∥g∥_{p′(·)}.

concepts.title: Holomorphy of a modular form at a cusp
concepts.description: After applying the weight-k slash action by a matrix sending a cusp to infinity, the resulting periodic function has a Fourier expansion in q_h=exp(2πiτ/h) with no negative powers, where h is the cusp width.

concepts.title: Holomorphic function of one complex variable
concepts.description: A function on an open subset of ℂ is holomorphic if its complex derivative exists at every point of that subset.

concepts.title: Holomorphic function of several complex variables
concepts.description: A complex function on an open subset of C^n that is locally representable by a convergent power series in the n complex coordinates. Vector-valued holomorphy for a finite-dimensional target means holomorphy of its coordinates in any basis.

concepts.title: Riesz–Dunford holomorphic functional calculus
concepts.description: For a bounded operator T on a complex Banach space and f holomorphic near σ(T), define f(T)=(2πi)⁻¹∮Γ f(z)(zI−T)⁻¹ dz, where Γ encloses σ(T) inside that neighborhood.

concepts.title: Continuity of holomorphic functional calculus under compact uniform convergence
concepts.description: If f_n→f uniformly on compact subsets of a common neighborhood of σ(T), for a bounded Banach-space operator T, then f_n(T)→f(T) in operator norm.

concepts.title: Algebra homomorphism property of holomorphic functional calculus
concepts.description: For a bounded operator T, evaluation f↦f(T) is a unital algebra homomorphism from functions holomorphic on a common neighborhood of σ(T) into bounded operators; it agrees with polynomial evaluation.

concepts.title: Spectral mapping theorem for holomorphic functional calculus
concepts.description: If f is holomorphic near the spectrum of a bounded operator T, then σ(f(T))=f(σ(T)).

concepts.title: Homeomorphism
concepts.description: A bijection between topological spaces that is continuous and has a continuous inverse.

concepts.title: Homogeneous real polynomial
concepts.description: A real polynomial in finitely many variables whose nonzero monomials all have the same total degree.

concepts.title: Homogeneous set for a subset coloring
concepts.description: H⊆X is homogeneous for c if c is constant on the r-element subsets of H.

concepts.title: Hopf algebra
concepts.description: A unital associative algebra H with coassociative coproduct Δ:H→H⊗H and counit ε:H→k that are algebra homomorphisms, and an antipode S satisfying m(S⊗id)Δ=m(id⊗S)Δ=ηε, where m and η are multiplication and unit.

concepts.title: Hopf ideal of a commutative Hopf algebra
concepts.description: An ideal I of a commutative Hopf algebra H satisfying Δ(I)⊂I⊗H+H⊗I, ε(I)=0 and S(I)⊂I, so the quotient inherits the Hopf operations.

concepts.title: Hörmander smooth-density theorem for diffusions
concepts.description: For bounded smooth Stratonovich diffusion fields satisfying the parabolic Hörmander bracket condition, the transition law at positive time has a smooth density with respect to Lebesgue measure. A full-rank invariant open region may be used in place of the whole Euclidean space.

concepts.title: Householder reflection
concepts.description: For a nonzero real vector v, the orthogonal reflection H=I−2vvᵀ/(vᵀv) fixes the hyperplane perpendicular to v and negates v. Applying H to a vector uses O(n) arithmetic operations.

concepts.title: Householder completion preserving leading orthogonal columns
concepts.description: Given the first k orthonormal columns of an n×n orthogonal transform, successive Householder transformations on trailing coordinates yield an orthogonal matrix with exactly these columns. Applying its k factors costs O(nk), while the ANOVA variance attributed to the first k transformed Gaussian coordinates agrees with that of any orthogonal completion of those columns.

concepts.title: Humbert surface in the genus-two Siegel modular variety
concepts.description: The image in Sp₄(Z)∖H₂ of the quadratic divisor a z₁+b z₂+c z₃+d(z₂²−z₁z₃)+e=0 with primitive integer coefficients and positive discriminant D=b²−4ac−4de; all such divisors of discriminant D give the Humbert surface H_D.

concepts.title: Hyperfinite von Neumann algebra
concepts.description: A von Neumann algebra that is the weak closure of an increasing union of finite-dimensional *-subalgebras.

concepts.title: Hypergraph-correlated random variables
concepts.description: For a finite hypergraph (V,E), an E-indexed family Y_e is hypergraph-correlated if independent underlying variables X_v exist with each Y_e a measurable function only of (X_v)_{v∈e}.

concepts.title: Reflection in a linear hyperplane in Euclidean space
concepts.description: For a unit vector u, reflection in u⊥ is R_u(x)=x−2(x·u)u.

concepts.title: Hyperplane trace operator for a function space
concepts.description: The restriction map f(x₁,…,x_n)↦f(x₁,…,x_{n−1},0), initially on smooth functions; a trace on a larger function space is a continuous extension of this map when such an extension exists.

concepts.title: Hyperspecial maximal compact subgroup
concepts.description: For a reductive group over a nonarchimedean local field,a subgroup given by the valuation-ring points of a smooth affine integral group scheme whose special fiber is connected reductive.

concepts.title: Idele group of a number field
concepts.description: The restricted product ∏′_v F_v× with respect to O_v× at finite places. As a group it is the unit group of the adele ring, but its restricted-product topology is specified independently rather than taken as the subspace topology from A_F.

concepts.title: Idelic norm
concepts.description: For an idele a=(a_v), |a|_A=∏_v|a_v|_v using the normalized local multiplicative norms; almost all factors are1. This is a continuous homomorphism A_F×→R_{>0}.

concepts.title: Idempotent element of an algebra
concepts.description: An element e satisfying e²=e.

concepts.title: Idempotent endomorphism
concepts.description: An endomorphism e:X→X satisfying e∘e=e.

concepts.title: Splitting of an idempotent endomorphism
concepts.description: Maps r:X→Y and i:Y→X with ir=e and ri=id_Y exhibit Y as the image of the idempotent e.

concepts.title: Identically distributed random variables
concepts.description: A family is identically distributed when all its random variables have the same distribution.

concepts.title: Identity theorem for holomorphic functions
concepts.description: Two holomorphic functions on a connected complex domain that agree on a set with an accumulation point inside the domain agree everywhere.

concepts.title: Humbert divisors of the Igusa cusp forms
concepts.description: On the genus-two Siegel modular variety, the weight-five even-theta product has simple divisor H₁, and the weight35 Igusa cusp form has divisor H₁+H₄ with multiplicity one on both Humbert surfaces.

concepts.title: Igusa’s generators for genus-two Siegel modular forms
concepts.description: The complex graded ring of full-group genus-two scalar Siegel modular forms is generated by E₄,E₆,χ₁₀,χ₁₂,χ₃₅, with χ₃₅² a polynomial in the first four. Over Z its even-weight subring has Igusa’s fourteen integral generators, and every integral odd-weight form is χ₃₅ times an integral even-weight form.

concepts.title: Type II₁ factor
concepts.description: An infinite-dimensional von Neumann algebra with center ℂ1 admitting a faithful normal tracial state.

concepts.title: II₁ subfactor
concepts.description: An inclusion N⊂M of von Neumann factors of type II₁.

concepts.title: Image of a linear map
concepts.description: For a linear map f:V→W, its image is the subspace {f(v):v∈V} of W.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Coexistence curve and critical point of the imitative monomer–dimer model
concepts.description: For the variational function in the pressure theorem, there is a critical endpoint m_c=2−√2,J_c=(3+2√2)/4,h_c=½log(2√2−2)−¼. A coexistence curve h=γ(J),J>J_c, has exactly two distinct nondegenerate global maximizers. Off that curve the global maximizer is unique; at the endpoint its second and third derivatives vanish and fourth derivative is negative. Away from the curve and endpoint it is nondegenerate.

concepts.title: Monomer-density limit and phase coexistence in the imitative monomer–dimer model
concepts.description: In the complete-graph imitative monomer–dimer model define g(z)=eᶻ(√(e²ᶻ+4)−eᶻ)/2, p₀(z)=−(1−g(z))/2−½log(1−g(z)), and F(m)=−Jm²+p₀((2m−1)J+h). If F has a unique global maximizer m*, then S_N/N converges in distribution to m*. On the coexistence curve, where its two nondegenerate global maxima are m₁<m₂, the limit is ρ₁δ_{m₁}+ρ₂δ_{m₂}, with ρ_l proportional to [−F″(m_l)(2−m_l)]⁻¹ᐟ².

concepts.title: Gaussian and quartic monomer-count fluctuations in the imitative monomer–dimer model
concepts.description: For the complete-graph imitative monomer–dimer model with J>0, let F and its unique maximizer m* be as in the density-limit theorem. Away from coexistence and the critical endpoint, (S_N−Nm*)/√N converges to N(0,−1/F″(m*)−1/(2J)). At the critical endpoint, F″=F‴=0,F⁽⁴⁾<0 and (S_N−Nm*)/N³ᐟ⁴ converges to the density proportional to exp(F⁽⁴⁾(m*)x⁴/24). For J=0 the Gaussian limit has mean-density g(h) and variance g′(h).

concepts.title: Variational pressure theorem for the imitative monomer–dimer model
concepts.description: For complete-graph imitative monomer–dimer parameters h∈ℝ,J≥0, let g(z)=eᶻ(√(e²ᶻ+4)−eᶻ)/2 and p₀(z)=−(1−g(z))/2−½log(1−g(z)). Then lim_NN⁻¹logZ_N=max_{m∈[0,1]}{−Jm²+p₀(h+(2m−1)J)}.

concepts.title: Imitative monomer–dimer model on the complete graph
concepts.description: On matchings D of K_N, let S(D)=N−2|D| be the monomer count. With external field h∈ℝ and coupling J≥0, assign D probability proportional to N^{−|D|}exp((h−J)S(D)+JS(D)²/N). This is the complete-graph monomer–dimer model with attractive imitative interaction.

concepts.title: Independence system
concepts.description: A finite set V and a nonempty family I of subsets of V closed under taking subsets.

concepts.title: Independent family of random variables
concepts.description: For distinct i₁,…,iₖ and Borel A₁,…,Aₖ, independence requires P(⋂ⱼ{Xᵢⱼ∈Aⱼ})=∏ⱼP(Xᵢⱼ∈Aⱼ).

concepts.title: Independent set in a graph
concepts.description: A set of vertices in a graph containing no edge.

concepts.title: Independent set in a hypergraph
concepts.description: A set of vertices containing no hyperedge.

concepts.title: Independent σ-algebras
concepts.description: A family of sub-σ-algebras is independent if the probability of the intersection of events from any finite subfamily equals the product of their probabilities.

concepts.title: Indicator function of a subset
concepts.description: For A⊆Ω, the real function 1_A is 1 on A and 0 on its complement.

concepts.title: Induced Riemannian metric of an embedded surface
concepts.description: An embedded smooth surface inherits the Euclidean inner product on each tangent plane; in a chart m its metric matrix is g_{ij}=∂ᵢm·∂ⱼm.

concepts.title: Inertia group at a prime of a Galois extension
concepts.description: The subgroup I_w of the decomposition group consisting of automorphisms acting trivially on the residue field at w.

concepts.title: Infinite product of complex numbers or functions
concepts.description: The limit of the finite partial products ∏_{j=1}^N a_j as N→∞, when it exists; for functions the mode of convergence is specified, such as locally uniform convergence on the stated domain. Formal products mean stabilization of each coefficient instead of analytic convergence.

concepts.title: Z(g)-finite smooth function on a Lie group
concepts.description: A smooth complex function f on a real Lie group is Z(g)-finite when the span of zf, for z in the center of U(g⊗_R C), is finite-dimensional. The action differentiates right translations and extends to the enveloping algebra.

concepts.title: Injective function
concepts.description: A function f is injective if f(x)=f(y) implies x=y for all points of its domain.

concepts.title: Inner function on the unit disk
concepts.description: A bounded holomorphic function on the unit disk whose radial boundary values have modulus one almost everywhere on the unit circle.

concepts.title: Inner–outer factorization in Hardy H²
concepts.description: Every nonzero H² function is the product of an inner function and an outer H² function; the factors are unique up to opposite unimodular constants.

concepts.title: Inner-product C*-module
concepts.description: A semi-inner-product C*-module with ⟨x,x⟩=0 only for x=0. Its norm is ∥x∥=∥⟨x,x⟩∥¹ᐟ²; completeness is not assumed.

concepts.title: Integer
concepts.description: An integer is an element of the ordered ring ℤ, obtained by adjoining additive inverses to the natural numbers.

concepts.title: Divisibility of integers
concepts.description: An integer a divides b if b=ac for some integer c.

concepts.title: Integer polynomial
concepts.description: An integer polynomial is a real polynomial all of whose coefficients lie in ℤ.

concepts.title: Integral basis of a number field
concepts.description: A finite Z-module basis of the ring of integers O_F: every algebraic integer in F is a unique integer linear combination of the basis elements.

concepts.title: Element integral over a commutative ring
concepts.description: For a ring inclusion R⊂A, an element a∈A is integral over R if it satisfies a monic polynomial with coefficients in R.

concepts.title: Integral Heisenberg group for scalar-index Jacobi forms
concepts.description: For λ,μ in Z^g and κ in Z, use the triples (λ,μ,κ) with product (λ+λ′,μ+μ′,κ+κ′+λ·μ′−μ·λ′). The dot products are the finite coordinate sums; this specifies the integral normalization used in the scalar-index Jacobi slash action.

concepts.title: Integral Jacobi group
concepts.description: The semidirect product of Sp(2g,Z) with the integral Heisenberg group, where the symplectic factor acts on the λ,μ coordinates and fixes the center; its action on H_g×C^g is the one used in Jacobi modular and elliptic transformation laws.

concepts.title: Integral Miller basis for full-group elliptic modular forms
concepts.description: For each integral weight k, M_k(SL₂(Z)) has a basis f_j=q^j+O(q^d), 0≤j<d, with integer Fourier coefficients, where d=dim_C M_k. For even k≥0, d≤floor(k/12)+1; spaces of odd weight and weight2 are zero.

concepts.title: Monotonicity of the Lebesgue integral
concepts.description: If 0≤f≤g are measurable functions on a measure space, then ∫f dμ≤∫g dμ, allowing infinite integrals.

concepts.title: Kernel of an integral operator
concepts.description: For a measure space, a measurable function K(x,y) representing an operator by (Tf)(x)=∫K(x,y)f(y)dμ(y), on the specified class of functions where the expression is defined. A square-integrable kernel is an element of L² of the product measure space.

concepts.title: Integrated operator of a unitary representation
concepts.description: For f∈L¹(G), the bounded operator π(f) determined weakly by ⟨π(f)v,w⟩=∫_G f(g)⟨π(g)v,w⟩dg. This uses a fixed Haar measure and a unitary representation of a locally compact group.

concepts.title: Integration by parts for C¹ real functions
concepts.description: For u,v∈C¹([a,b]), ∫ₐᵇuv′=u(b)v(b)−u(a)v(a)−∫ₐᵇu′v.

concepts.title: Integration by parts for real integrals
concepts.description: For continuously differentiable u,v on [a,b], ∫_a^buv′=[uv]_a^b−∫_a^bu′v; improper variants follow when boundary terms and integrals converge.

concepts.title: Interior of a subset of a topological space
concepts.description: The interior of A is the union of all open subsets contained in A.

concepts.title: Interlacing of real-rooted polynomials
concepts.description: The real zeros of degree-n and degree-(n−1) real-rooted polynomials interlace if, when listed with multiplicity, α₁≤β₁≤α₂≤⋯≤β_{n−1}≤α_n.

concepts.title: Interlacing and positive partial fractions
concepts.description: If p,q are monic real polynomials of degrees d,d−1 with real roots weakly interlacing, then after cancellation q/p has only simple real poles and a partial-fraction expansion∑_jc_j/(z−r_j), with c_j≥0. A denominator root of multiplicity m cancels at least m−1 times. Conversely such a ratio gives weak interlacing after reinserting common real factors.

concepts.title: Intermediate value theorem for real functions
concepts.description: A continuous real function on an interval takes every value between any two of its values.

concepts.title: Internal Hom in a module category
concepts.description: For objects M,N of a module category over C, an internal Hom is an object [M,N] of C with natural bijections Hom_C(X,[M,N])≅Hom_M(X⊗M,N). It exists in the finite semisimple setting used here.

concepts.title: Intersection body of a star body
concepts.description: The star body IK with radial function ρ_IK(u) equal to the (d−1)-dimensional volume of K∩u⊥.

concepts.title: Intersection of a family of sets
concepts.description: Inside a specified ambient set, the elements belonging to every member of the family.

concepts.title: Intertwiner of algebra representations
concepts.description: A linear map T between modules over an algebra A such that T(av)=aT(v) for every a∈A and v in the source module.

concepts.title: Intrinsic ultracontractivity of a symmetric killed semigroup
concepts.description: A symmetric killed semigroup with positive ground state φ is intrinsically ultracontractive if for every t>0 its transition density satisfies p_t(x,y)≤C_tφ(x)φ(y) almost everywhere for a finite C_t. Equivalently its ground-state-transformed semigroup maps L²(φ²dx) boundedly to L∞.

concepts.title: Intrinsic ultracontractivity on bounded Lipschitz domains
concepts.description: The killed symmetric uniformly elliptic diffusion semigroup on a bounded connected Lipschitz domain with smooth coefficients is intrinsically ultracontractive: for each t>0 its kernel satisfies p_t(x,y)≤C_tφ₁(x)φ₁(y).

concepts.title: Invariant gauge form on a smooth affine algebraic group
concepts.description: A nowhere-zero left-invariant algebraic differential form ω of degree d=dim_F Lie(G): in coordinates it is an element of Λ^d Ω_(O(G)/F) whose value at every geometric point is nonzero. It is defined over F, and its invariant choices differ by F×.

concepts.title: Invariant random probability measure for a random dynamical system
concepts.description: A probability kernel ω↦π_ω on the state space satisfying (φ_t(ω,·))_*π_ω=π_{θ_tω} almost surely for each t. Equivalently P(dω)π_ω(dx) is invariant under the skew-product evolution.

concepts.title: Inverse function theorem in Euclidean space
concepts.description: A continuously differentiable map between open subsets of ℝⁿ whose derivative is invertible at a point restricts near that point to a C¹ diffeomorphism. A C^k or smooth map has an inverse of the same regularity.

concepts.title: Fixed-point parity lemma for finite involutions
concepts.description: If f is an involution of a finite set X, then X and Fix(f) have the same cardinality modulo two.

concepts.title: IP-set of positive integers
concepts.description: A subset of ℕ₊ is an IP-set if it contains FS(xᵢ) for some infinite sequence of positive integers.

concepts.title: Irreducible finite Markov chain
concepts.description: A finite Markov chain is irreducible if for any states x,y some number of steps n has Pⁿ(x,y)>0.

concepts.title: Irreducible nonnegative matrix
concepts.description: A finite square nonnegative real matrix A is irreducible if for every pair i,j some n≥0 satisfies (Aⁿ)_{ij}>0. Equivalently its directed support graph is strongly connected.

concepts.title: Irreducible polynomial
concepts.description: A nonzero nonunit polynomial over a specified coefficient ring that cannot be written as a product of two nonunits. Over a field, both factors would have smaller positive degree.

concepts.title: Irreducible unitary representation
concepts.description: A nonzero unitary representation with no closed invariant complex linear subspace other than0 and the whole Hilbert space.

concepts.title: Regression-based Householder transform for Gaussian quadrature
