concepts.description: For square-integrable f under standard normal input X, compute a=E[Xf(X)] and reflect e₁ onto a/‖a‖, using identity if a=0 or the directions already agree. Then the fitted linear part of f(UX) is ‖a‖X₁, capturing variance ‖a‖². For f=g∘h the direction may instead use E[Xh(X)]; sequential residual-coordinate reflections accommodate several intermediate functions. Applying k reflections costs O(nk), excluding direction computation.

concepts.title: Ising model on a finite graph
concepts.description: Spins σ_v∈{−1,+1} receive Gibbs weight exp(β∑_{uv∈E}J_{uv}σ_uσ_v+∑_vh_vσ_v), for specified couplings and external fields.

concepts.title: Isomorphism in a category
concepts.description: A morphism f:X→Y having an inverse g:Y→X, so gf=id_X and fg=id_Y.

concepts.title: Isotropic symmetric α-stable Lévy process
concepts.description: For 0<α≤2, the Euclidean Lévy process whose characteristic function is Eexp(iξ·X_t)=exp(−t|ξ|ᵅ), up to a specified positive time-scaling constant.

concepts.title: Iteration of a self-map
concepts.description: For f:X→X, define f⁰=id_X and f^{n+1}=f∘fⁿ for natural n.

concepts.title: Itô stochastic differential equation driven by Brownian motion
concepts.description: An adapted continuous process X solves dX_t=b(X_t)dt+σ(X_t)dB_t if it satisfies X_t=X₀+∫₀ᵗb(X_s)ds+∫₀ᵗσ(X_s)dB_s almost surely.

concepts.title: Itô’s formula for Brownian diffusions
concepts.description: If X solves dX=b dt+σ dB and f is C¹ in time and C² in space, then df(t,X_t)=(∂_tf+b·∇f+½tr(σσᵀD²f))dt+∇f·σdB, with the usual localization hypotheses.

concepts.title: Itô integral with respect to Brownian motion
concepts.description: For an adapted process H with E∫₀ᵀ|H_s|²ds<∞, ∫H_s dB_s is the L² limit of left-endpoint adapted step-process sums. Localization extends the definition to locally square-integrable integrands.

concepts.title: Itô isometry for Brownian integrals
concepts.description: For a predictable Brownian integrand H with E∫₀ᵀ|H_s|²ds<∞, E|∫₀ᵀH_s dB_s|²=E∫₀ᵀ|H_s|²ds, and the integral has mean zero.

concepts.title: Jackson approximation theorem on the sphere
concepts.description: For a λ-Lipschitz real function f on S^{n−1} and positive integer k, a real polynomial P of degree at most k satisfies sup_{S^{n−1}}|f−P|≤Cλn/k for an absolute C.

concepts.title: Jacobi form of Siegel degree g
concepts.description: A holomorphic function φ(τ,z) on ℍ_g×ℂ^g with the weight-k, index-m transformation laws under the integral Jacobi group, whose Fourier coefficients c(T,R) vanish unless 4mT−RRᵀ is positive semidefinite.

concepts.title: Jacobi theta function with characteristics
concepts.description: For fixed real a,b, θ[a,b](τ,z)=∑_{n∈Z}exp(πi(n+a)²τ+2πi(n+a)(z+b)), with Im(τ)>0. The three even half-characteristics (1/2,0),(0,0),(0,1/2) give the standard θ₂,θ₃,θ₄ conventions.

concepts.title: Jacobi theta function
concepts.description: The holomorphic series θ(τ,z)=∑_{n∈ℤ}exp(πin²τ+2πinz) for Im(τ)>0; this specifies the zero-characteristic theta convention.

concepts.title: Specialization of a Jacobi form at torsion points
concepts.description: Evaluate a Jacobi form after its Jacobi-group slash action at z=0 with rational translation parameters; collecting the N-torsion evaluations gives a vector-valued modular form.

concepts.title: Jacobian matrix of a differentiable Euclidean map
concepts.description: For f:ℝⁿ→ℝᵐ, its Jacobian matrix at a point has entries ∂f_i/∂x_j. For m=n its determinant is the Jacobian determinant.

concepts.title: Janson’s Hoeffding bound for dependency graphs
concepts.description: If n random variables Y_v∈[0,1] have dependency graph G and q=n⁻¹∑_vEY_v, then P(∑_vY_v≥n(q+ε))≤exp(−2nε²/χ_f(G)) for ε>0.

concepts.title: Jensen’s inequality for expectations
concepts.description: For an integrable real random variable X and convex φ with E|φ(X)|<∞, φ(EX)≤Eφ(X), when φ is defined on an interval containing the range of X.

concepts.title: Jones index
concepts.description: For a II₁ subfactor N⊂M, its index [M:N] is the von Neumann dimension of L²(M) as an N-module, possibly infinite.

concepts.title: Jones–Wenzl idempotent
concepts.description: The idempotent fₙ in TLₙ(δ) with identity-diagram coefficient 1 and eᵢfₙ=fₙeᵢ=0 for every adjacent cap–cup generator. It exists for all n at generic δ; special parameters require care.

concepts.title: Jordan curve theorem
concepts.description: A simple closed curve in the plane separates the plane into exactly two connected components, one bounded and one unbounded, and is the boundary of both.

concepts.title: Jordan normal form theorem
concepts.description: Every linear endomorphism of a finite-dimensional complex vector space has a basis consisting of Jordan chains for its eigenvalues; its matrix in that basis is block diagonal with Jordan blocks.

concepts.title: K-finite function under right translation
concepts.description: For a subgroup K of G, a complex function f on G is K-finite if the functions x↦f(xk), k∈K, span a finite-dimensional complex vector space. In automorphic applications K is compact.

concepts.title: k-wise independent random variables
concepts.description: A family of random variables is k-wise independent if every subfamily of at most k members is jointly independent.

concepts.title: Kähler differentials of an algebra
concepts.description: For a commutative F-algebra A, the A-module Ω_(A/F) generated by symbols da, a∈A, subject to additivity, F-linearity and d(ab)=a·db+b·da.

concepts.title: Karoubi envelope of a category
concepts.description: The category obtained by formally splitting idempotent endomorphisms. Its objects are pairs (X,e) with e²=e; a map (X,e)→(Y,f) is a map a:X→Y with a=fae.

concepts.title: Kernel of a linear map
concepts.description: For a linear map f:V→W, its kernel is the subspace {v∈V:f(v)=0}.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Kikuta–Takemori’s sharp genus-two Sturm bound
concepts.description: Let f be a scalar full-group degree-two Siegel modular form of weight k≥0 with coefficients in O_{K,𝔭}. Put b_k=⌊k/10⌋ for even k and ⌊(k−5)/10⌋ for odd k. If the coefficients indexed by T=(m,r/2;r/2,n)≥0 with m,n≤b_k vanish modulo 𝔭^ν, then all coefficients do, for every prime ideal 𝔭 and ν≥1. This bound is optimal whenever the weight-k space is nonzero.

concepts.title: Markov process killed on leaving a domain
concepts.description: Run a Markov process until its first exit time τ_D from a specified domain and then send it to an absorbing cemetery state. Its sub-Markov semigroup is P_tᴰf(x)=E_x[f(X_t)1_{t<τ_D}].

concepts.title: Killed transition matrix of a finite Markov chain
concepts.description: For a set A, retain the submatrix P_{Aᶜ,Aᶜ}; missing row mass records killing when the chain enters A. Its powers give survival transition probabilities before hitting A.

concepts.title: Klartag’s linear-size isomorphic Minkowski symmetrization theorem
concepts.description: For n≥2 and a convex body K⊂ℝⁿ, at most 5n Minkowski symmetrizations produce a centrally symmetric body K̃ with (1−c|log log n|/√log n)M*(K)B₂ⁿ⊆K̃⊆(1+c|log log n|/√log n)M*(K)B₂ⁿ, for an absolute c. In particular its outer radius is at most an absolute multiple of M*(K).

concepts.title: Klartag’s quantitative Minkowski symmetrization theorem
concepts.description: For n≥2, 0<ε<1/2 and a nonempty compact convex set K⊂ℝⁿ with M*(K)=M₀, at most cn|log ε| Minkowski symmetrizations produce K̃ with (1−ε)M₀B₂ⁿ⊆K̃⊆(1+ε)M₀B₂ⁿ, for a universal c.

concepts.title: Esther Klein's five-point theorem
concepts.description: Every set of five planar points in general position contains four points in convex position.

concepts.title: Kneser’s addition theorem for finite sumsets
concepts.description: For finite nonempty subsets A,B of an abelian group, |A+B|≥|A|+|B|−|H(A+B)|, where H(A+B) is the translation stabilizer of the sumset.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Koecher’s principle for Siegel modular forms
concepts.description: In genus g≥2, a holomorphic function on H_g obeying a Siegel modular transformation law for an arithmetic congruence group has the usual nonnegative cusp Fourier support, without an additional growth hypothesis.

concepts.title: Kolmogorov's maximal inequality
concepts.description: If X₁,…,Xₙ are independent with EXᵢ=0 and EXᵢ²<∞, then for λ>0, P(max₁≤ₖ≤ₙ abs(∑ᵢ≤ₖXᵢ)≥λ)≤(∑ᵢ≤ₙVar(Xᵢ))/λ².

concepts.title: Kolmogorov's strong law for iid real random variables
concepts.description: If (Xₙ) is jointly independent and identically distributed with E abs(X₁)<∞, then (X₁+···+Xₙ)/n→EX₁ almost surely.

concepts.title: König's infinity lemma
concepts.description: Every infinite rooted finitely branching tree has an infinite simple path starting at its root.

concepts.title: Kővári–Sós–Turán theorem
concepts.description: For fixed integers s,t≥2, every n-vertex simple graph containing no K_{s,t} subgraph has O_{s,t}(n^(2−1/s)) edges. The paper uses the balanced case s=t.

concepts.title: Kronecker’s prime-difference conjecture
concepts.description: Every positive even integer occurs infinitely often as a difference of two primes.

concepts.title: Kronecker symbol with denominator2
concepts.description: For an integer a, (a/2)=0 if a is even, and (a/2)=(−1)^((a²−1)/8) if a is odd; equivalently it is 1 for a≡±1 modulo8 and −1 for a≡±3 modulo8.

concepts.title: Krull topology on an infinite Galois group
concepts.description: On Gal(L/F), the subgroup fixing each finite intermediate extension E/F is an open neighbourhood of the identity; their cosets form a basis. For an absolute Galois group take L=F^sep.

concepts.title: L²-space on an automorphic quotient
concepts.description: Complex square-integrable functions modulo almost-everywhere equality on Γ∖G, for a discrete subgroup Γ of a unimodular locally compact group G and the quotient Haar measure; the inner product is ∫_(Γ∖G)f·conj(h).

concepts.title: Lang–Steinberg theorem
concepts.description: For a smooth connected affine algebraic group over a finite field with Frobenius F, the map x↦x⁻¹F(x) is surjective over an algebraic closure; equivalently its first Galois cohomology is trivial.

concepts.title: Bochner connection Laplacian on tangent vector fields
concepts.description: The rough or connection Laplacian ∇*∇ on tangent vector fields, defined from covariant differentiation and its formal L² adjoint. In the selected surface problem it is the weak operator associated to the squared norm of the tangential covariant derivative, not the Hodge Laplacian on differential forms.

concepts.title: Laplace’s method at a nondegenerate real maximum
concepts.description: If a smooth real f has a unique interior maximum x₀ with f″(x₀)<0 and integrable exponentially negligible tails, then ∫e^{Nf(x)}dx∼e^{Nf(x₀)}√(2π/(−Nf″(x₀))). Continuous prefactors multiply the leading term by their value at x₀.

concepts.title: Laplace asymptotics for varying real integrands
concepts.description: Let ψ_n be positive on a fixed compact interval K with f_n=logψ_n and f_n,f_n″ converging uniformly there to f,f″. Suppose each f_n attains its maximum at an interior x_n, f has a unique interior maximum x₀ with f″(x₀)<0, the logarithmic supremum of |ψ_n| outside K is uniformly separated below f_n(x_n), and ∫|ψ_n| is uniformly bounded. Then ∫ψ_n(x)ⁿdx∼exp(nf_n(x_n))√(2π/(−nf″(x₀))).

concepts.title: Mei–Read-McFarland recurrence for large minimal attracted numbers
concepts.description: Fix b≥2 and e≥1. There is an explicit threshold M(b,e) such that, whenever the exact-height minima σ_h(u),σ_{h+1}(u) exist and σ_h(u) exceeds M(b,e), S_{e,b}(σ_{h+1}(u))=σ_h(u). The paper gives a threshold on the size of σ_h(u), not a uniform threshold on h.

concepts.title: Larson’s Γ₁(n) level theorem for generalized divisor sums
concepts.description: For every symmetric residue set S modulo n and k≥1, Rose’s A_{S,n,k} is a quasimodular form of mixed weight at most2k on Γ₁(n).

concepts.title: Full lattice in Euclidean space
concepts.description: A subgroup Λ⊂ℝⁿ generated overℤ by a real vector-space basis ofℝⁿ.

concepts.title: Law of total variance
concepts.description: For square-integrable X and sub-σ-algebra G, Var(X)=E[Var(X|G)]+Var(E[X|G]).

concepts.title: Lax–Milgram theorem over real Hilbert spaces
concepts.description: If a bounded bilinear form a on a real Hilbert space H is coercive, a(u,u)≥c‖u‖² for c>0, then for every bounded linear functional ℓ there is a unique u∈H with a(u,v)=ℓ(v) for all v∈H.

concepts.title: Least common multiple of integers
concepts.description: For nonzero integers a₁,…,a_r, the least positive integer divisible by every a_i.

concepts.title: Population least-squares linear regression
concepts.description: For a square-integrable response Y and real predictors X, choose coefficients a,b minimizing E(Y−aᵀX−b)². With independent standard normal predictors, b=EY and a_j=E(YX_j).

concepts.title: Least upper bound in a partially ordered set
concepts.description: For A⊆P, its least upper bound is an upper bound s satisfying s≤b for every upper bound b of A, when such an s exists.

concepts.title: Lebesgue differentiation theorem
concepts.description: Almost every point of a locally integrable function on ℝⁿ is a Lebesgue point.

concepts.title: Lebesgue integral
concepts.description: For measurable f≥0, ∫f dμ is the supremum of integrals of nonnegative simple functions below f. For signed f with ∫abs(f)dμ<∞, define ∫f=∫f⁺−∫f⁻.

concepts.title: Lebesgue measure on Euclidean space
concepts.description: The completion of the Borel measure on ℝⁿ assigning each rectangular box the product of its side lengths.

concepts.title: Lebesgue point of a locally integrable function
concepts.description: A point x is a Lebesgue point of f if the average of |f(y)−f(x)| over balls centered at x tends to zero as their radii tend to zero.

concepts.title: Lehrer–Zhang braid-generation theorem
concepts.description: For a strongly multiplicity-free irreducible representation V of a generic Drinfeld–Jimbo quantum group, the braid-group image generates End_U(V⊗n) as an algebra for every n.

concepts.title: Level of distribution of the primes
concepts.description: An exponent θ for which the average error in the prime number theorem in progressions, summed over moduli q≤x^(θ−ε), is O_A,ε(x/(log x)^A) for every A,ε>0. The precise weighted prime count and allowed modulus family must be stated when using a variant.

concepts.title: Lévy continuity theorem
concepts.description: If characteristic functions φ_n converge pointwise to a function φ continuous at zero, then φ is a characteristic function and the corresponding probability distributions converge weakly to its law. Conversely weak convergence implies pointwise characteristic-function convergence.

concepts.title: Lévy process
concepts.description: A càdlàg stochastic process starting at zero with stationary independent increments and continuity in probability, taking values in Euclidean space.

concepts.title: Lie algebra over a field
concepts.description: A vector space with a bilinear bracket [x,y] satisfying [x,x]=0 and [x,[y,z]]+[y,[z,x]]+[z,[x,y]]=0.

concepts.title: Lie algebra of an affine algebraic group
concepts.description: For a coordinate Hopf algebra A with counit ε, the F-vector space of linear maps D:A→F satisfying D(ab)=ε(a)D(b)+ε(b)D(a). Extend them to invariant derivations using the coproduct; their commutator induces the Lie bracket.

concepts.title: Lie algebra of a real Lie group
concepts.description: The real vector space of left-invariant smooth vector fields on a real Lie group, with bracket [X,Y] acting on smooth functions as X∘Y−Y∘X. It is identified with the tangent space at the identity.

concepts.title: Lie bracket of smooth vector fields
concepts.description: The vector field [V,W] characterized by [V,W]f=V(Wf)−W(Vf); in coordinates [V,W]ⁱ=∑_j(Vʲ∂_jWⁱ−Wʲ∂_jVⁱ).

concepts.title: Limit inferior of an extended-real sequence
concepts.description: For a sequence (a_n), liminf a_n=sup_N inf_{n≥N}a_n, allowing infinite endpoints.

concepts.title: Limit of a real function at a point
concepts.description: The relation lim_{x→a}f(x)=L means that for every ε>0 there is δ>0 such that 0<|x−a|<δ in the domain implies |f(x)−L|<ε.

concepts.title: k-linear category
concepts.description: A category whose morphism spaces are vector spaces over a field k and whose composition is k-bilinear. This convention does not require finite sums or a zero object.

concepts.title: Linear combination of vectors
concepts.description: A finite sum a₁v₁+⋯+aₙvₙ of vectors multiplied by scalars from their vector space’s ground field; the empty sum is zero.

concepts.title: Hou–Leung–Xiang linear Kneser theorem
concepts.description: Let L/F be a field extension in which every element algebraic over F is separable. For nonzero finite-dimensional F-subspaces S,T⊆L, dim_F(ST)≥dim_F S+dim_F T−dim_F H(ST), where H(ST) is the stabilizer field of ST.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Linear map between vector spaces
concepts.description: A map between vector spaces over the same field preserving addition and scalar multiplication.

concepts.title: Linear span of a set of vectors
concepts.description: The subspace consisting of all finite linear combinations of a specified set of vectors.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Linearity of the Lebesgue integral
concepts.description: If f and g are integrable real functions and a,b are real scalars, then af+bg is integrable and ∫(af+bg)dμ=a∫f dμ+b∫g dμ.

concepts.title: Linearly independent family of vectors
concepts.description: A family of vectors is linearly independent if every finite linear combination equalling zero has all coefficients zero.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Lipschitz domain in Euclidean space
concepts.description: An open connected Euclidean set whose boundary is locally the graph of a Lipschitz function, with the domain locally on one side.

concepts.title: Lipschitz map between metric spaces
concepts.description: A map f:(X,d)→(Y,e) is Lipschitz if e(f(x),f(y))≤L d(x,y) for one finite constant L and all x,y∈X.

concepts.title: Little o notation
concepts.description: The assertion f=o(g) along a specified limit means f(x)/g(x)→0, where g is nonzero near that limit. Sequences are the instance x=n→∞.

concepts.title: Local field
concepts.description: A nondiscrete locally compact Hausdorff topological field. Both archimedean and nonarchimedean local fields are allowed.

concepts.title: Local-field topology on points of an affine algebraic group
concepts.description: For a local field F and an affine embedding G⊂A^n, give G(F) the subspace topology from F^n. Polynomial coordinate maps show this topology is independent of the chosen affine embedding.

concepts.title: Local martingale
concepts.description: An adapted càdlàg process M for which stopping times T_n↑∞ almost surely exist such that each stopped process M_{t∧T_n} is a martingale.

concepts.title: Local measure defined by an algebraic gauge form
concepts.description: On the local-field points of a smooth algebraic group, write an invariant gauge form in analytic coordinates as ω=f(x)dx₁∧…∧dx_d and use |f(x)|_v times product additive Haar measure. For the number-field standard convention take vol(O_v)=1 at finite places, dx over R, and2 dxdy over C.

concepts.title: Local norm estimate from numerical radius
concepts.description: For a bounded operator T on a complex Hilbert space with w(T)≤1 and a vector x with ∥x∥≤1, ∥Tx∥²≤2+2√(1−|⟨Tx,x⟩|²).

concepts.title: Local weak convergence of bounded-degree graphs
concepts.description: A bounded-degree graph sequence converges locally to a random rooted graph if, for each finite radius and rooted neighborhood type, the proportion of vertices with that neighborhood converges to the corresponding root-neighborhood probability. For random graphs this convergence may be in probability.

concepts.title: Localization of a commutative ring
concepts.description: For a multiplicatively closed subset S of a commutative ring R containing 1, S⁻¹R consists of fractions r/s, identifying r/s with r′/s′ when t(rs′−r′s)=0 for some t in S, with the usual fraction operations.

concepts.title: Locally compact group
concepts.description: A topological group whose underlying space is locally compact and Hausdorff.

concepts.title: Locally compact Hausdorff space
concepts.description: A Hausdorff topological space in which every point has a neighbourhood with compact closure.

concepts.title: Locally constant function
concepts.description: A function that is constant on some open neighbourhood of each point of its domain.

concepts.title: Locally convex topological vector space
concepts.description: A real or complex topological vector space whose zero has a neighborhood base of convex sets; equivalently its topology can be generated by seminorms.

concepts.title: Locally finite triangulation of a Euclidean set
concepts.description: A family of Euclidean simplices covering the set, closed under taking faces and meeting in common faces, such that every point has a neighborhood meeting only finitely many simplices.

concepts.title: Locally finite point configuration
concepts.description: An integer-valued Radon measure ξ=∑_iδ_{x_i} assigning finite mass to every compact set; repeated points may have multiplicity. Configuration space carries the vague topology.

concepts.title: Locally path-connected topological space
concepts.description: A space in which every neighborhood of each point contains a path-connected open neighborhood of that point.

concepts.title: Uniform convergence on compact subsets
concepts.description: A sequence of functions converges locally uniformly on a topological space if it converges uniformly on every compact subset.

concepts.title: Log-Hölder continuous variable exponent
concepts.description: An exponent p is locally log-Hölder if |p(x)−p(y)|≤C/log(e+1/|x−y|); global log-Hölder continuity additionally requires |p(x)−p∞|≤C/log(e+|x|) for a constant p∞.

concepts.title: L(log L)ᵏ moment condition
concepts.description: X∈L(log L)ᵏ means E[abs(X)(log⁺abs(X))ᵏ]<∞, where log⁺t=max(0,log t) for t>0 and log⁺0=0.

concepts.title: Logarithmic fundamental solution of −Δ in the plane
concepts.description: The locally integrable function Γ(x)=(2π)⁻¹log(1/|x|) on ℝ² satisfies −ΔΓ=δ₀ in the distributional sense.

concepts.title: Lopsided planar algebra
concepts.description: A connected shaded planar algebra, with one-dimensional 0-box spaces, normalized so the shaded contractible circle evaluates to 1. The unshaded circle then evaluates to the index, the product of the two circle moduli.

concepts.title: Lower semicontinuous extended-real function
concepts.description: A function u:X→(−∞,∞] on a topological space is lower semicontinuous if {x:u(x)>a} is open for every real a.

concepts.title: Lebesgue Lᵖ space
concepts.description: For a measure space and 1≤p<∞, Lᵖ consists of measurable scalar functions modulo equality almost everywhere with ∫|f|ᵖ<∞, normed by (∫|f|ᵖ)¹ᐟᵖ. For p=∞ use the essential-supremum norm.

concepts.title: Lusin topological space
concepts.description: A Hausdorff topological space that is a continuous bijective image of a Polish space. Its Borel measurable space is consequently standard Borel; the topology need not itself be Polish.

concepts.title: Maillet’s prime-difference conjecture
concepts.description: Every positive even integer is a difference of two primes.

concepts.title: Malliavin covariance matrix
concepts.description: For a random vector F=(F¹,…,Fⁿ) with Malliavin differentiable components, its covariance matrix is γ_F^{ij}=⟨DFⁱ,DFʲ⟩ in the Cameron–Martin space.

concepts.title: Malliavin derivative on Wiener space
concepts.description: For a smooth cylindrical Wiener functional F=f(B(h₁),…,B(h_n)), DF=∑_i∂_if(B(h₁),…,B(h_n))h_i in the Cameron–Martin space; its closure defines the Malliavin derivative on the corresponding Sobolev domains.

concepts.title: First-order Malliavin Sobolev space on Wiener space
concepts.description: For1<p<∞, D¹,ᵖ is the completion of smooth cylindrical Wiener functionals in the norm(E|F|ᵖ+E‖DF‖_Hᵖ)¹ᐟᵖ, using the closed Malliavin derivative D and Cameron–Martin space H.

concepts.title: Marginal density on a product measure space
concepts.description: A joint density on a product space induces a marginal density by integrating out the coordinates not retained.

concepts.title: Marginal distribution on a finite product space
concepts.description: The marginal on a set of coordinates is obtained by summing the joint mass over all other coordinates.

concepts.title: Time-homogeneous Markov chain on a finite state space
concepts.description: A sequence of random states in a finite set whose conditional next-state distribution given its whole past depends only on the present state, through one fixed stochastic transition matrix.

concepts.title: Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling
concepts.description: Use a Markov chain with a prescribed stationary distribution to generate dependent approximate samples from that distribution,with ergodic averages used to estimate expectations.

concepts.title: Markov’s inequality for nonnegative random variables
concepts.description: If Y is a nonnegative integrable real random variable and t>0, then P(Y≥t)≤E[Y]/t.

concepts.title: Markov transition semigroup
concepts.description: A family of transition kernels P_t(x,A), t≥0, with P₀(x,·)=δ_x and P_{s+t}(x,A)=∫P_t(y,A)P_s(x,dy). Sub-Markov semigroups may lose mass at a cemetery state.

concepts.title: Continuous-time martingale
concepts.description: An integrable process M_t adapted to a filtration F_t, t≥0, with E[M_t|F_s]=M_s almost surely whenever s≤t. Right-continuity of paths is an additional regularity condition when needed.

concepts.title: Bounded martingale convergence theorem
concepts.description: A martingale uniformly bounded by a deterministic constant converges almost surely and in L¹. In particular, conditional expectations of a bounded X along increasing σ-algebras converge to E[X|σ(∪_nF_n)].

concepts.title: Nonnegative martingale convergence theorem
concepts.description: A nonnegative right-continuous martingale converges almost surely to a finite integrable random variable as t→∞. Its limiting expectation may be strictly smaller than its initial expectation.

concepts.title: Discrete-time martingale
concepts.description: An integrable process (M_n) adapted to an increasing sequence of σ-algebras (F_n) such that E[M_{n+1}|F_n]=M_n almost surely.

concepts.title: Masharov–Sharipov’s bound for second-cuboid searches
concepts.description: In the second-cuboid parametrization with distinct coprime positive p,q, no root giving a perfect cuboid can occur for q≥59p. Thus every possible candidate in this family has q<59p and t<61p². This does not assert nonexistence of arbitrary perfect cuboids.

concepts.title: Matching in a graph
concepts.description: A set of edges no two of which share a vertex. Unmatched vertices are called monomers in a monomer–dimer interpretation.

concepts.title: Matrix exponential
concepts.description: For a finite square real or complex matrix A, exp(A)=∑_{n≥0}Aⁿ/n!, with convergence in any matrix norm.

concepts.title: Matrix over a ring
concepts.description: A rectangular array of elements of a ring; addition is entrywise and matrix multiplication uses row-by-column sums.

concepts.title: Trace of a square matrix
concepts.description: The sum of the diagonal entries of a square matrix.

concepts.title: Maximal compact subgroup of a Lie group
concepts.description: A compact subgroup of a real Lie group maximal among its compact subgroups under inclusion.

concepts.title: Maximal coupling of finite probability distributions
concepts.description: A coupling (X,Y) of p and q with P(X≠Y)=d_TV(p,q), attaining the smallest possible disagreement probability.

concepts.title: Griffeath’s maximal coupling theorem for Markov chains
concepts.description: Finite Markov chains with the same transition kernel can be coupled so that their coalescence time T satisfies P(T>n)=d_TV(Law(X_n),Law(Y_n)) for every n. Such a coupling need not be co-adapted.

concepts.title: Maximum modulus principle
concepts.description: A nonconstant holomorphic function on a connected open subset of ℂ cannot have a local maximum of its modulus in the interior.

concepts.title: Maynard–Tao multidimensional sieve
concepts.description: A refinement of Selberg’s sieve using weights (∑_{d_i|n+h_i}λ_{d₁,…,d_k})² for an admissible tuple h₁,…,h_k, with coefficients selected by a function on a simplex. Comparing weighted prime counts with total mass produces several primes in a common translate.

concepts.title: Maynard’s lower bound for the prime-cluster variational constant
concepts.description: For all sufficiently large k, the prime-cluster variational constant M_k satisfies M_k>log k−2loglog k−2.

concepts.title: Maynard’s variational criterion for prime clusters
concepts.description: Let M_k be the supremum of (∑ᵢJ_i(F))/I(F) for nonzero real Riemann-integrable F supported on {t_i≥0,∑t_i≤1}, where I=∫F² and J_i=∫(∫F dt_i)². If primes have level of distribution θ>0, every admissible k-tuple has infinitely many translates containing at least ceil(θM_k/2) primes.

concepts.title: Meagre subset of a topological space
concepts.description: A countable union of nowhere dense subsets.

concepts.title: Mean support function on the unit sphere
concepts.description: For nonempty compact K⊂ℝⁿ, M*(K)=∫_{S^{n−1}}h_K(u)dσ(u), with σ normalized to total mass one. This is half the mean width under the convention that width in direction u is h_K(u)+h_K(−u).

concepts.title: Mean value theorem for real functions
concepts.description: If f is continuous on [a,b] and differentiable on (a,b), there exists c∈(a,b) such that f(b)−f(a)=f′(c)(b−a).

concepts.title: Measurable map between measurable spaces
concepts.description: A function for which the preimage of each measurable subset of the codomain is measurable in the domain.

concepts.title: Measurable simple real function
concepts.description: A measurable real function with finite range. It can be written as a finite sum ∑ a_i 1_{A_i} with measurable level sets A_i.

concepts.title: Measurable space
concepts.description: A set equipped with a specified σ-algebra of subsets.

concepts.title: Measure
concepts.description: A measure μ maps a σ-algebra to [0,∞], sends ∅ to 0, and satisfies μ(⋃ₙAₙ)=∑ₙμ(Aₙ) for every pairwise disjoint sequence of measurable sets.

concepts.title: Measure-preserving measurable flow
concepts.description: A jointly measurable family θ_t of probability-preserving maps, indexed by real t, with θ₀=id and θ_{s+t}=θ_s∘θ_t.

concepts.title: Meromorphic continuation
concepts.description: A meromorphic function on a larger connected complex domain that agrees with a given function on its original open domain.

concepts.title: Meromorphic function of one complex variable
concepts.description: A function on a complex domain locally expressible as a quotient of holomorphic functions with denominator not identically zero; zeros of the denominator give poles after common factors cancel.

concepts.title: Metaplectic double cover of SL₂(R)
concepts.description: The group Mp₂(R) of pairs (γ,φ), with γ=[[a,b],[c,d]]∈SL₂(R) and φ a holomorphic function on the upper half-plane satisfying φ(τ)²=cτ+d; multiplication is (γ₁,φ₁)(γ₂,φ₂)=(γ₁γ₂,(φ₁∘γ₂)φ₂). The projection to γ is a double cover.

concepts.title: Method of moments for convergence in distribution
concepts.description: If probability laws have all moments, each moment converges to the corresponding finite moment of a probability law uniquely determined by its moments, then the laws converge weakly to that law.

concepts.title: Completion of a metric space
concepts.description: A complete metric space containing an isometric dense copy of the given metric space. It is unique up to an isometry fixing that copy.

concepts.title: Metric space
concepts.description: A set X with a function d:X×X→[0,∞) such that d(x,y)=0 exactly when x=y, d(x,y)=d(y,x), and d(x,z)≤d(x,y)+d(y,z).

concepts.title: Normality of metric spaces
concepts.description: Any two disjoint closed subsets of a metric space have disjoint open neighborhoods; equivalently every metric space is normal.

concepts.title: Moment-generating-function convergence theorem
concepts.description: If moment generating functions are finite on a common neighborhood of zero and converge there pointwise to the moment generating function of a probability distribution, the corresponding distributions converge weakly to that distribution.

concepts.title: Primitive idempotent in an algebra
concepts.description: A nonzero idempotent that is not a sum of two nonzero orthogonal idempotents. In a finite-dimensional semisimple algebra A, e is primitive exactly when the left ideal Ae is a simple A-module.

concepts.title: Minimal polynomial of an algebraic element
concepts.description: The unique monic polynomial of least positive degree over F vanishing at an algebraic element α; it generates the ideal of all polynomials over F vanishing at α.

concepts.title: Minimum attainment for lower semicontinuous functions on compact sets
concepts.description: A lower semicontinuous function from a nonempty compact space into (−∞,∞] attains its infimum.

concepts.title: Minimum principle for superharmonic functions
concepts.description: A superharmonic function on a bounded domain with nonnegative lower boundary limits is nonnegative throughout the domain. An interior minimum forces it to be constant on that connected component.

concepts.title: Minkowski’s first inequality for mixed volumes
concepts.description: For full-dimensional convex bodies K,L⊂ℝⁿ, V(K[n−1],L)^n≥|K|^{n−1}|L|, with equality exactly when K and L are homothetic.

concepts.title: Minkowski inequality for Lᵖ norms
concepts.description: For 1≤p≤∞ and f,g∈Lᵖ of a measure space, ∥f+g∥_p≤∥f∥_p+∥g∥_p.

concepts.title: Minkowski sum of subsets of a vector space
concepts.description: For subsets A,B of a vector space, A+B={a+b:a∈A,b∈B}.

concepts.title: Minkowski symmetrization of a Euclidean set
concepts.description: For K⊂ℝⁿ and a unit u, M_u(K)=½(K+R_uK), where R_u is reflection in u⊥.

concepts.title: Mixed discriminant of square matrices
concepts.description: The symmetric multilinear coefficient D(A₁,…,A_n) in det(∑t_iA_i), normalized by D(A,…,A)=det A.

concepts.title: Projection body associated with a quermassintegral
concepts.description: For 0≤i≤d−2, Π_iK is the convex body with support function h_{Π_iK}(u)=W_i(K|u⊥), where the quermassintegral is taken in the (d−1)-dimensional space u⊥.

concepts.title: Mixed variable Lebesgue–sequence space L^{p(·)}(ℓ^{q(·)})
concepts.description: A sequence of measurable functions (fⱼ) has quasi-norm ∥(∑ⱼ|fⱼ(·)|^{q(·)})^{1/q(·)}∥_{L^{p(·)}}; functions are identified almost everywhere.

concepts.title: Mixed volume of convex bodies
concepts.description: The symmetric coefficient V(K₁,…,K_d) in the homogeneous degree-d volume polynomial |∑tᵢKᵢ| for nonnegative scalars tᵢ, normalized by V(K,…,K)=|K|.

concepts.title: Integral representation of mixed volume using curvature matrices
concepts.description: For C² convex bodies with positive definite curvature matrices, V(K₁,…,K_n)=n⁻¹∫_{S^{n−1}}h_{K₁}D(D²h_{K₂},…,D²h_{K_n})dS, where D² is the curvature matrix of the homogeneous support function.

concepts.title: Total variation mixing time
concepts.description: For a finite chain and chosen initial law, t_mix(ε)=inf{t:d_TV(Law(X_t),π)≤ε}. Worst-case mixing time takes the maximum over starting states.

concepts.title: Möbius function
concepts.description: The arithmetic function μ(n) equal to 0 if a squared prime divides n and to (−1)^r if n is a product of r distinct primes, including μ(1)=1.

concepts.title: Moderate growth of an adelic function
concepts.description: A function f on G(A_F) has moderate growth if |f(g)|≤C H(g)^N for some constants C,N>0 and a fixed faithful adelic matrix height H. Uniform moderate growth requires a common N for all derivatives from U(g_∞⊗C), with constants allowed to depend on the derivative.

concepts.title: Modular tensor category
concepts.description: A ribbon fusion category over ℂ whose S-matrix is invertible.

concepts.title: Cusp of a subgroup of SL₂(Z)
concepts.description: An orbit of a subgroup Γ⊂SL₂(Z) on Q∪{∞} under fractional linear transformations; for a congruence subgroup its cusp width is the positive translation period after sending a representative to infinity.

concepts.title: Modular form of integer weight on a congruence subgroup
concepts.description: A holomorphic function f on the upper half-plane satisfying f((aτ+b)/(cτ+d))=(cτ+d)^k f(τ) for matrices in a specified congruence subgroup, and holomorphic at every cusp.

concepts.title: Weight-k slash operator on the upper half-plane
concepts.description: For γ=[[a,b],[c,d]]∈SL₂(ℤ), (f|ₖγ)(τ)=(cτ+d)^{-k}f((aτ+b)/(cτ+d)).

concepts.title: Module category over a tensor category
concepts.description: A category M with an action C×M→M and coherent associativity and unit isomorphisms.

concepts.title: Module over a commutative ring
concepts.description: An abelian group M with an action of a commutative ring R satisfying r(m+n)=rm+rn, (r+s)m=rm+sm, (rs)m=r(sm), and 1m=m. Unlike a vector space, its scalar ring need not be a field.

concepts.title: Von Neumann dimension of a Hilbert module
concepts.description: A Hilbert module over a finite factor is represented by a projection on a sum of copies of L²(M); its dimension is the extended matrix trace of that projection.

concepts.title: Rational forms pass to dual fusion categories
concepts.description: In the characteristic-zero fusion-category setting, let M_K be an indecomposable finite semisimple module category over D_K and let D_k,M_k be compatible rational forms. Scalar extension induces a fully faithful dominant functor Fun_{D_k}(M_k,M_k)⊗_k K→Fun_{D_K}(M_K,M_K), so the dual category over k is a rational form of the dual over K.

concepts.title: Homomorphism of modules over a commutative ring
concepts.description: An additive map f:M→N of modules over the same commutative ring satisfying f(rm)=rf(m).

concepts.title: Mollifier on Euclidean space
concepts.description: A nonnegative smooth compactly supported function j on ℝᵈ with integral one. Its scaled kernels j_ε(x)=ε⁻ᵈj(x/ε) produce smooth approximations by convolution.

concepts.title: Moment-determinate probability distribution
concepts.description: A probability law with finite moments of every nonnegative integer order is moment-determinate if no other probability law has the same sequence of moments.

concepts.title: Moment generating function
concepts.description: For a real random variable X, M_X(t)=Eexp(tX) at real t for which the expectation is finite.

concepts.title: Monoidal category
concepts.description: A category C with a tensor bifunctor C×C→C, a unit object, and natural associativity and unit isomorphisms satisfying the pentagon and triangle identities.

concepts.title: Tensor equivalence
concepts.description: A strong monoidal functor whose underlying functor is an equivalence of categories.

concepts.title: Strong monoidal functor
concepts.description: A functor equipped with coherent isomorphisms preserving tensor products and the tensor unit.

concepts.title: Monoidal natural transformation
concepts.description: A natural transformation between strong monoidal functors compatible with their tensor-product and unit isomorphisms.

concepts.title: Monomer–dimer model on a finite graph
concepts.description: A probability distribution on graph matchings in which unmatched vertices are monomers and matched edges dimers, with specified nonnegative vertex and edge activities multiplying to give each matching’s unnormalized weight. The matching constraint is the hard-core exclusion.

concepts.title: Monotone convergence theorem for Lebesgue integrals
concepts.description: If 0≤fₙ≤fₙ₊₁ and fₙ→f pointwise, then ∫fₙdμ increases to ∫f dμ, allowing infinity.

concepts.title: Monotone-gap selection theorem for points on a line
concepts.description: For r,s≥2, any binom(r+s−4,r−2)+1 distinct points on a line contain r points with nondecreasing consecutive gaps or s points with nonincreasing consecutive gaps.

concepts.title: Convergence of bounded monotone real sequences
concepts.description: Every bounded monotone sequence of real numbers converges.

concepts.title: Monotone subsequence
concepts.description: A strictly increasing subsequence has indices i₁<···<iₖ and values aᵢ₁<···<aᵢₖ; a decreasing subsequence reverses the value comparisons and retains increasing indices.

concepts.title: Monte Carlo estimator of an expectation
concepts.description: Estimate EF by the empirical mean L⁻¹∑_{ℓ=1}ᴸF(X_ℓ) of independent identically distributed samples. Variants may use dependent samples with a separately justified sampling law.

concepts.title: Montel’s theorem for locally bounded holomorphic families
concepts.description: A locally uniformly bounded family of holomorphic functions on a complex domain is normal: every sequence has a subsequence converging uniformly on compact subsets to a holomorphic function.

concepts.title: Moore–Penrose inverse of a real matrix
concepts.description: For a real matrix A, its Moore–Penrose inverse A† is the matrix satisfying AA†A=A, A†AA†=A†, (AA†)ᵀ=AA† and (A†A)ᵀ=A†A. For full column rank, A†=(AᵀA)⁻¹Aᵀ.

concepts.title: Morimoto’s stochastic-mesh CVA estimators
concepts.description: For a portfolio whose payoffs each depend only on a shared macro factor and one local factor, approximate each future conditional payoff with a low-dimensional stochastic mesh and time-discretize expected positive aggregate exposure. One estimator uses the approximate exposure itself; another uses the mesh only to classify its sign and averages realized discounted payoffs from independent paths on the estimated positive-exposure region.

concepts.title: Multi-index for Euclidean partial derivatives
concepts.description: An n-tuple α=(α₁,…,α_n) of nonnegative integers, with |α|=∑α_i; Dᵅ denotes taking α_i partial derivatives in coordinate i.

concepts.title: Multinomial theorem
concepts.description: For commuting variables,(x₁+⋯+xᵣ)^n=∑_{n₁+⋯+nᵣ=n}n!/(n₁!⋯nᵣ!)x₁^{n₁}⋯xᵣ^{nᵣ}, summing over nonnegative indices.

concepts.title: Multiple dense divisibility of integers
concepts.description: Fix y≥1. Every positive integer is 0-tuply y-densely divisible. Recursively n is i-tuply y-densely divisible if, for all j+k=i−1 and 1≤R≤yn, there is n=ab with R/y≤b≤R, where a is j-tuply and b is k-tuply y-densely divisible.

concepts.title: Multiple-spine change of measure for constant-rate branching
concepts.description: For rate-β branching with offspring A and moments m_j=EAʲ finite for1≤j≤k, start one ancestor with k marks. A particle carrying j marks moves by the original Markov motion, branches at rateβm_j with offspring law aʲP(A=a)/m_j, and each mark independently chooses a child uniformly. Unmarked particles retain the original branching law. The marked genealogical subtree is its skeleton.

concepts.title: Multiplicative algebraic group
concepts.description: The affine F-group G_m with R-points R×, represented by F[t,t⁻¹], whose coproduct sends t to t⊗t.

concepts.title: Multiplicative Hecke operator on Siegel modular forms
concepts.description: For a finite double-coset correspondence ΓMΓ, the multiplicative transform of F is the product of its weight-slash transforms over left-coset representatives, with the corresponding weight and character. It contrasts with the additive sum defining an ordinary Hecke operator.

concepts.title: Multiplicity of a polynomial root
concepts.description: The multiplicity of a root a of a polynomial P is the largest m≥1 for which (x−a)^m divides P. A root of multiplicity1 is simple.

concepts.title: Multivariate normal distribution
concepts.description: A distribution of a real vector X for which every real linear combination of coordinates is normally distributed; it is specified by its mean vector and positive semidefinite covariance matrix.

concepts.title: Nagaoka’s congruences for Igusa’s integral generators modulo2 and3
concepts.description: For p=2 or3, the reductions of all fourteen even-weight Igusa integral generators are explicit polynomials in X₁₀,Y₁₂,X₁₆. In particular X₄≡X₆≡1, X₁₂≡X₁₀, X₁₈≡X₁₆ and X₂₄≡X₁₀X₁₆. The complete finite identity list, with the distinct p=2 and p=3 higher-weight formulas, is fixed by the stated source locator.

concepts.title: Nagaoka’s genus-two modular-form structure modulo 2 and 3
concepts.description: For p=2 or 3, every reduction modulo p of an integral even-weight full-group genus-two Siegel modular form is a unique polynomial over F_p in the reductions of Igusa’s X₁₀,Y₁₂,X₁₆, after forgetting the weight grading.

concepts.title: Natural isomorphism
concepts.description: A natural transformation whose component at every object is an isomorphism.

concepts.title: Natural number
concepts.description: One of 0, 1, 2, …; natural numbers count finite collections.

concepts.title: Natural transformation
concepts.description: A family of maps between the values of two functors, commuting with every morphism in their source category.

concepts.title: Negligible morphism in a spherical linear category
concepts.description: In a spherical k-linear category with End(1)=k, f:X→Y is negligible if tr(gf)=0 for every g:Y→X. Such morphisms form a tensor ideal.

concepts.title: Newton polygon of a bivariate polynomial
concepts.description: The convex hull in ℝ² of exponent pairs (i,j) whose monomial coefficients in P(x,y)=∑cᵢⱼxⁱyʲ are nonzero.

concepts.title: Nilpotent ideal of a commutative ring
concepts.description: An ideal I for which I^n=0 for some positive integer n, meaning every product of n elements of I is zero.

concepts.title: Extreme-point criterion for the closed unit ball of H∞
concepts.description: A scalar Schur function b is non-extreme exactly when log(1−|b*|²) is integrable on the unit circle.

concepts.title: Non-extreme scalar Schur function
concepts.description: A holomorphic b on the unit disk with ∥b∥∞≤1 that is not an extreme point of the closed unit ball of H∞, regarded as a real convex set.

concepts.title: Non-reconstruction for Gibbs measures on sparse graphs
concepts.description: The spin at a typical vertex becomes asymptotically independent of a randomly sampled distant boundary condition, measured by the expected total variation change of its conditional marginal as the boundary radius tends to infinity.

concepts.title: Continuous nonabelian 1-cocycle
concepts.description: For a topological group Γ acting continuously on a group H, a continuous map c:Γ→H satisfying c(στ)=c(σ)σ(c(τ)). Cocycles are equivalent when c′(σ)=h⁻¹c(σ)σ(h) for one h∈H.

concepts.title: Nonarchimedean local field
concepts.description: A field complete for a nontrivial discrete valuation and having a finite residue field.

concepts.title: Non-cyclotomicity of the principal Haagerup fusion categories
concepts.description: The principal even parts of the Haagerup and extended Haagerup subfactors have no complete rational form over any cyclotomic field.

concepts.title: Nondegenerate bilinear form
concepts.description: A bilinear form b:V×V→F is nondegenerate if b(v,w)=0 for all w forces v=0, and b(v,w)=0 for all v forces w=0.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Non-elliptic G₂ web
concepts.description: A G₂ web with no closed loop components and with at least six edges on every internal face.

concepts.title: Nonnegative real square root
concepts.description: For t≥0, √t is the unique real number y≥0 satisfying y²=t.

concepts.title: Sum of a nonnegative series
concepts.description: For aₙ≥0, define ∑ₙ≥1aₙ as the supremum of its finite partial sums; the value may be infinite.

concepts.title: Nonnegative grading on a commutative ring
concepts.description: A decomposition R=⊕_{n≥0}R_n of its additive group such that R_mR_n⊆R_{m+n} and 1∈R_0. Multiplication is ordinarily commutative; this does not mean the sign rule sometimes called graded commutativity.

concepts.title: Metric induced by a norm
concepts.description: The metric induced by a norm on a real or complex vector space is d(x,y)=‖x−y‖.

concepts.title: Norm monotonicity for positive C*-algebra elements
concepts.description: If 0≤a≤b in a C*-algebra, then ∥a∥≤∥b∥.

concepts.title: Normal closure of a number field
concepts.description: The smallest normal extension of ℚ inside a fixed algebraic closure that contains the given number field.

concepts.title: Normal distribution
concepts.description: The real probability distribution N(m,σ²) with density (2πσ²)⁻¹ᐟ²exp(−(x−m)²/(2σ²)) for σ>0; variance zero gives a point mass at m.

concepts.title: Normal algebraic field extension
concepts.description: An algebraic extension L/F such that every irreducible polynomial over F with a root in L factors into linear polynomials over L.

concepts.title: Normally reflected diffusion in a convex domain
concepts.description: A continuous process in a closed convex domain solving an SDE plus an inward normal finite-variation correction supported on boundary times, keeping the process inside the domain.

concepts.title: Normal subgroup
concepts.description: A subgroup H of G satisfying gHg⁻¹=H for every g∈G.

concepts.title: Compatibility of field norm with normalized place norms
concepts.description: For a finite extension L/K of number fields and every place v of K, ∏_(w|v)|a|_w=|N_(L/K)(a)|_v for all a∈L×.

concepts.title: Normalized local multiplicative norm on a number field
concepts.description: At a real place use the usual absolute value, at a complex place use the square of the usual complex modulus, and at a finite place v use |x|_v=(#k_v)^(−ord_v(x)), with |0|_v=0. The complex normalization is multiplicative but need not satisfy the ordinary triangle inequality.

concepts.title: Normalized consecutive prime gap
concepts.description: For consecutive primes p_n,p_{n+1}, the real number (p_{n+1}−p_n)/log p_n. Its finite limit points are subsequential limits of this sequence.

concepts.title: Normalized trace space of an ordered abelian group
concepts.description: For an ordered abelian group with order unit u, S(G,u) is the set of positive homomorphisms τ:G→ℝ with τ(u)=1, with the topology of pointwise convergence on G.

concepts.title: Normed vector space
concepts.description: A real or complex vector space X with a function ∥·∥:X→[0,∞) that is positive except at zero, absolutely homogeneous, and subadditive.

concepts.title: Norming family of linear functionals
concepts.description: A family F of linear functionals on a normed space X is norming when ∥x∥=sup{|f(x)|:f∈F} for every x∈X.

concepts.title: Nowhere dense subset of a topological space
concepts.description: A subset whose closure has empty interior.

concepts.title: Number field
concepts.description: A finite extension of ℚ.

concepts.title: Discriminant of a number field
concepts.description: For an integral basis ω₁,…,ω_n of F, the integer d_F=det(Tr_(F/Q)(ω_iω_j))_(i,j). A change of integral basis leaves this determinant unchanged.

concepts.title: Product formula for a number field
concepts.description: For every nonzero a in a number field F, ∏_v|a|_v=1 using normalized local multiplicative norms at every finite and infinite place. Only finitely many factors differ from1.

concepts.title: Numerical radius of a Hilbert-space operator
concepts.description: For a bounded Hilbert-space operator T, w(T)=sup{|z|:z∈W(T)}.

concepts.title: Comparison of numerical radius and operator norm
concepts.description: For a bounded operator T on a complex Hilbert space, w(T)≤∥T∥≤2w(T). If T is self-adjoint, w(T)=∥T∥.

concepts.title: Berger’s power inequality for numerical radius
concepts.description: For every bounded Hilbert-space operator T and integer n≥1, w(Tⁿ)≤w(T)ⁿ.

concepts.title: Numerical range of a Hilbert-space operator
concepts.description: For a bounded operator T on a nonzero complex Hilbert space, W(T)={⟨Tx,x⟩:∥x∥=1}.

concepts.title: Handelman–Roy criterion for one-sided linear Diophantine approximation
concepts.description: Let H⊂ℝⁿ be an additive subgroup containing no strictly positive vector,and F the smallest face of the standard simplex containing the nonnegative normalized linear functionals that vanish on H. Then for every h∈H,m≥1 and ε>0 there exists h′∈H with h−mh′>−ε coordinatewise iff for every f∈F,the subgroup f(H) is zero or dense inℝ.

concepts.title: Open interval in the real line
concepts.description: For real a<b, the set (a,b)={x∈ℝ:a<x<b}.

concepts.title: Operator norm of a bounded linear operator
concepts.description: For a bounded linear map T:X→Y between normed spaces, ∥T∥=sup{∥Tx∥:∥x∥≤1}.

concepts.title: Spectrum of a bounded operator
concepts.description: For a bounded operator T on a complex Banach space, σ(T) is the set of complex λ for which λI−T has no bounded two-sided inverse.

concepts.title: Aldous–Diaconis optimal strong stationary time theorem
concepts.description: For an irreducible aperiodic finite Markov chain with positive stationary law, there exists a strong stationary time T with P(T>n)=sep(Law(X_n),π) for every n; any strong stationary time has tail at least this separation distance.

concepts.title: Asymptotic coalescence of ordered couplings with the same limiting marginal law
concepts.description: On a Polish space with closed partial order, if X_t≤Y_t and both marginal laws converge weakly to the same probability measure μ, then d(X_t,Y_t)→0 in probability.

concepts.title: Order interval in a partially ordered set
concepts.description: For f≤g, the order interval [f,g] consists of all x satisfying f≤x≤g.

concepts.title: Order-preserving random dynamical system
concepts.description: A random dynamical system on a partially ordered state space such that x≤y implies φ_t(ω,x)≤φ_t(ω,y) for all t≥0 and every noise realization.

concepts.title: Order unit in a partially ordered abelian group
concepts.description: A positive element u such that every g satisfies −Nu≤g≤Nu for some positive integer N.

concepts.title: Partially ordered abelian group
concepts.description: An abelian group with a translation-invariant partial order. In this paper it is directed: every element is a difference of positive elements.

concepts.title: Ordered field
concepts.description: A field with a total order preserved by addition, in which the product of two positive elements is positive.

concepts.title: Ordered pair
concepts.description: A pair (x,y) with distinguished first and second entries; (x,y)=(x′,y′) exactly when x=x′ and y=y′.

concepts.title: Orthogonal complement for a bilinear form
concepts.description: For a bilinear form b on V and subspace U, its right orthogonal complement is U⊥={v∈V:b(u,v)=0 for every u∈U}. This definition does not assume a positive inner product.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Real orthogonal group
concepts.description: The group O(n) of real n×n matrices U satisfying UᵀU=I; these are the linear isometries of Euclidean space.

concepts.title: Orthogonal idempotents in an algebra
concepts.description: Idempotents e and f satisfying ef=fe=0.

concepts.title: Real orthogonal matrix
concepts.description: A real square matrix U with UᵀU=I, equivalently a linear map preserving the Euclidean inner product.

concepts.title: Sequence of orthogonal polynomials
concepts.description: A sequence of real polynomials of successive degrees, orthogonal under ∫p(x)q(x)dμ(x) for a specified positive measure with the necessary finite moments.

concepts.title: Orthogonal projection onto a closed Hilbert subspace
concepts.description: For a closed subspace V of a Hilbert space H, Pᵥx is the unique v∈V for which x−v is orthogonal to V; Pᵥ is a bounded self-adjoint idempotent operator.

concepts.title: Orthonormal basis of a Hilbert space
concepts.description: An orthonormal family whose linear span is dense in the Hilbert space.

concepts.title: Orthonormal family in a Hilbert space
concepts.description: Vectors (e_i) with ⟨e_i,e_j⟩=0 for i≠j and ‖e_i‖=1.

concepts.title: Outer function in Hardy H²
concepts.description: A function a∈H² is outer if the linear span of a,z a,z²a,… is dense in H²; this is equivalent to the usual exponential Poisson-integral definition.

concepts.title: Poisson formula for the logarithm of an outer function
concepts.description: For a nonzero outer a∈H² of the unit disk, log|a(z)|=∫_T P_z(ζ)log|a*(ζ)|dm(ζ), where P_z(ζ)=(1−|z|²)/|ζ−z|² and m is normalized arc measure. In particular |a(0)|=exp∫log|a*|dm.

concepts.title: Outer function with prescribed boundary modulus
concepts.description: If w≥0 belongs to L² of the unit circle and log w∈L¹, there is a unique outer a∈H² with a(0)>0 and |a|=w almost everywhere. If w≤1 then a∈H∞ with norm at most one.

concepts.title: Outer unit normal of a convex body
concepts.description: A unit vector u is an outer normal at x∈∂K if (y−x)·u≤0 for every y∈K; at boundary points with a unique such u, this gives the Gauss map.

concepts.title: Field of p-adic numbers
concepts.description: For a prime p, ℚ_p is the completion of ℚ for the p-adic absolute value |x|_p=p^{-v_p(x)}.

concepts.title: p-adic valuation of a rational number
concepts.description: For a prime p and nonzero rational x, v_p(x) is the unique integer r such that x=p^r a/b with integers a,b not divisible by p; put v_p(0)=+∞.

concepts.title: p-integral rational number
concepts.description: For a prime p, a rational number is p-integral if it can be written a/b with integers a,b and p not dividing b.

concepts.title: Pairwise independent random variables
concepts.description: A family (Xᵢ) is pairwise independent if P(Xᵢ∈A,Xⱼ∈B)=P(Xᵢ∈A)P(Xⱼ∈B) for all i≠j and Borel A,B⊆ℝ.

concepts.title: Paley–Zygmund inequality
concepts.description: For nonnegative X with 0<E[X²]<∞ and 0<θ<1, P(X>θEX)≥(1−θ)²(EX)²/E[X²].

concepts.title: Parabolic Hörmander bracket condition for a diffusion
concepts.description: For smooth Stratonovich fields V₀,V₁,…,V_d, the noise fields V_i,i≥1, together with their iterated Lie brackets with V₀,…,V_d, span the spatial tangent space at every point. The drift field alone is not included as a generating direction.

concepts.title: Parabolic subgroup of a reductive algebraic group
concepts.description: A closed algebraic subgroup P of a connected reductive F-group G such that, after base change to an algebraic closure, P contains a Borel subgroup of G. Equivalently G/P is projective.

concepts.title: Parseval’s identity for an orthonormal Hilbert basis
concepts.description: For an orthonormal basis (e_k) of a separable Hilbert space, x=∑_k⟨x,e_k⟩e_k in norm and ‖x‖²=∑_k|⟨x,e_k⟩|².

concepts.title: Partial derivative in Euclidean coordinates
concepts.description: The ith partial derivative of f at x is the derivative at zero of t↦f(x+t e_i), with all other coordinates fixed; vector-valued maps are differentiated componentwise.

concepts.title: Partial-fraction decomposition over ℂ
concepts.description: A complex rational function is a polynomial plus a finite sum of terms c/(z−a)^j, one collection for each finite pole, with j bounded by its multiplicity.

concepts.title: Partial isometry between Hilbert spaces
concepts.description: A bounded linear operator that preserves norms on the orthogonal complement of its kernel.

concepts.title: Partial order
concepts.description: A reflexive, antisymmetric and transitive binary relation, usually written ≤.

concepts.title: Partition function of a finite Gibbs model
concepts.description: The normalizing sum Z=∑_σ exp(−βH(σ)); equivalently Z=∑_σ∏_aψ_a(σ) for positive factor weights. Its logarithm records the model’s free energy up to normalization.

concepts.title: Partition of a set
concepts.description: A family of nonempty pairwise disjoint subsets whose union is the set.

concepts.title: Pasting lemma for a finite closed cover
concepts.description: Maps on finitely many closed subsets covering a topological space glue to a continuous map if they are continuous and agree on every overlap.

concepts.title: Path-connected topological space
concepts.description: A topological space in which every pair of points is joined by a continuous map from [0,1] with those endpoints.

concepts.title: Peetre maximal function of a band-limited function
concepts.description: For scale j and a>0, the Peetre maximal function is f*_{j,a}(x)=sup_y |f(y)|/(1+2ʲ|x−y|)^a, used for functions localized to a frequency band of size 2ʲ.

concepts.title: Pelekis–Ramon–Wang Bennett bound for dependency graphs
concepts.description: If finitely many real random variables Y_v have dependency graph G, EY_v=0, Y_v≤1 and S=∑_vVar(Y_v)>0, then for t>0, P(∑_vY_v≥t)≤exp{−S[(1+t/S)ln(1+t/S)−t/S]/χ_f(G)}.

concepts.title: Perfect cuboid
concepts.description: A rectangular box whose three edges, three face diagonals and space diagonal all have positive integer lengths.

concepts.title: Perfect cuboid existence problem
concepts.description: The open existence question asks whether any rectangular box has integer edges, face diagonals and space diagonal.

concepts.title: Perron–Frobenius theorem for nonnegative matrices
concepts.description: A nonnegative real matrix has a nonnegative eigenvalue equal to its spectral radius. If it is irreducible, that eigenvalue is simple and has a strictly positive eigenvector, unique up to scalar.

concepts.title: Local strict minimum in Petty’s conjectured projection inequality
concepts.description: For each d≥3 there is ε_d>0 such that a nonellipsoidal convex body K with absolutely continuous surface area measure and ∥f_{TK}−1∥∞<ε_d for some invertible linear T satisfies |ΠK|/|K|^{d−1}>|ΠB₂ᵈ|/|B₂ᵈ|^{d−1}.

concepts.title: φ-transform characterization of variable-exponent Triebel–Lizorkin-type spaces
concepts.description: For the admissible p,q,s,φ defining F^{s(·),φ}_{p(·),q(·)}, the Frazier–Jawerth analysis and synthesis maps are bounded between this function space and its matching dyadic coefficient space, and analysis followed by synthesis reconstructs the distribution: TψSϕ=id. In particular the function-space quasi-norm is independent, up to equivalence, of the admissible Schwartz pair.

concepts.title: π
concepts.description: π is the least positive zero of the real sine function and equals the circumference-to-diameter ratio of a Euclidean circle.

concepts.title: Irrationality of π
concepts.description: There are no integers a,b with b≠0 such that π=a/b.

concepts.title: Piecewise affine homeomorphism on a planar domain
concepts.description: A homeomorphism on an open subset of ℝ² that is affine on every triangle of a locally finite triangulation; the triangulation need not be finite.

concepts.title: Pigeonhole principle
concepts.description: If more than n objects are assigned to n boxes, at least one box receives two objects; more generally some box receives at least the average number.

concepts.title: Pivotal category
concepts.description: A rigid monoidal category with a monoidal natural isomorphism from the identity functor to the double-dual functor.

concepts.title: Place of a number field
concepts.description: An equivalence class of nontrivial absolute values on a number field; its completion is denoted F_v. Archimedean and nonarchimedean places give its infinite and finite places.

concepts.title: General position for planar point sets
concepts.description: A finite P⊂ℝ² is in general position here if no three distinct points of P lie on one line.

concepts.title: Planar isotopy of tangle diagrams
concepts.description: A continuous deformation of embedded diagrams preserving their incidences, boundary components and marked data.

concepts.title: Mora-Corral–Pratelli smoothing of planar piecewise affine homeomorphisms
concepts.description: A planar piecewise affine homeomorphism in W¹,¹ can be approximated arbitrarily closely, both uniformly and in W¹,¹, by smooth diffeomorphisms, preserving boundary values when the continuous boundary extension is prescribed.

concepts.title: Poincaré inequality on H₀¹ of a bounded domain
concepts.description: For a bounded domain D⊂ℝᵈ there is C_D<∞ such that ‖u‖_{L²(D)}≤C_D‖∇u‖_{L²(D)} for all u∈H₀¹(D).

concepts.title: Strict separation of a point from a closed convex cone
concepts.description: If C is a nonempty closed convex cone in R^n and b∉C, there is y such that y·c≥0 for every c∈C and y·b<0.

concepts.title: Point process
concepts.description: A random locally finite point configuration, or equivalently a probability measure on configuration space with its measurable structure generated by counting points in bounded Borel sets.

concepts.title: Correlation functions of a point process
concepts.description: Relative to a reference measure dx, the k-point correlation function ρ⁽ᵏ⁾ is the density satisfying E∑_{x₁,…,xₖ distinct in ξ}f(x₁,…,xₖ)=∫fρ⁽ᵏ⁾dx₁⋯dxₖ for nonnegative measurable f, when this density exists. The sum counts distinct particle labels.

concepts.title: Compensation formula for Poisson random measures
concepts.description: If N has intensity dt·ν(dz), then for every nonnegative predictable H, E∫H(t,z)N(dt,dz)=E∫H(t,z)dtν(dz). The predictable hypothesis refers to a filtration in which future Poisson increments are independent of the past.

concepts.title: Poisson distribution
concepts.description: The distribution on nonnegative integers with masses P(N=k)=e⁻ˡλᵏ/k! for λ≥0.

concepts.title: Poisson kernel of the unit disk
concepts.description: For ζ on the unit circle and z in the disk, Pζ(z)=(1−|z|²)/|ζ−z|²; integrating it against boundary data gives harmonic extensions.

concepts.title: Poisson point process
concepts.description: A point process with intensity measure λ for which counts in disjoint measurable sets are independent and ξ(A) has Poisson law of mean λ(A) whenever λ(A)<∞.

concepts.title: Poisson random measure
concepts.description: An integer-valued random measure N with intensity ν such that N(A) is Poisson with meanν(A) for every finite-intensity measurable set A, and counts on disjoint sets are independent.

concepts.title: Poisson representation of positive harmonic functions on the disk
concepts.description: Every nonnegative harmonic function h on the unit disk is uniquely h(z)=∫_T(1−|z|²)/|ζ−z|²dμ(ζ) for a finite positive Borel measure μ on the unit circle.

concepts.title: Polar coordinates in the Euclidean plane
concepts.description: A point is written (r cosθ,r sinθ) with r≥0; away from zero, r>0 and the angle is understood modulo2π.

concepts.title: de Polignac’s conjecture on consecutive prime gaps
concepts.description: Every positive even integer occurs infinitely often as the gap between consecutive primes.

concepts.title: Polish space
concepts.description: A topological space admitting a complete separable metric that induces its topology.

concepts.title: Polymath’s prime distribution to fourfold densely divisible moduli
concepts.description: If ϖ,δ>0 satisfy600ϖ+180δ<7, the Motohashi–Pintz–Zhang discrepancy estimate holds for squarefree4-tuply x^δ-densely divisible moduli q≤x^(1/2+2ϖ−ε), for every ε>0: uniformly over bounded prime sets I and a coprime to P_I, the sum over q dividing P_I of |Δ(Λ1_[x,2x];a mod q)| is O_A(x/(log x)^A). Here Δ subtracts the coprime-class mean.

concepts.title: Division algorithm for polynomials over a field
concepts.description: For polynomials a,b over a field with b≠0, there are unique polynomials q,r with a=bq+r and either r=0 or deg r<deg b.

concepts.title: Polynomial over a field
concepts.description: A formal finite sum a₀+a₁x+⋯+aₙxⁿ with coefficients in a field, with the usual coefficientwise addition and multiplication.

concepts.title: Polynomial ring over a commutative ring
concepts.description: The ring R[X₁,…,X_n] of formal finite sums of monomials with coefficients in R, with coefficientwise addition and the usual multiplication of monomials.

concepts.title: Approximation of a convex body by polytopes
concepts.description: Every Euclidean convex body is a Hausdorff limit of convex hulls of finite point sets.

concepts.title: Portmanteau theorem for probability measures
concepts.description: For probability measures on a metric space, weak convergence μ_n⇒μ is equivalent to limsup μ_n(F)≤μ(F) for every closed F, and equivalently to liminf μ_n(G)≥μ(G) for every open G.

concepts.title: Positional base-b expansion of a nonnegative integer
concepts.description: For an integer base b≥2, write x=∑_{i=0}^{n−1}aᵢbⁱ with digits0≤aᵢ<b and a nonzero leading digit when x>0;0 has the zero expansion.

concepts.title: Norm closedness of the positive cone of a C*-algebra
concepts.description: A norm limit of positive elements of a C*-algebra is positive.

concepts.title: Positive definite complex kernel
concepts.description: A kernel K:X×X→ℂ is positive definite if ∑ᵢⱼcᵢc̄ⱼK(xᵢ,xⱼ)≥0 for every finite choice of points xᵢ and scalars cᵢ.

concepts.title: Positive definite real matrix
concepts.description: A symmetric real matrix A such that xᵀAx>0 for every nonzero real column vector x.

concepts.title: Positive distributions are Radon measures
concepts.description: A distribution T satisfying T(φ)≥0 for every nonnegative smooth compactly supported test function is integration against a unique positive Radon measure.

concepts.title: Positive element and order in a C*-algebra
concepts.description: An element is positive if it has the form b*b. For self-adjoint a,b, write a≤b when b−a is positive.

concepts.title: Order-unit bound for a positive C*-algebra element
concepts.description: For positive a in a C*-algebra, a≤∥a∥1 in its unitization.

concepts.title: Positive linear functional on a complex *-algebra
concepts.description: A complex linear map φ:A→ℂ satisfying φ(a*a)≥0 for all a∈A; neither a C*-norm on A nor continuity is assumed.

concepts.title: Positive linear functional on a C*-algebra
concepts.description: A complex linear map φ:A→ℂ satisfying φ(a*a)≥0 for every a∈A.

concepts.title: Bounded positive operator
concepts.description: A bounded self-adjoint operator A is positive, written A≥0, if ⟨Ax,x⟩≥0 for every vector x.

concepts.title: Positive semidefinite real matrix
concepts.description: A symmetric real matrix A such that xᵀAx≥0 for every real column vector x.

concepts.title: Positive square root in a C*-algebra
concepts.description: Every positive element a of a C*-algebra has a unique positive element b with b²=a. For any a, its absolute value is |a|=(a*a)¹ᐟ².

concepts.title: Potts model on a finite graph
concepts.description: A finite-state spin at every vertex receives Gibbs weight determined by whether adjacent spins agree; the antiferromagnetic model penalizes agreement.

concepts.title: Powell’s fixed-window limit under long-survival conditioning
concepts.description: For the critical killed branching diffusion on a bounded C¹ domain under the survival-asymptotic hypotheses, for every fixed T and event B measurable through time T, lim_{t→∞}P_x(B|N_t>0)=Q_x(B), where Q_x is the additive-martingale spine law.

concepts.title: Predictable stochastic process
concepts.description: A process measurable for the σ-algebra on time×sample space generated by adapted left-continuous processes. This formalizes choosing an integrand from information available just before the integration time.

concepts.title: Preimage of a subset under a function
concepts.description: For f:A→B and E⊆B, f⁻¹(E)={x∈A:f(x)∈E}.

concepts.title: Prime number
concepts.description: An integer p>1 is prime if its only positive divisors are 1 and p.

concepts.title: Prime ideal of a commutative ring
concepts.description: A proper ideal P of a commutative ring R such that ab in P implies a in P or b in P.

concepts.title: Prime number theorem with de la Vallée Poussin’s error term
concepts.description: There is c>0 for which ψ(x)=x+O(x exp(−c√log x)) as x→∞, where ψ(x)=∑_{n≤x}Λ(n).

concepts.title: Primitive polynomial over a finite field
concepts.description: A monic irreducible polynomial p of degree s over F_q is primitive if the residue class of x generates the multiplicative group of the field F_q[x]/(p), which has qˢ elements.

concepts.title: Principal component analysis of a random vector
concepts.description: For a square-integrable real vector, choose orthonormal eigenvectors of its covariance matrix in decreasing eigenvalue order. Projection onto the first k such vectors captures the largest possible sum of coordinate variances among k-dimensional orthogonal projections.

concepts.title: Principal even part of a subfactor
concepts.description: For a finite-index II₁ subfactor N⊂M, the tensor category of N–N bimodules generated by L²(M), closing under finite sums, summands and duals.

concepts.title: Principal extended Haagerup fusion category
concepts.description: The principal even part of the extended Haagerup subfactor, considered as a fusion category over ℂ.

concepts.title: Principal graph pair of a finite-index subfactor
concepts.description: The pair of rooted bipartite graphs recording tensoring with the generating N–M Hilbert bimodule and its dual. Even vertices are simple N–N or M–M bimodules, odd vertices are simple mixed bimodules, and edge multiplicities count their summands. The graphs may be infinite.

concepts.title: Principal Haagerup fusion category
concepts.description: The principal even part of the Haagerup subfactor, considered as a fusion category over ℂ.

concepts.title: Probability density relative to a measure
concepts.description: A nonnegative measurable function P with ∫P dμ=1; the measure P dμ is the corresponding probability measure.

concepts.title: Probability generating function
concepts.description: For a nonnegative integer-valued random variable A, G(s)=E[sᴬ]=∑_{k≥0}P(A=k)sᵏ for 0≤s≤1, with extension where the series converges.

concepts.title: Probability mass function on a finite set
concepts.description: A function p from a finite set Ω to [0,1] satisfying ∑_{ω∈Ω}p(ω)=1; the probability of A⊆Ω is ∑_{ω∈A}p(ω).

concepts.title: Probability space
concepts.description: A probability space is (Ω,𝔽,P), where 𝔽 is a σ-algebra on Ω and P is a measure on 𝔽 with P(Ω)=1.

concepts.title: Product of categories
concepts.description: C×D has pairs of objects and pairs of morphisms, with identities and composition defined componentwise.

concepts.title: Product measure
concepts.description: For σ-finite measure spaces, the product measure on the product σ-algebra assigns a measurable rectangle A×B the value μ(A)ν(B); its completion also includes subsets of product-null sets.

concepts.title: Product topology
concepts.description: On a Cartesian product of topological spaces, the topology with basic open sets restricting finitely many coordinates to open subsets and leaving all other coordinates unrestricted.

concepts.title: Product of finite-dimensional subspaces of a field extension
concepts.description: For a field extension L/F and finite-dimensional F-subspaces S,T⊆L, their product ST is the F-linear span of {st:s∈S,t∈T}. It is spanned by products of basis vectors of S and T.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Projection body of a convex body
concepts.description: The origin-symmetric convex body ΠK whose support function at a unit vector u is the (d−1)-dimensional volume of the orthogonal projection of K onto u⊥.

concepts.title: Local attraction of the ball under projection-body iteration
concepts.description: For each d≥3 there is ε_d>0 such that if a convex body K has absolutely continuous surface area measure and ∥f_{TK}−1∥∞<ε_d for some invertible linear T, then ΠᵐK converges to the Euclidean ball up to linear equivalence, in Banach–Mazur distance.

concepts.title: Prokhorov’s theorem on Polish spaces
concepts.description: A family of probability measures on a Polish space is relatively compact for weak convergence if and only if it is tight; in particular every tight sequence has a weakly convergent subsequence.

concepts.title: Proper convex extended-real functional
concepts.description: A function R:V→(−∞,∞] on a real vector space is proper if it is finite somewhere and is convex if R((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)R(x)+tR(y) for 0≤t≤1.

concepts.title: Pullback of a scalar or ambient-valued function between surfaces
concepts.description: For a diffeomorphism Φ:M→N, the pullback of f:N→V is Φ*f=f∘Φ. This is composition of functions, not the derivative-based pullback of tangent vector fields.

concepts.title: Pure drift chain on uniformly rewired cycle arcs
concepts.description: Cut a directed cycle at k uniformly chosen distinct edges into arcs. Along each remaining arc the chain moves deterministically forward; at an arc endpoint it chooses the start of one of the k arcs uniformly. Equivalently one can begin with k independent positive geometric arc lengths and then condition their sum to obtain a fixed-size model.

concepts.title: Pushforward measure
concepts.description: For a measurable map f:X→Y and measure μ on X, the pushforward f_*μ on Y satisfies f_*μ(B)=μ(f⁻¹(B)).

concepts.title: Pythagorean pair for a non-extreme scalar Schur function
concepts.description: For a non-extreme b, a pair (b,a) has a∈H∞ outer, a(0)>0, and |a|²+|b|²=1 almost everywhere on the unit circle.

concepts.title: Pythagorean theorem
concepts.description: In a Euclidean right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse length is the sum of the squares of the two leg lengths.

concepts.title: Pythagorean triple
concepts.description: A triple of positive integers (a,b,c) satisfying a²+b²=c².

concepts.title: Quadratic covariation of continuous semimartingales
concepts.description: For continuous semimartingales X,Y, [X,Y]_t is the limit in probability of sums ∑(X_{t_{i+1}}−X_{t_i})(Y_{t_{i+1}}−Y_{t_i}) as the partition mesh tends to zero.

concepts.title: Source condition for a differentiable quadratic Tikhonov penalty
concepts.description: Let F:X→Y be bounded linear between real Hilbert spaces and R a differentiable quadratic penalty. The variational source condition at x† is R′(x†)=F′w for some w∈Y*, where F′w=w∘F and R′(x†)∈X*. Under Hilbert-space identifications this is the usual adjoint range condition, with constant factors absorbed in w.

concepts.title: Quantum group U_q(𝔤₂)
concepts.description: The Drinfeld–Jimbo quantized enveloping algebra of 𝔤₂; in the braid-generation theorem q is indeterminate and the coefficient field is ℂ(q).

concepts.title: Quantum integer
concepts.description: For n≥1, [n]_q=qⁿ⁻¹+qⁿ⁻³+⋯+q¹⁻ⁿ, and [0]_q=0. Equivalently [n]_q=(qⁿ−q⁻ⁿ)/(q−q⁻¹) when the quotient is defined; the Laurent polynomial also specializes at q=±1.

concepts.title: Quasi-Gibbs measure for a point process
concepts.description: For specified one-body and pair potentials Φ,Ψ, a point-process law is quasi-Gibbs if its restriction to configurations with m particles in each bounded region can be approximated increasingly by submeasures whose conditional inside laws, given the outside configuration, are bounded above and below by positive multiples of exp(−H_inside) times Poisson reference measure restricted to m particles. Constants may depend on the region, particle number, approximation level and outside configuration.

concepts.title: Quasi-Monte Carlo integration
concepts.description: Approximate an integral on [0,1]ˢ by the average of the integrand over a deterministic point set chosen for uniform coverage, typically of low discrepancy; other input laws can be sampled by a transformation of these points.
