concepts.title: Quasi-normed vector space
concepts.description: A real or complex vector space with a positive definite absolutely homogeneous function q satisfying q(x+y)≤C(q(x)+q(y)) for a fixed C≥1.

concepts.title: Quasi-regular symmetric Dirichlet form
concepts.description: A symmetric Dirichlet form on L²(X,m) is quasi-regular if it has a nest of compact sets, an E₁-dense subset of its domain with quasi-continuous versions, and countably many domain elements with quasi-continuous versions separating all points outside an exceptional set.

concepts.title: Regular representation theorem for quasi-regular Dirichlet forms
concepts.description: Every quasi-regular Dirichlet form is quasi-homeomorphic to a regular Dirichlet form on a locally compact separable metric space; conversely such a quasi-homeomorphic image of a regular form is quasi-regular.

concepts.title: Quasimodular form
concepts.description: A holomorphic function whose weight-k modular transformation differs by a finite polynomial in c/(cτ+d), with holomorphic coefficient functions and the required cusp-growth conditions; equivalently the holomorphic part of an almost holomorphic modular form.

concepts.title: Quermassintegral of a convex body
concepts.description: For a convex body K⊂ℝᵈ, W_i(K)=V(K[d−i],B₂ᵈ[i]), where brackets denote repeated arguments and B₂ᵈ is the unit Euclidean ball.

concepts.title: Quotient of an abelian group by a subgroup
concepts.description: For an abelian group G and subgroup H,the cosets G/H form an abelian group under (g+H)+(g′+H)=g+g′+H.

concepts.title: Quotient of a commutative ring by an ideal
concepts.description: For an ideal I of R, the cosets R/I form a ring under (r+I)+(s+I)=r+s+I and (r+I)(s+I)=rs+I.

concepts.title: Quotient of a group by a normal subgroup
concepts.description: For a normal subgroup H of G, the cosets G/H form a group under (gH)(g′H)=gg′H.

concepts.title: Quotient Haar measure for unimodular groups
concepts.description: For a closed unimodular subgroup H of a unimodular locally compact group G with fixed Haar measures, the right G-invariant measure on H∖G characterized by ∫_G f(g)dg=∫_(H∖G)∫_H f(hg)dh d[g] for compactly supported continuous f.

concepts.title: Quotient of a linear category by an ideal
concepts.description: For a k-linear category C and a linear ideal I closed under composition on either side, C/I has the same objects and morphism spaces Hom_C(X,Y)/I(X,Y), with induced composition.

concepts.title: Quotient module
concepts.description: For a submodule N of an R-module M, the cosets M/N carry addition and scalar multiplication induced from M.

concepts.title: Quotient topology
concepts.description: For a surjection q:X→Y, a subset U⊆Y is open exactly when q⁻¹(U) is open in X.

concepts.title: Quotient vector space
concepts.description: For a subspace U⊆V, the cosets V/U form a vector space with addition and scalar multiplication induced from V.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Radon measure
concepts.description: A Borel measure on a Hausdorff topological space that is finite on compact sets and inner regular: the measure of every Borel set is the supremum of the measures of its compact subsets.

concepts.title: Radon–Nikodym derivative of a measure
concepts.description: A nonnegative measurable function f representing ν relative to μ by ν(A)=∫_A f dμ for every measurable A; it is defined up to μ-almost-everywhere equality when such a density exists.

concepts.title: Ramanujan delta modular form
concepts.description: The normalized weight-12 cusp form Δ=(E₄³−E₆²)/1728=q∏_{n≥1}(1−q^n)^24 for SL₂(Z), where q=exp(2πiτ).

concepts.title: Ramification index of a finite extension of discretely valued fields
concepts.description: For L/K with compatible normalized discrete valuations v_L,v_K, the positive integer e satisfying v_L(x)=e v_K(x) for every x in K×; equivalently [v_L(L×):v_L(K×)]=e.

concepts.title: Two-color uniform Ramsey number Rᵣ(s,t)
concepts.description: Rᵣ(s,t) is the least N such that every red–blue r-subset coloring on N elements has a red-homogeneous s-set or a blue-homogeneous t-set; set it to ∞ if there is no such N.

concepts.title: Random closed set in a Polish space
concepts.description: A nonempty closed-set-valued map A(ω) for which ω↦d(x,A(ω)) is measurable for every fixed x. It is a random compact set if its values are compact almost surely.

concepts.title: Uniform random k-SAT model
concepts.description: A Boolean formula on n variables formed by m independent clauses, each uniformly chosen from the 2ᵏ·binomial(n,k) clauses containing k distinct variables, each independently negated or unnegated.

concepts.title: Randomly shifted quasi-Monte Carlo rule
concepts.description: Add one uniform random vector in [0,1]ˢ to every point of a deterministic quadrature set, reducing coordinates modulo one. Independent shifts give independent randomized estimates; digital shifts use digitwise addition in a fixed base instead.

concepts.title: Randomized stopping time
concepts.description: A stopping time after the process filtration has been enlarged by auxiliary randomization independent of the original process.

concepts.title: Rank of a linear map
concepts.description: The dimension of the image of a linear map.

concepts.title: Rational form of a tensor category
concepts.description: For fields k⊂K and a semisimple K-linear abelian tensor category C_K, a rational form over k is a semisimple k-linear abelian tensor category C_k with a tensor equivalence Kar(C_k⊗_k K)≃C_K. The additional tensor structure must be preserved.

concepts.title: Rational function over a field
concepts.description: An element of k(x), represented by a quotient p(x)/q(x) of polynomials over k with q≠0; two quotients are equal when their cross-products agree.

concepts.title: Rational number
concepts.description: A real x is rational if x=a/b for integers a,b with b≠0; otherwise it is irrational.

concepts.title: Rational points of an affine algebraic group
concepts.description: For an affine F-group G with coordinate Hopf algebra A and commutative F-algebra R, the group G(R)=Hom_(F-alg)(A,R), with group multiplication induced by the coproduct of A.

concepts.title: Rational parametrization of the unit circle
concepts.description: The map t↦((1−t²)/(1+t²),2t/(1+t²)) from Q to rational points of x²+y²=1 other than (−1,0). Its inverse is t=y/(1+x); t∈(0,1) describes the positive quadrant after exchanging coordinates if desired.

concepts.title: Real cosine function
concepts.description: For real t, cos(t) is the real part of exp(it).

concepts.title: Real exponential function
concepts.description: The real function exp(x)=∑_{n≥0}xⁿ/n!, whose series converges for every real x.

concepts.title: Real Hilbert space
concepts.description: A real inner-product space complete for its induced norm metric.

concepts.title: Real inner-product space
concepts.description: A real vector space with a symmetric bilinear form ⟨x,y⟩ that is positive on ⟨x,x⟩ for x≠0; its induced norm is √⟨x,x⟩.

concepts.title: Real Lie group
concepts.description: A group that is a smooth real manifold, with smooth multiplication and inversion.

concepts.title: Natural logarithm
concepts.description: The inverse ln:(0,∞)→ℝ of the real exponential function.

concepts.title: Real polynomial in finitely many variables
concepts.description: A finite real linear combination of monomials x₁^{a₁}⋯x_d^{a_d} with nonnegative integer exponents.

concepts.title: Real number
concepts.description: A real number is an element of a complete ordered field ℝ; completeness means every nonempty subset bounded above has a least upper bound.

concepts.title: Real polynomial
concepts.description: A real polynomial is a finite sum ∑ⱼ₌₀ᵐaⱼxʲ with real coefficients and nonnegative integer m.

concepts.title: Real power of a positive real number
concepts.description: For x>0 and p∈ℝ, define xᵖ=exp(p log x). For p>0 extend by 0ᵖ=0.

concepts.title: Real-valued random variable
concepts.description: A real-valued random variable is a measurable map from a probability space to ℝ with its Borel σ-algebra.

concepts.title: Real sequence
concepts.description: A real sequence is a function a:ℕ₊→ℝ, written (aₙ)ₙ≥1.

concepts.title: Convergent real series
concepts.description: The series ∑ₙ≥1aₙ converges to S if its sequence of partial sums converges to S.

concepts.title: Rectangular average of a real random array
concepts.description: For positive integer indices, the rectangular average at (n₁,…,nᵣ) is (∏ⱼnⱼ)⁻¹∑₁≤ᵢⱼ≤ₙⱼXᵢ₁,…,ᵢᵣ. Its joint limit means that every nⱼ tends to infinity.

concepts.title: Infinitely recurring prime difference
concepts.description: A positive integer d such that p−q=d for infinitely many pairs of prime numbers p,q; the two primes need not be consecutive. Benatar calls these de Polignac numbers, a convention distinguished here from consecutive prime gaps.

concepts.title: Reduced Palm distribution of a point process
concepts.description: The disintegration μ_x of the reduced Campbell measure: E∑_{x∈ξ}F(x,ξ−δ_x)=∫E_{μ_x}F(x,η)ρ⁽¹⁾(x)dx. It describes the remaining configuration viewed conditional on a point at x, without conditioning on a usually null event.

concepts.title: Refinable trace on an ordered abelian group
concepts.description: A positive trace τ is refinable if every equality τ(g)=∑ᵢτ(aᵢ),with g,aᵢ positive and g nonzero,can be realized by positive aᵢ′ with g=∑ᵢaᵢ′ and τ(aᵢ′)=τ(aᵢ).

concepts.title: Reflexive Banach space
concepts.description: A Banach space X for which the canonical isometric map X→X**, sending x to the functional ℓ↦ℓ(x), is onto.

concepts.title: Regular symmetric Dirichlet form
concepts.description: A symmetric Dirichlet form on L²(E,m), where E is locally compact separable metric and m is a full-support Radon measure, is regular if its domain intersected with compactly supported continuous functions is dense both in the domain’s E₁ norm and in C_c(E) for the uniform norm.

concepts.title: Hunt-process existence for regular symmetric Dirichlet forms
concepts.description: A regular symmetric Dirichlet form on a locally compact separable metric space with full-support Radon reference measure has an associated symmetric Hunt process, outside a properly exceptional set, whose transition semigroup agrees with the L² semigroup of the form.

concepts.title: Bapst–Coja-Oghlan regularity lemma for probability measures on discrete cubes
concepts.description: For finite Ω and ε>0, every measure on Ωⁿ for sufficiently large n admits coordinate and state partitions of bounded total size N(ε,Ω), refining any coordinate partition with at most 1/ε classes. Apart from total mass ε and εn exceptional coordinates, conditioning on a state makes empirical spin distributions regular on each coordinate class: all subsets of relative size at least ε have expected total variation discrepancy below ε from the full class’s empirical distribution. Within each state, empirical distributions on each class have diameter below ε; the unconditioned measure is regular as well.

concepts.title: Penalty-minimizing solution of an inverse problem
concepts.description: An R-minimizing solution of Fx=y minimizes the penalty R among all exact solutions of that equation.

concepts.title: Relative entropy of finite probability distributions
concepts.description: D(p∥q)=∑_ωp(ω)ln(p(ω)/q(ω)), with a positive p(ω) and zero q(ω) giving +∞ and zero p terms contributing zero.

concepts.title: Relatively τ-elliptic element
concepts.description: A relatively τ-semisimple element γ whose relevant twisted centralizer,modulo the central torus specified by the involution setup,is anisotropic over the ground field.

concepts.title: Twisted relative orbit for two involutions
concepts.description: Given G=Res_{M/F}G₀ with commuting involutions σ and τ,and θ=στ,the relative classes are double cosets G^σ(k)∖G(k)/G^θ(k); geometric relative classes permit the acting elements over an algebraic closure.

concepts.title: Relatively τ-semisimple element
concepts.description: In the commuting-involution setting θ=στ,an element γ is relatively τ-semisimple when δ=γγ^{-θ} is τ-semisimple,meaning δδ^τ is semisimple.

concepts.title: Relatively compact subset of a topological space
concepts.description: A subset whose closure is compact.

concepts.title: Rellich compactness of H₀¹ into L² on a bounded domain
concepts.description: For a bounded Euclidean domain, the inclusion H₀¹(Ω)→L²(Ω) is compact.

concepts.title: Su's rental harmony theorem
concepts.description: For n participants and rooms, let pᵢ≥0 and ∑pᵢ=R>0. Suppose preferred-room sets are nonempty and closed, and contain only free rooms whenever some room is free. Then some price vector admits a bijection assigning every participant a preferred room.

concepts.title: Representable functor
concepts.description: A functor naturally isomorphic to Hom(A,−), or to Hom(−,A) in the contravariant case.

concepts.title: Representing measure for a point of a compact convex set
concepts.description: A Borel probability measure μ on a compact convex subset K of a locally convex space represents x∈K if ∫_K f dμ=f(x) for every continuous affine real function f on K.

concepts.title: Reproducing kernel Hilbert space
concepts.description: A Hilbert space of scalar functions on a set X in which evaluation at every x∈X is a bounded linear functional; its reproducing kernel satisfies f(x)=⟨f,kₓ⟩.

concepts.title: Residual subset of a topological space
concepts.description: A subset whose complement is meagre.

concepts.title: Residue field of a discretely valued field
concepts.description: The quotient O_v/m_v of the valuation ring by its maximal ideal.

concepts.title: Restricted product of topological groups
concepts.description: For groups G_i with chosen open subgroups K_i, the group of tuples g_i with g_i∈K_i for all but finitely many i, with the topology whose basic opens are products of open sets equal to K_i outside finitely many coordinates.

concepts.title: Restricted tensor product of vector spaces
concepts.description: For vector spaces V_i with specified nonzero reference vectors v_i, the vector space spanned by tensors ⊗_i w_i for which w_i=v_i outside a finite set, subject to the usual multilinear relations. This is the algebraic restricted tensor product, without a Hilbert completion.

concepts.title: Restriction of scalars of an algebraic group
concepts.description: For a finite field extension M/F and an M-group H, Res_{M/F}H is the F-group with R-points H(R⊗_F M) for each F-algebra R.

concepts.title: Reverse Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for a form of positive index at most one
concepts.description: If a real symmetric bilinear form B has no two-dimensional positive definite subspace, then B(x,y)²≥B(x,x)B(y,y) whenever B(y,y)>0.

concepts.title: Reversible finite Markov chain
concepts.description: A finite Markov chain with a positive stationary distribution π satisfying detailed balance; under π its finite path laws are invariant under reversal of time.

concepts.title: Ribbon category
concepts.description: A braided rigid monoidal category with a twist compatible with both the braiding and duality.

concepts.title: Richter–Westerholt-Raum Sturm bound for Siegel modular forms
concepts.description: For a degree-g≥2, weight-k Siegel modular form with p-integral rational Fourier coefficients, vanishing modulo p of all c(T) with every tᵢᵢ≤(4/3)^g k/16 forces vanishing of every coefficient. For p≥5 the bound improves to (4/3)^g·9k/160.

concepts.title: Riemann integral
concepts.description: A bounded f:[a,b]→ℝ has Riemann integral I if all tagged Riemann sums approach I as the maximum length of the partition intervals tends to zero.

concepts.title: Interval additivity of the Riemann integral
concepts.description: For integrable f on [a,b] and c∈[a,b], ∫_a^b f=∫_a^c f+∫_c^b f, with the usual orientation convention.

concepts.title: Linearity of the Riemann integral
concepts.description: If f,g are Riemann integrable on the same compact interval and a,b are real, af+bg is integrable and ∫(af+bg)=a∫f+b∫g.

concepts.title: Order bounds for the Riemann integral
concepts.description: If integrable f satisfies m≤f≤M on [a,b], then m(b−a)≤∫_a^b f≤M(b−a).

concepts.title: Riemann’s removable singularity theorem
concepts.description: A holomorphic function on a punctured neighborhood of a complex point extends holomorphically across that point if it is bounded near the point.

concepts.title: Tagged Riemann sum
concepts.description: For a partition a=x₀<⋯<x_n=b and tags t_i∈[x_{i−1},x_i], the Riemann sum of f is ∑ᵢf(t_i)(x_i−x_{i−1}); the partition mesh is maxᵢ(x_i−x_{i−1}).

concepts.title: Riesz decomposition property for an ordered abelian group
concepts.description: Whenever0≤a≤b+c with b,c≥0, there are0≤b₁≤b and0≤c₁≤c with a=b₁+c₁.

concepts.title: Riesz decomposition for positive superharmonic functions on the disk
concepts.description: A positive superharmonic function on the unit disk decomposes uniquely into a Green potential of a positive locally finite measure and a positive harmonic function; the harmonic part has a positive boundary-measure Poisson representation.

concepts.title: Riesz–Markov representation on a compact space
concepts.description: Every positive linear functional on the continuous real functions on a compact Hausdorff space is integration against a unique finite regular Borel measure.

concepts.title: Riesz representation theorem for Hilbert-space functionals
concepts.description: Every bounded linear functional on a real Hilbert space is uniquely of the form x↦⟨x,y⟩ for some y in that Hilbert space, with norm‖y‖.

concepts.title: Gilbert–Shannon–Reeds riffle shuffle
concepts.description: Split a deck at a binomially chosen position and interleave the two packets uniformly while preserving each packet’s internal order. Repeating gives a Markov chain on permutations.

concepts.title: Right-continuous path
concepts.description: A path x:[0,∞)→E in a metric space is right-continuous if d(x(t+h),x(t))→0 as h↓0 for every t≥0.

concepts.title: Right module over a complex algebra
concepts.description: A complex vector space X with a bilinear action X×A→X satisfying (xa)b=x(ab); for a unital algebra the action is taken to satisfy x1=x.

concepts.title: Right triangle in Euclidean space
concepts.description: A nondegenerate triangle with vertices a,a+u,a+v for nonzero Euclidean vectors u,v satisfying u·v=0, where u·v is the sum of coordinate products. The side from a+u to a+v is the hypotenuse.

concepts.title: Rigid monoidal category
concepts.description: A monoidal category in which every object has left and right duals, with evaluation and coevaluation maps satisfying the zigzag identities.

concepts.title: Homomorphism of commutative rings
concepts.description: A map between commutative rings preserving addition, multiplication and the multiplicative identity.

concepts.title: Ideal of a commutative ring
concepts.description: An additive subgroup I of a commutative ring R such that ri belongs to I for every r in R and i in I.

concepts.title: Ring of integers of a number field
concepts.description: The subring O_K of a number field K consisting of its elements integral over Z, namely the roots in K of monic integer-coefficient polynomials.

concepts.title: Risk-neutral valuation of contingent claims
concepts.description: Under a specified probability measure making discounted traded asset prices martingales, the arbitrage-free price of a replicable claim is the conditional expectation of its discounted payoff, subject to the market model and integrability hypotheses.

concepts.title: Rolle’s theorem
concepts.description: If f is continuous on [a,b], differentiable on (a,b), and f(a)=f(b), then f′(c)=0 for some c∈(a,b).

concepts.title: Root of unity
concepts.description: In a field, a root of unity is an element ζ with ζⁿ=1 for some positive integer n; its order is the least such n.

concepts.title: Rooted locally finite graph
concepts.description: A connected graph with a distinguished root and finitely many incident edges at every vertex; finite-radius rooted neighborhoods retain their induced graph structure.

concepts.title: Rooted finitely branching tree
concepts.description: A rooted tree is a connected acyclic graph with a distinguished root. It is finitely branching if every vertex has finitely many children, meaning adjacent vertices one edge farther from the root.

concepts.title: Rose’s generalized sum-of-divisor functions
concepts.description: For a positive integer n,a set S⊆{1,…,n} stable under negation modulo n,and k≥1, A_{S,n,k}(q)=∑_{0<m₁<⋯<mₖ, mᵢ mod n∈S}q^{m₁+⋯+mₖ}/∏ᵢ(1−q^{mᵢ})² for∣q∣<1.

concepts.title: Rotational eigenvector in a planar algebra
concepts.description: A nonzero n-box S, n>0, satisfying ρ(S)=ωS for the shading-preserving two-click rotation ρ. Since ρⁿ=id, its eigenvalue ω is an nth root of unity.

concepts.title: S-matrix of a ribbon fusion category
concepts.description: For a ribbon fusion category over ℂ, the S-matrix is indexed by simple objects; its (X,Y) entry is the categorical trace of c(Y,X)c(X,Y) on X⊗Y. This is the unnormalized Hopf-link convention.

concepts.title: Sarason’s Toeplitz characterization of H(b) for non-extreme b
concepts.description: For a Pythagorean pair (b,a), f∈H² lies in H(b) exactly when T_{b̄}f=T_{ā}g for some g∈H². That g is unique and ∥f∥²_{H(b)}=∥f∥²_{H²}+∥g∥²_{H²}.

concepts.title: Polynomial density in H(b) for non-extreme b
concepts.description: If b is a non-extreme scalar Schur function, analytic polynomials are dense in its de Branges–Rovnyak space H(b).

concepts.title: Saroglou–Zvavitch refinement of Lutwak’s quermassintegral inequality
concepts.description: For every convex body K⊂ℝᵈ, d≥3, W_{d−2}(Π_{d−2}K)≥[d(d−2)ω_{d−1}²/((d−1)²ω_d)]W_{d−1}(K)²+[ω_{d−1}²/(d−1)²]W_{d−2}(K), where ω_j is the j-dimensional unit ball volume. Equality holds for balls; the inequality is strict for bodies that are not centrally symmetric.

concepts.title: Scalar extension of a linear category
concepts.description: For k⊂K, replace each morphism space Hom(X,Y) by Hom(X,Y)⊗_k K, keeping the same objects and extending composition.

concepts.title: Schauder basis of a Banach space
concepts.description: A sequence (eₙ) in a Banach space for which every vector x has a unique expansion x=∑ₙaₙeₙ converging in norm.

concepts.title: Schlumprecht’s arbitrarily distortable Banach space
concepts.description: The completion of c₀₀ in the least norm satisfying ∥x∥=max{∥x∥∞,sup_{n≥2}(log₂(n+1))⁻¹ sup_{E₁<⋯<Eₙ}∑ᵢ∥Eᵢx∥}, where Eᵢ are successive finite coordinate sets. Its unit vector basis is unconditional and subsymmetric.

concepts.title: Schneider’s projection-functional monotonicity theorem
concepts.description: For a full-dimensional convex body K⊂ℝᵈ, set P(K)=|ΠK|/|K|^{d−1}. Then P(K)≥P(ΠK), with equality exactly when K is homothetic to Π²K.

concepts.title: Scalar Schur algorithm on the unit disk
concepts.description: For a holomorphic disk map f with |f(0)|<1, replace f by (f(z)−f(0))/(z(1−overline{f(0)}f(z))) and iterate; Schwarz’s lemma makes the removable value at zero and the disk bound valid. The successive values at zero are its Schur parameters.

concepts.title: Schur's lemma
concepts.description: A nonzero morphism between simple objects of an abelian category is an isomorphism. Consequently, the endomorphism ring of a simple object is a division ring.

concepts.title: Schwartz space
concepts.description: The space S(ℝⁿ) of smooth functions φ for which supₓ|xᵅ∂ᵝφ(x)| is finite for every pair of multi-indices α,β, with the topology of these seminorms.

concepts.title: Schwarz lemma
concepts.description: If f maps the unit disk holomorphically to itself and f(0)=0, then |f(z)|≤|z| and |f′(0)|≤1. Equality at a nonzero point or in the derivative bound forces f(z)=cz with |c|=1.

concepts.title: Sharipov’s second cuboid conjecture
concepts.description: For distinct coprime positive integers p,q, the polynomial Qₚq(t)=t¹⁰+(2q²+p²)(3q²−2p²)t⁸+(q⁸+10p²q⁶+4p⁴q⁴−14p⁶q²+p⁸)t⁶−p²q²(q⁸−14p²q⁶+4p⁴q⁴+10p⁶q²+p⁸)t⁴−p⁶q⁶(q²+2p²)(3p²−2q²)t²−p¹⁰q¹⁰ is irreducible in ℤ[t]. The family comes from the second special case of the cuboid parametrization.

concepts.title: Perfect-cuboid criterion in the second-cuboid parametrization
concepts.description: For coprime distinct positive integers p,q and an integer root t of the degree-ten Q_{p,q} from the second cuboid conjecture, the corresponding parametrized cuboid is perfect exactly when t>max(p²,pq,q²) and (p²+t)(pq+t)>2t². This is a criterion within that parametrized family, not a claim that every perfect cuboid belongs to it.

concepts.title: Selberg sieve weight
concepts.description: A nonnegative arithmetic weight obtained by squaring a divisor sum, typically (∑_{d|P(n)}λ_d)² with coefficients λ_d supported on d≤R, designed to suppress values with small prime factors.

concepts.title: Norm of a bounded self-adjoint operator from its quadratic form
concepts.description: For a bounded self-adjoint operator A on a complex Hilbert space, ∥A∥=sup_{∥x∥=1}|⟨Ax,x⟩|.

concepts.title: Bounded self-adjoint operator
concepts.description: A bounded operator T on a complex Hilbert space is self-adjoint if T=T*.

concepts.title: Semi-inner-product C*-module
concepts.description: A right module X over a C*-algebra A with an A-valued form ⟨x,y⟩, complex linear and A-linear in y, conjugate symmetric, additive in each argument, and satisfying ⟨x,x⟩≥0. Zero length need not imply x=0; this is not the nonsymmetric semi-inner product used in Banach-space geometry.

concepts.title: Semidirect product of groups
concepts.description: Given a homomorphism α:G→Aut(H), the group H⋊_αG has underlying set H×G and multiplication (h,g)(h′,g′)=(hα(g)(h′),gg′).

concepts.title: Seminorm on a real or complex vector space
concepts.description: A nonnegative function p with p(ax)=|a|p(x) and p(x+y)≤p(x)+p(y); p may vanish on nonzero vectors.

concepts.title: Topology generated by a family of seminorms
concepts.description: For seminorms (p_i) on a vector space, a neighborhood base at zero consists of finite intersections of sets {x:p_i(x)<ε}; neighborhoods at other points are translates.

concepts.title: Semisimple abelian category
concepts.description: An abelian category in which every object is a finite direct sum of simple objects.

concepts.title: Semisimplification by negligible morphisms
concepts.description: Quotient a spherical linear category by its negligible morphisms and take the Karoubi envelope. Under the usual finiteness and nondegeneracy hypotheses this gives a semisimple category; the construction does not guarantee semisimplicity for an arbitrary pivotal category.

concepts.title: Separable closure of a field
concepts.description: A separable algebraic extension F^sep/F that has no further nontrivial finite separable algebraic extension, equivalently the separable elements in a chosen algebraic closure.

concepts.title: Separable algebraic field extension
concepts.description: An algebraic extension L/F is separable if the minimal polynomial over F of every element of L has distinct roots in an algebraic closure.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Separable metric space
concepts.description: A metric space having a countable dense subset.

concepts.title: Separable polynomial over a field
concepts.description: A polynomial having no repeated root in an algebraic closure of its coefficient field.

concepts.title: Separation distance from a positive finite distribution
concepts.description: For a probability mass function p and a strictly positive π, sep(p,π)=max_x(1−p(x)/π(x)). It is generally not symmetric.

concepts.title: Sequence in a set
concepts.description: A function from the natural numbers, or the positive natural numbers, to that set.

concepts.title: Limit of a real sequence
concepts.description: A sequence (aₙ) converges to L∈ℝ if for every ε>0 there is N such that n≥N implies abs(aₙ−L)<ε.

concepts.title: Sequential characterization of compact metric spaces
concepts.description: A metric space is compact exactly when every sequence has a convergent subsequence with limit in the space.

concepts.title: Set
concepts.description: A collection of distinct elements, regarded as one object.

concepts.title: Complement of a subset
concepts.description: For A⊆Ω, its complement Ω∖A consists of the elements of Ω that do not belong to A.

concepts.title: Sevast’yanov–Watanabe extinction criterion for bounded-domain branching diffusions
concepts.description: For a bounded connected sufficiently regular domain D, a symmetric uniformly elliptic killed diffusion with principal Dirichlet eigenvalue λ, and independent rate-β branching of mean m>1, survival forever has positive probability exactly when β(m−1)>λ. At and below criticality extinction is almost sure; the survival probability to t tends to zero uniformly over starting positions. Lipschitz boundary suffices.

concepts.title: Seven-dimensional fundamental representation of U_q(𝔤₂)
concepts.description: The irreducible fundamental U_q(𝔤₂)-module of dimension seven, deforming the smallest nontrivial representation of 𝔤₂.

concepts.title: Shaded planar algebra
concepts.description: Vector spaces P_{n,+},P_{n,−} acted on multilinearly by shaded planar tangles, compatibly with gluing and identity tangles.

concepts.title: Shaded planar tangle
concepts.description: A disc with interior discs and nonintersecting strings, with an even number of endpoints on each boundary, checkerboard-shaded complementary regions and marked boundary intervals; considered up to the prescribed isotopy.

concepts.title: Shannon entropy of a finite distribution
concepts.description: For a finite probability mass function p, H(p)=−∑_ωp(ω)ln p(ω), with 0ln0=0.

concepts.title: Shape operator of an oriented embedded surface
concepts.description: With a chosen unit normal field n, the shape operator is S_x(v)=−dn_x(v) on T_xM. This uses the −dn sign convention.

concepts.title: Sturm bound k/10 for degree-two Siegel modular forms
concepts.description: For p≥5 and an even-weight k Siegel modular form of degree two with p-integral coefficients, if all coefficients indexed by T have zero reduction whenever both diagonal entries are at most ⌊k/10⌋, then the form vanishes modulo p.

concepts.title: Scalar-valued Siegel modular form for the full modular group
concepts.description: A holomorphic function F on ℍ_g with F((AZ+B)(CZ+D)⁻¹)=det(CZ+D)^k F(Z) for integral symplectic matrices [[A,B],[C,D]], and a Fourier expansion supported on positive semidefinite half-integral symmetric matrices. For g=1 the cusp-holomorphy condition is included.

concepts.title: Siegel modular form for a congruence subgroup
concepts.description: A holomorphic function f on the degree-g Siegel upper half-space transforming as f((AZ+B)(CZ+D)⁻¹)=det(CZ+D)^k f(Z) under a congruence subgroup Γ⊂Sp(2g,Z), with holomorphy at all cusps; for g>1 the usual Koecher principle makes the cusp condition automatic.

concepts.title: Siegel upper half-space
concepts.description: The set ℍ_g of symmetric complex g×g matrices whose imaginary part is positive definite.

concepts.title: σ-algebra
concepts.description: A σ-algebra on Ω contains Ω and is closed under complements in Ω and countable unions.

concepts.title: σ-finite measure
concepts.description: A measure whose whole underlying space is a countable union of measurable sets of finite measure.

concepts.title: Sign of a permutation
concepts.description: The sign of a permutation of {1,…,n} is (−1) to the number of inversions, where an inversion is a pair i<j with σ(i)>σ(j).

concepts.title: Approximation of nonnegative measurable functions by simple functions
concepts.description: Every nonnegative measurable function is the pointwise increasing limit of nonnegative measurable simple functions.

concepts.title: Simple object in an abelian category
concepts.description: A nonzero object whose only subobjects are zero and itself.

concepts.title: Simple partially ordered abelian group
concepts.description: A nontrivial directed ordered abelian group in which every nonzero positive element is an order unit.

concepts.title: Geometric n-simplex
concepts.description: An n-simplex is conv(v₀,…,vₙ), where v₁−v₀,…,vₙ−v₀ are linearly independent. Its faces are the hulls of subsets of its vertices.

concepts.title: Triangulation of a geometric simplex
concepts.description: A triangulation of S is a finite collection of simplices covering S, closed under faces, such that any two members intersect in a common face or not at all.

concepts.title: Real sine function
concepts.description: The sine function is defined by the everywhere convergent power series sin(x)=∑ₖ≥0(−1)ᵏx²ᵏ⁺¹/(2k+1)!.

concepts.title: Singular value decomposition of a real matrix
concepts.description: Every real m×n matrix is UΣVᵀ with U,V orthogonal and Σ rectangular diagonal with nonnegative entries, its singular values.

concepts.title: Size-biased change of measure
concepts.description: Given a probability measure P and a nonnegative random variable W with 0<E_PW<∞, the W-biased measure is Q(A)=E_P[W·1_A]/E_PW; equivalently dQ/dP=W/E_PW.

concepts.title: Skorokhod divergence on Wiener space
concepts.description: The adjoint δ of the Malliavin derivative on L² Wiener space: u belongs to D(δ) when E⟨DF,u⟩=E[Fδ(u)] for all smooth cylindrical F, for some square-integrable δ(u). It extends the adapted Itô integral.

concepts.title: Smallest integer of a specified digit-power attraction height
concepts.description: For fixed b,e,u and h, σ_h(u) is the least positive integer whose first hit of u under S_{e,b} occurs at exactly h iterations, when this set is nonempty.

concepts.title: Smirnov class on the unit disk
concepts.description: The holomorphic functions on the unit disk expressible as b/a with a,b∈H∞ and a outer.

concepts.title: Smooth finitely presented commutative algebra
concepts.description: A finitely presented R-algebra A such that, for every R-algebra B with nilpotent ideal I, every R-algebra map A→B/I lifts to A→B. This is the infinitesimal lifting formulation of smoothness for affine finite-presentation algebras.

concepts.title: Smooth affine algebraic group
concepts.description: An affine algebraic group over F whose coordinate algebra is smooth over F. In the finite-type characteristic-zero case all affine group schemes are smooth, but that assertion is a separate theorem.

concepts.title: Smooth atom for dyadic function-space decompositions
concepts.description: A smooth atom associated to a dyadic cube Q is supported in a fixed dilation of Q, obeys scale-normalized derivative bounds up to a specified order, and has vanishing polynomial moments up to a specified order.

concepts.title: Smooth bump function on Euclidean space
concepts.description: A smooth real-valued function on R^n with compact support, often chosen to be one on a specified compact set and zero outside a prescribed open neighbourhood.

concepts.title: Smooth positively curved approximation of a convex body
concepts.description: Every full-dimensional Euclidean convex body is a Hausdorff limit of convex bodies with smooth support functions and positive definite curvature matrices.

concepts.title: Smooth domain in Euclidean space
concepts.description: An open connected Euclidean set whose boundary is locally the graph of a C∞ function, with the domain locally on one side.

concepts.title: Smooth integer
concepts.description: A positive integer whose prime factors are all at most a specified bound y; equivalently its largest prime factor P⁺(n) is at most y, with a harmless convention for n=1.

concepts.title: Smooth real manifold
concepts.description: A Hausdorff second-countable topological space with charts to open subsets of R^n whose transition maps are smooth. Smooth functions and maps are those whose expressions in these charts are smooth.

concepts.title: Smooth map between open Euclidean sets
concepts.description: A map on an open subset of ℝⁿ is smooth if all of its component partial derivatives of every order exist and are continuous.

concepts.title: Smooth molecule for dyadic function-space decompositions
concepts.description: A smooth molecule associated to a dyadic cube has prescribed vanishing moments and scale-normalized derivative bounds with polynomial decay away from that cube, instead of compact support.

concepts.title: Smooth stochastic flow for bounded smooth diffusion fields
concepts.description: For C_b∞ Stratonovich fields on ℝⁿ, the solution maps x↦X_t^x form a stochastic flow of C∞ diffeomorphisms, after choosing a suitable version. Their spatial derivatives and inverse Jacobians have all finite moments locally uniformly in time, uniformly in the starting point.

concepts.title: Smooth vector field on Euclidean space
concepts.description: A smooth map V:ℝⁿ→ℝⁿ, acting on smooth scalar functions by Vf=∑_iVⁱ∂_if.

concepts.title: Smooth vector field on a manifold
concepts.description: An R-linear derivation of the algebra C∞(M) of smooth real functions on a smooth manifold M. In local coordinates it acts as ∑_i X^i(x)∂_i with smooth coefficient functions.

concepts.title: Snake lemma for vector spaces
concepts.description: For a commuting diagram with exact rows 0→A→B→C→0 and 0→A′→B′→C′→0 and vertical maps a,b,c, there is a natural exact sequence 0→ker(a)→ker(b)→ker(c)→coker(a)→coker(b)→coker(c)→0.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Sobol sequence in a finite-dimensional unit cube
concepts.description: For each coordinate choose a primitive binary polynomial xˢ+a₁xˢ⁻¹+⋯+a_{s−1}x+1 and odd initial m_k<2ᵏ for1≤k≤s. Continue m_k=(⊕_{i=1}^{s−1}2ⁱa_im_{k−i})⊕2ˢm_{k−s}⊕m_{k−s}, and put v_k=m_k/2ᵏ. The n-th coordinate is ⊕_kn_kv_k, where n_k are binary digits of n. A standard first coordinate uses v_k=2⁻ᵏ. Gray-code indexing reorders each initial power-of-two block; polynomial and direction-number choices specify the sequence.

concepts.title: Sobolev space H₀¹ of a Euclidean domain
concepts.description: The closure of smooth compactly supported functions in the W¹,² norm. Its elements have zero boundary trace in the usual regular-domain setting.

concepts.title: Sobolev space H⁻¹ of a Euclidean domain
concepts.description: The continuous dual of H₀¹, with the Hilbert-space dual norm. A locally integrable function defines an element by pairing against test functions whenever that pairing extends continuously.

concepts.title: Completeness of Sobolev spaces
concepts.description: For integer k≥0 and1≤p≤∞, W^{k,p}(Ω) is a Banach space for the norm combining all weak-derivative Lᵖ norms. In particular W^{k,2} is Hilbert.

concepts.title: First-order Sobolev vector fields on an embedded surface
concepts.description: Vector fields with square-integrable components and square-integrable first weak surface derivatives, defined using smooth charts and the surface measure; tangent Sobolev fields additionally lie in each tangent plane almost everywhere.

concepts.title: First-order Sobolev space W¹,ᵖ
concepts.description: For an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ and 1≤p≤∞, W¹,ᵖ(Ω) consists of Lᵖ functions whose first weak partial derivatives are also in Lᵖ, with norm combining the function and derivative Lᵖ norms; vector-valued versions are componentwise.

concepts.title: Sobolev–Morrey bound for W¹,ᵖ on Euclidean space
concepts.description: If p>N, a function in W¹,ᵖ(ℝᴺ) has a bounded continuous representative with ‖f‖∞≤C‖f‖_{W¹,ᵖ}.

concepts.title: Sobolev embedding W²,ᵖ into continuous functions
concepts.description: On a bounded Lipschitz domain Ω⊂ℝᵈ, if1<p<∞ and2p>d, every W²,ᵖ function has a continuous representative on the closure, with sup norm bounded by C‖u‖_{W²,ᵖ}.

concepts.title: Sobolev space Wᵏ,ᵖ of a Euclidean domain
concepts.description: For integer k≥0 and1≤p≤∞, Wᵏ,ᵖ(Ω) consists of Lᵖ functions whose distributional partial derivatives Dᵅ for all |α|≤k also lie in Lᵖ. A norm combines the finitely many derivative Lᵖ norms.

concepts.title: Solvable group
concepts.description: A group whose iterated commutator subgroups reach the trivial subgroup after finitely many steps.

concepts.title: Solvable smooth affine algebraic group
concepts.description: A smooth affine algebraic group whose group of points over an algebraic closure is solvable. For the characteristic-zero groups used here this agrees with termination of the algebraic derived series.

concepts.title: Special linear group SL₂(ℤ)
concepts.description: The group of2×2 integer matrices [[a,b],[c,d]] satisfying ad−bc=1, with matrix multiplication.

concepts.title: Special linear group over a commutative ring
concepts.description: The group SL_n(R) of square matrices over a commutative ring R whose determinant is 1, with matrix multiplication.

concepts.title: Special standard Markov process
concepts.description: A right-continuous strong Markov process on a Lusin state space, with cemetery state, that is quasi-left-continuous: along stopping times T_n↑T, X_{T_n}→X_T on the event T is before the lifetime.

concepts.title: Spectral characterization of positive C*-algebra elements
concepts.description: An element of a C*-algebra has the form b*b exactly when it is self-adjoint with spectrum contained in [0,∞).

concepts.title: Spectral gap of a reversible finite Markov chain
concepts.description: For an irreducible reversible transition matrix with eigenvalues 1=λ₀>λ₁≥⋯, its spectral gap is 1−λ₁; the absolute spectral gap instead uses max_{i≥1}|λ_i|.

concepts.title: Spectral radius of a finite matrix
concepts.description: The maximum absolute value of the complex eigenvalues of the matrix.

concepts.title: Spectral radius in a complex Banach algebra
concepts.description: For an element a of a complex Banach algebra, its spectral radius is sup{|λ|:λ belongs to the spectrum of a}, using the unitization when the algebra has no identity.

concepts.title: Spectrum of an element of a complex Banach algebra
concepts.description: For a in a complex Banach algebra A, σ(a) consists of complex λ for which λ1−a has no two-sided inverse, using the unitization if A has no identity.

concepts.title: Sperner labeling of a triangulated simplex
concepts.description: For S=conv(v₀,…,vₙ), label each triangulation vertex by an element of {0,…,n}; a vertex on conv(vᵢ:i∈I) must have a label in I.

concepts.title: Sperner's lemma
concepts.description: Every Sperner-labeled triangulation of an n-simplex has an odd number of elementary n-simplices carrying all n+1 labels. In particular there is at least one.

concepts.title: Area measure on the Euclidean unit sphere
concepts.description: On S^{d−1}⊂ℝᵈ, spherical area is the restriction of (d−1)-dimensional Hausdorff measure. Its probability normalization divides by its total mass.

concepts.title: Spherical harmonic
concepts.description: The restriction to the unit sphere in ℝᵈ of a homogeneous polynomial annihilated by the Euclidean Laplacian. Its degree is the degree of that polynomial.

concepts.title: Spherical harmonic decomposition of L² of a sphere
concepts.description: The real Hilbert space L²(S^{n−1}) is the orthogonal sum of the finite-dimensional spaces of spherical harmonics of degrees k≥0; a polynomial of degree m restricts to a sum of harmonics of degrees at most m.

concepts.title: Normalized spherical Radon transform
concepts.description: For a function f on S^{d−1}, Rf(u) is its average over the equatorial sphere S^{d−1}∩u⊥; the normalization gives R1=1.

concepts.title: Split algebraic torus
concepts.description: An algebraic F-group isomorphic over F to a finite product of copies of G_m. An F-torus need only become such a product after extending F to an algebraic closure.

concepts.title: Split fusion category
concepts.description: A fusion category in which every simple object has endomorphism algebra k.

concepts.title: Split semisimple k-linear category
concepts.description: A semisimple k-linear abelian category in which every simple object is split.

concepts.title: Split semisimple algebra
concepts.description: A finite-dimensional algebra isomorphic to a finite product of full matrix algebras over its base field.

concepts.title: Split simple object in a k-linear abelian category
concepts.description: A simple object X in a k-linear abelian category is split if its scalar map k→End(X) is an isomorphism.

concepts.title: Splitting field for a semisimple algebra
concepts.description: For a finite-dimensional semisimple k-algebra A, a splitting field is an extension K/k for which K⊗_k A is a finite product of full matrix algebras over K.

concepts.title: Spreading model generated by a basic sequence
concepts.description: A basic sequence (xₙ) generates (ẽₙ) as a spreading model when for each finite scalar list (aᵢ), the asymptotic limits of ∥∑ᵢaᵢx_{nᵢ}∥ as the ordered indices move to infinity equal ∥∑ᵢaᵢẽᵢ∥.

concepts.title: Intrinsic squared norm of a simple object in a fusion category
concepts.description: For a simple X in a fusion category over ℂ, choose an isomorphism a:X→X**. The product Tr(a)Tr((a⁻¹)*) is independent of this choice and is called |X|². With a pivotal structure it equals dim(X)dim(X*).

concepts.title: Squarefree integer
concepts.description: A positive integer divisible by no square of a prime.

concepts.title: Stabilizer field of a finite-dimensional subspace
concepts.description: For a nonzero finite-dimensional F-subspace V⊆L in L/F, its stabilizer field is H(V)={x∈L:xV⊆V}. It contains F; every nonzero x in H(V) satisfies xV=V.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Translation stabilizer of a subset of an abelian group
concepts.description: For a subset A of an abelian group G, H(A)={g∈G:g+A=A}, a subgroup of G.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Star body about the origin
concepts.description: A compact set star shaped about 0 whose radial function ρ(u)=max{t≥0:tu∈K} on the unit sphere is positive and continuous.

concepts.title: Star discrepancy of a finite point set
concepts.description: For points x₁,…,x_N in [0,1]ˢ, D* is sup_{a∈[0,1]ˢ}|N⁻¹∑_i1_{x_i∈[0,a)}−∏_ja_j|.

concepts.title: Stationary distribution of a finite Markov chain
concepts.description: A probability row vector π satisfying πP=π for the chain’s transition matrix P.

concepts.title: Stochastic mesh method for conditional expectations
concepts.description: Approximate a Markov transition expectation by weighted values at simulated future states. With transition density p(s,x;t,y) and L simulated paths, a common weight at Y_j=X_j(t) is p(s,x;t,Y_j)/(Lq(Y_j)), where q(y)=L⁻¹∑_ℓp(s,X_ℓ(s);t,y); this reuses one random mesh for many starting states.

concepts.title: Stochastically monotone Markov kernel
concepts.description: On a partially ordered finite state space, P is monotone if Pf is increasing whenever f is increasing, equivalently P(x,·) is stochastically dominated by P(y,·) whenever x≤y.

concepts.title: Stochastic porous medium equation with additive noise
concepts.description: The evolution dX_t=[Δ(|X_t|^{m−1}X_t)+cX_t]dt+dW_t, m>1, on a specified domain with specified boundary conditions, interpreted variationally in a negative Sobolev state space when driven by Hilbert-valued additive Wiener noise.

concepts.title: Stochastic process
concepts.description: A family (X_t) indexed by a specified time set, with each X_t a measurable map from a probability space into a specified measurable state space. Adaptation, joint measurability and path regularity are additional conditions when required.

concepts.title: Stopping time for a filtration
concepts.description: A random time T taking values in the time index together with infinity, such that {T≤t}∈F_t for every t; by time t one can determine whether T has occurred.

concepts.title: Stratonovich integral for continuous semimartingales
concepts.description: For continuous semimartingales X,Y, ∫Y∘dX=∫YdX+½[Y,X], when the Itô integral exists. Equivalently it is obtained from symmetric stochastic Riemann sums.

concepts.title: Strictly singular bounded operator
concepts.description: A bounded linear operator whose restriction to no infinite-dimensional closed subspace is an isomorphism onto its image, equivalently is bounded below on no such subspace.

concepts.title: Strong Markov process
concepts.description: A Markov process whose conditional future after any finite stopping time, given the past through that time, has the transition law started from its state at that stopping time.

concepts.title: Strongly multiplicity-free highest-weight representation
concepts.description: A finite-dimensional irreducible highest-weight representation of a complex semisimple Lie algebra or its generic Drinfeld–Jimbo quantum group, with one-dimensional weight spaces and weights totally ordered by the root order. The root order compares weights whose difference is a nonnegative integral combination of simple roots.

concepts.title: Strong well-posedness of globally Lipschitz Brownian SDEs
concepts.description: If drift b and diffusion matrix σ are globally Lipschitz on ℝⁿ, then for each deterministic initial state and Brownian motion there is a pathwise unique adapted continuous strong solution of dX=b(X)dt+σ(X)dB, with finite second moments of its supremum on bounded time intervals.

concepts.title: Strong stationary time of a Markov chain
concepts.description: A randomized stopping time T such that X_T has the stationary distribution and is independent of T.

concepts.title: Strongly continuous contraction semigroup
concepts.description: Bounded operators T_t on a Banach space satisfy T₀=I,T_{s+t}=T_sT_t,‖T_t‖≤1 and T_tx→x in norm as t↓0 for every x.

concepts.title: Strongly measurable Banach-valued function
concepts.description: A function that is an almost-everywhere pointwise norm limit of Banach-valued simple functions.

concepts.title: Strongly relatively τ-regular element
concepts.description: A relatively τ-semisimple γ for which the τ-centralizer of γγ^{-θ} in G^σ is a connected torus.

concepts.title: Subgroup
concepts.description: A subset of a group containing the identity and closed under multiplication and inverses.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Discrete-time submartingale
concepts.description: An integrable adapted process X_n with E[X_{n+1}|F_n]≥X_n almost surely for every n.

concepts.title: Submodule of a module over a commutative ring
concepts.description: An additive subgroup of a module stable under multiplication by every scalar of its coefficient ring.

concepts.title: Subobject in a category
concepts.description: An equivalence class of monomorphisms into a fixed object, where two are equivalent if an isomorphism of their domains commutes with the maps.

concepts.title: Subset
concepts.description: A⊆B means every element of A is an element of B.

concepts.title: Coloring of r-element subsets
concepts.description: An r-subset coloring is a map from the r-element subsets of X to C.

concepts.title: Subspace topology
concepts.description: For A⊆X, the topology whose open sets are A∩U for U open in X.

concepts.title: Subsymmetric Schauder basis
concepts.description: An unconditional Schauder basis equivalent to each of its subsequences.

concepts.title: Sum of vector subspaces
concepts.description: For subspaces U and W of the same vector space, U+W={u+w:u∈U,w∈W}, the smallest subspace containing both.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Sumset in an abelian group
concepts.description: For subsets A,B of an additive abelian group, A+B={a+b:a∈A,b∈B}.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Isometric identification of superharmonic Dirichlet and de Branges–Rovnyak spaces
concepts.description: Let μ be a nonzero finite positive measure on the closed unit disk, representing a superharmonic Dirichlet weight, and let b be non-extreme with associated outer a normalized by a(0)>0 and |a|²+|b|²=1 on the circle. Then Dμ=H(b) with equal norms exactly when μ=|α|²δζ and b(z)/a(z)=αz/(1−ζ̄z) for some ζ in the closed disk and α≠0.

concepts.title: Dilation inequality for superharmonic Dirichlet integrals
concepts.description: For a positive superharmonic Dirichlet weight represented by a finite positive closed-disk measure μ, f∈Dμ and fᵣ(z)=f(rz), Dμ(fᵣ)≤2r/(1+r)Dμ(f) for 0≤r<1.

concepts.title: Superharmonic function on a planar domain
concepts.description: A lower semicontinuous function u:Ω→(−∞,∞], not identically∞ on a component, is superharmonic if its value at each center is at least its circle average whenever the closed disk lies in Ω.

concepts.title: Support of a distribution
concepts.description: The complement of the largest open set on which the distribution vanishes on every smooth compactly supported test function.

concepts.title: Support function of a nonempty compact Euclidean set
concepts.description: For nonempty compact K⊂ℝⁿ, h_K(u)=max{x·u:x∈K}; this equals the support function of its convex hull.

concepts.title: Support function of a convex body
concepts.description: For a convex body K⊂ℝᵈ, h_K(u)=max{x·u:x∈K}; it may be restricted to the unit sphere or extended positively homogeneously to ℝᵈ.

concepts.title: Support of a function
concepts.description: The closure in its domain of the set on which a function is nonzero.

concepts.title: Surface area measure of a convex body
concepts.description: The measure S_K on the unit sphere assigning a Borel set of directions the boundary area of points of K whose outer unit normal lies in that set; points with nonunique normals form a boundary-area null set.

concepts.title: Surface gradient on an embedded surface
concepts.description: For a smooth real f on a surface M⊂ℝ³, ∇Mf is the tangent vector field satisfying ⟨∇Mf,v⟩=df(v) for tangent vectors v; equivalently it is the tangential projection of an ambient smooth extension’s gradient.

concepts.title: Convergence of Tikhonov regularization under surface perturbation
concepts.description: For a bounded linear tangent-field inverse operator and its bounded linear ambient approximations on uniformly regular parametrized surfaces with C² surface error γ→0, transported operator error ρ→0 and data error δ→0, minimize squared data discrepancy plus normal-component penalty plus α times the squared first-order surface seminorm. Under weakly lower semicontinuous convex penalties with weakly sequentially compact level sets and existence of a seminorm-minimizing exact tangent solution, α→0 and (ρ²+γ²+δ²)/α→0 imply that weak cluster points of the pulled-back minimizers are seminorm-minimizing solutions.

concepts.title: Symmetric Dirichlet form
concepts.description: A closed densely defined nonnegative symmetric form E on real L²(X,m) satisfying the Markov contraction property: for u∈D(E), v=(0∨u)∧1 belongs to D(E) and E(v,v)≤E(u,u).

concepts.title: Origin-symmetric generalized zonoid
concepts.description: An origin-symmetric convex body K that is a Minkowski difference of origin-symmetric zonoids: there are such zonoids L,M with K+M=L, equivalently h_K=h_L−h_M.

concepts.title: Symmetric group of a finite set
concepts.description: The group of all bijections of a finite set to itself under composition.

concepts.title: Symmetric Markov semigroup
concepts.description: A Markov transition semigroup is symmetric with respect to m if ∫fP_tg dm=∫gP_tf dm for suitable f,g. Its stationary process has time-reversal invariant finite-dimensional distributions when initialized from a probability measure m.

concepts.title: Symmetric matrix
concepts.description: A square matrix A equal to its transpose, so aᵢⱼ=aⱼᵢ.

concepts.title: Symmetric measurable function on a finite product space
concepts.description: A measurable function f(x₁,…,x_N) unchanged by every permutation of its N arguments.

concepts.title: Symmetric square of a module
concepts.description: For a module M over a commutative ring R, Sym²_R(M) is (M⊗_R M) modulo the relations x⊗y−y⊗x. In small characteristic this differs from the submodule of M⊗M generated by x⊗x; the paper explicitly uses the latter convention in its integral Witt targets.

concepts.title: Symplectic group over a commutative ring
concepts.description: Sp₂g(R) is the group of invertible 2g×2g matrices M over R satisfying MᵀJM=J for J=[[0,I],[-I,0]].

concepts.title: Syndeticity of infinitely recurring prime differences
concepts.description: The set D of positive integers occurring infinitely often as differences p−q of primes is syndetic. In particular the set of all positive prime differences is syndetic.

concepts.title: Syndetic subset of the positive integers
concepts.description: A set S⊆ℕ₊ is syndetic if some finite bound L makes every interval {a,…,a+L} meet S.

concepts.title: Szemerédi’s theorem
concepts.description: Every subset of the positive integers having positive upper asymptotic density contains arbitrarily long finite arithmetic progressions.

concepts.title: T-matrix of a ribbon fusion category
concepts.description: For a ribbon fusion category over ℂ, the T-matrix is diagonal, with entry at a simple object X equal to the scalar of its ribbon twist θ_X. No additional anomaly scalar is included.

concepts.title: Tamagawa measure of a reductive group over a number field
concepts.description: For a connected reductive number-field group G of dimension d, choose an invariant F-rational gauge form and its standard local measures m_v. Let ρ_G be the Galois representation on X*(G)⊗C and r_G the leading nonzero Laurent coefficient of its finite-place Artin L-function at s=1. The Tamagawa measure is r_G⁻¹|d_F|^(−d/2)(∏_(v infinite)m_v)(∏_(v finite)L_v(1,ρ_G)m_v). It is independent of rescaling that gauge form by F×.

concepts.title: Tangent space of an embedded surface
concepts.description: At x on a smooth embedded surface M, TₓM is the two-dimensional vector subspace of velocities γ′(0) of smooth surface curves with γ(0)=x.

concepts.title: Tangent vector field on an embedded surface
concepts.description: A map v:M→ℝ³ with v(x)∈TₓM at each x; smoothness or Sobolev regularity is an additional stated condition.

concepts.title: Taylor’s theorem with integral remainder
concepts.description: If f is C^{n+1} on the interval joining a and x, then f(x)=∑_{k=0}ⁿf⁽ᵏ⁾(a)(x−a)ᵏ/k!+∫_a^xf⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾(s)(x−s)ⁿ/n! ds.

concepts.title: Taylor’s theorem with Lagrange remainder
concepts.description: If f has n continuous derivatives on an interval and an (n+1)st derivative between a and x, then f(x)=∑_{j=0}ⁿf⁽ʲ⁾(a)(x−a)ʲ/j!+f⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾(ξ)(x−a)ⁿ⁺¹/(n+1)! for some ξ between a and x.

concepts.title: Tempered distribution
concepts.description: A continuous linear functional on the Schwartz space S(ℝⁿ).

concepts.title: Temperley–Lieb algebra
concepts.description: TL_n(δ) is spanned by planar noncrossing pairings of n top and n bottom points. Multiply by stacking and replace every closed loop by δ; equivalently its generators satisfy eᵢ²=δeᵢ, eᵢeᵢ₊₁eᵢ=eᵢ and eᵢeⱼ=eⱼeᵢ for abs(i−j)>1.

concepts.title: Tensor category over a field
concepts.description: A k-linear abelian rigid monoidal category with a k-bilinear tensor product and End(1)=k, finite-dimensional morphism spaces, and finite length for every object. Semisimplicity and finitely many simple isomorphism classes are not required.

concepts.title: Tensor ideal of morphisms in a linear monoidal category
concepts.description: A family of linear subspaces of morphism spaces closed under composition on either side and tensoring with arbitrary morphisms.

concepts.title: Tensor power of a Hopf-algebra representation
concepts.description: The representation on V⊗n obtained by applying the iterated coproduct before acting on its n factors.

concepts.title: Tensor product of commutative algebras
concepts.description: For commutative R-algebras A,B, the module A⊗_R B with multiplication (a⊗b)(a′⊗b′)=aa′⊗bb′ and unit 1⊗1; it is the coproduct of A and B among commutative R-algebras.

concepts.title: Tensor product of modules over a commutative ring
concepts.description: For R-modules M,N, the R-module M⊗_R N with a bilinear map (m,n)↦m⊗n through which every R-bilinear map M×N→P factors uniquely by an R-linear map.

concepts.title: Tensor product of vector spaces
concepts.description: The vector space V⊗W with its universal bilinear map from V×W.

concepts.title: Test-function topology on C_c^∞ of an open Euclidean set
concepts.description: The finest locally convex topology making every inclusion D_K→C_c^∞(Ω) continuous, where D_K consists of smooth functions supported in a fixed compact K⊂Ω and has the seminorms max_{|α|≤m}sup|∂^αφ|.

concepts.title: Thick subset of the positive integers
concepts.description: A subset of ℕ₊ is thick if it contains intervals of arbitrarily large finite length.

concepts.title: Tietze extension theorem
concepts.description: Every continuous real-valued function on a closed subset of a normal topological space extends continuously to the whole space; if the function takes values in [−1,1], the extension can have the same range.

concepts.title: Tight-by-support Schauder basis
concepts.description: A Schauder basis is tight by support if no two infinite-dimensional closed subspaces with disjoint coordinate supports are isomorphic as Banach spaces.

concepts.title: Tight family of probability measures
concepts.description: A family of probability measures on a topological space is tight if for every ε>0 some compact K has μ(K)≥1−ε for every member μ of the family.

concepts.title: Subsequential diagonal decomposition in tight-by-support spaces
concepts.description: If X has a tight-by-support unconditional basis and T:[xₙ]→X is bounded for a weakly null sequence (xₙ), then some subsequence (xₙ)_{n∈M} satisfies T|[xₙ:n∈M]=D|[xₙ:n∈M]+S, with D a bounded diagonal operator on X and S strictly singular.

concepts.title: Variational Tikhonov regularization
concepts.description: For an operator equation Fx=y, approximate noisy data yδ by minimizing ∥Fx−yδ∥²+αR(x), where α>0 and R is a chosen penalty functional.

concepts.title: Tilting module for a quantum group
concepts.description: A finite-dimensional module admitting both a filtration by Weyl modules and a filtration by dual Weyl modules.

concepts.title: Toeplitz–Hausdorff theorem
concepts.description: The numerical range of every bounded operator on a complex Hilbert space is convex.

concepts.title: Toeplitz operator on H² of the unit disk
concepts.description: For ψ∈L∞ of the unit circle, Tψf=P₊(ψf), where P₊ is orthogonal projection from boundary L² onto H².

concepts.title: Tonelli’s theorem for nonnegative functions
concepts.description: For a nonnegative measurable function on the product of σ-finite measure spaces, the product integral equals either iterated integral, allowing∞.

concepts.title: Topological field
concepts.description: A field with a topology making addition, multiplication, additive inversion and inversion on the nonzero elements continuous.

concepts.title: Topological group
concepts.description: A group with a topology for which multiplication G×G→G and inversion G→G are continuous.

concepts.title: Topological ring
concepts.description: A ring with a topology for which addition, multiplication and additive inversion are continuous; the rings here are commutative with identity.

concepts.title: Topological space
concepts.description: A set X with a family τ of subsets, called open sets, containing ∅ and X and closed under arbitrary unions and finite intersections.

concepts.title: Topological vector space over ℝ or ℂ
concepts.description: A real or complex vector space with a topology for which vector addition and scalar multiplication are continuous.

concepts.title: Torsion-free abelian group
concepts.description: An abelian group in which ng=0 with a nonzero integer n forces g=0.

concepts.title: Torsion point of a complex torus
concepts.description: A point of a complex torus V/Λ killed by multiplication by a positive integer; an N-torsion point is represented by a vector in (1/N)Λ.

concepts.title: Totally bounded metric space
concepts.description: A metric space is totally bounded if for every ε>0 it is covered by finitely many open balls of radius ε.

concepts.title: Total order
concepts.description: A partial order in which any two elements are comparable.

concepts.title: Total variation distance between finite probability distributions
concepts.description: For probability mass functions p,q on the same finite set, d_TV(p,q)=½∑_ω|p(ω)−q(ω)|=sup_A|p(A)−q(A)|.

concepts.title: Total variation distance between probability measures
concepts.description: For probability measures μ,ν on the same measurable space, d_TV(μ,ν)=sup_{A measurable}|μ(A)−ν(A)|. This convention takes values in[0,1]; the total variation norm of μ−ν is twice this distance.

concepts.title: Trace-class operator on a Hilbert space
concepts.description: A bounded operator T for which |T|=(T*T)¹ᐟ² is a positive trace-class operator, equivalently its singular values are summable.

concepts.title: Positive trace-class operator on a Hilbert space
concepts.description: A nonnegative bounded self-adjoint operator Q is trace class if ∑_k⟨Qe_k,e_k⟩<∞ for an orthonormal basis; the sum is independent of the basis and equals its trace.

concepts.title: Trace on a partially ordered abelian group
concepts.description: A nonzero additive homomorphism τ:G→ℝ sending positive elements to nonnegative reals; it is normalized at an order unit u when τ(u)=1.

concepts.title: Tracial L²-space of a finite von Neumann algebra
concepts.description: The Hilbert completion of M for the inner product ⟨x,y⟩=τ(y*x), with the natural left and right multiplication actions.

concepts.title: Stochastic transition matrix
concepts.description: A square real matrix P with nonnegative entries and row sums one; P(x,y) is the one-step transition probability from x to y.

concepts.title: Twin-prime conjecture
concepts.description: There are infinitely many primes p for which p+2 is prime.

concepts.title: Twist in a braided monoidal category
concepts.description: A natural automorphism θ of the identity with θ₁=id and θ_{X⊗Y}=c_{Y,X}c_{X,Y}(θ_X⊗θ_Y).

concepts.title: Twisted relative orbital integral
concepts.description: For a relevant element γ and a unitary character μ of G^σ×G^θ trivial on its connected stabilizer,the twisted relative orbital integral integrates μ(x,y^{-1})f(x^{-1}γy) over (G_γ^{σθ})°∖(G^σ×G^θ),with compatible quotient Haar measures.

concepts.title: Twisted relative spectral trace
concepts.description: For a cuspidal representation π,the integral of its convolution-kernel K_{π(f)}(x,y) against μ(x,y^{-1}) over the normalized G^σ and G^θ automorphic quotients. For a K-finite test function it is the sum of products of the corresponding period integrals over an orthonormal basis.

concepts.title: U-statistic with symmetric kernel
concepts.description: For independent identically distributed observations X₁,…,X_N and a symmetric kernel u of m variables, the U-statistic is binom(N,m)⁻¹∑_{i₁<⋯<i_m}u(X_{i₁},…,X_{i_m}).

concepts.title: Transport bound for a finite UFG bracket family
concepts.description: For bounded smooth UFG fields with generating brackets V_α and flow Jacobian J_t, each V_α(x) can be expressed as∑_βb_{βα}(t,x)J_t(x)^{-1}V_β(X_t^x). The finitely many coefficients b_{βα} have moments of every order bounded uniformly over x and bounded time intervals.

concepts.title: Preservation of full Hörmander rank for UFG diffusions
concepts.description: For bounded smooth UFG fields with finite bracket-generation level ℓ, let h(x) be the determinant of the Gram matrix formed from brackets of weighted length≤ℓ, excluding the drift alone. The solution started in E={h>0} remains in E at every fixed time almost surely. For p>1 and0≤t≤T, E[h(X_t^x)^{-p}]≤C_{p,T}h(x)^{-p}.

concepts.title: Malliavin integration by parts along UFG bracket directions
concepts.description: For bounded smooth UFG Stratonovich fields, a generated bracket V_α of weighted length |α|, and random weight Φ with uniformly bounded D¹,ᵖ norms for every p>1, there are weights H_α(Φ;t,x) with uniformly bounded Lᵖ norms on0<t≤T such that E[Φ(V_αf)(X_t^x)]=t^{−|α|/2}E[H_α(Φ;t,x)f(X_t^x)] for bounded smooth f. Constants depend on the fields, bracket and weight norms.

concepts.title: First and second noise-direction estimates for UFG diffusion semigroups
concepts.description: For bounded smooth UFG fields, P_tf(x)=Ef(X_t^x) and every noise field V_j,j≥1, there is C_T such that ‖V_jP_tf‖∞≤C_T‖∇f‖∞ and ‖V_j²P_tf‖∞≤C_Tt^{-1/2}‖∇f‖∞ for0<t≤T and smooth f with bounded first derivative.

concepts.title: Gaussian upper bound for full-rank UFG transition densities
concepts.description: For bounded smooth UFG fields on ℝᴺ generated through weighted length ℓ, write h for their finite-bracket Gram determinant and E={h>0}. For0<t≤T and x,y∈E, the smooth transition density satisfies p_t(x,y)≤Ct^{−(N+1)ℓ/2}h(x)^{−2(N+1)ℓ}exp(−c|x−y|²/t). The same estimate holds with h(y) replacing h(x); C,c>0 may depend on the fields and T.

concepts.title: Uniformly finitely generated condition for diffusion vector fields
concepts.description: For bounded smooth diffusion fields V₀,…,V_d, the C_b^∞ module generated by all iterated brackets except the drift field alone is generated by brackets of uniformly bounded weighted length (a drift letter has weight two, a noise letter weight one). Each longer bracket is a linear combination of these finitely many fields with bounded smooth coefficient functions.

concepts.title: Tightness of a probability measure on a Polish space
concepts.description: Every Borel probability measure on a Polish space is tight: for every ε>0 some compact set has probability at least1−ε.

concepts.title: Densely defined self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space
concepts.description: A linear operator A with dense domain D(A) in a Hilbert space such that its Hilbert-space adjoint A* has the same domain and agrees with A. The adjoint domain consists of y for which x↦⟨Ax,y⟩ is bounded on D(A) in the ambient Hilbert norm.

concepts.title: Uncappable element of a planar algebra
concepts.description: A box killed by every operation that caps two adjacent boundary points.

concepts.title: Unconditional Schauder basis
concepts.description: A Schauder basis for which each vector’s expansion converges unconditionally, equivalently converges to the same vector after every permutation of its terms.

concepts.title: Undirected multigraph
concepts.description: A vertex set and an edge set, with two unordered endpoints assigned to each edge; distinct edges can have the same endpoints and loops are allowed.

concepts.title: Uniform convergence of functions into a metric space
concepts.description: A sequence fₙ:X→(Y,d) converges uniformly to f if for every ε>0, d(fₙ(x),f(x))<ε for every x∈X once n is sufficiently large independently of x.

concepts.title: Uniform distribution on the unit interval
concepts.description: The real probability law on [0,1] whose probability of an interval [a,b]⊆[0,1] is b−a.

concepts.title: Uniform subfield stabilizer theorem for subspace products
concepts.description: Let L/F be any field extension and S⊆L a nonzero finite-dimensional F-subspace. Either dim_F(ST)≥dim_F S+dim_F T−1 for every nonzero finite-dimensional F-subspace T, or there is a subfield F⊊K⊆L, depending only on S, such that STK=ST for every T violating this bound. No separability assumption is required.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Uniformly continuous map between metric spaces
concepts.description: A map f:X→Y between metric spaces such that for every ε>0 some δ>0 satisfies d_Y(f(x),f(y))<ε whenever d_X(x,y)<δ. The same δ works at every point.

concepts.title: Uniformly elliptic symmetric divergence-form operator
concepts.description: A second-order operator Lf=∑_{i,j}∂_i(a^{ij}(x)∂_jf) with symmetric coefficients for which c|ξ|²≤∑a^{ij}(x)ξ_iξ_j≤C|ξ|² uniformly in x, for fixed0<c≤C<∞; coefficients and boundary conditions determine its realization.

concepts.title: Unilateral credit valuation adjustment
concepts.description: In a model where the valuing institution cannot default, CVA is the expected discounted loss on positive counterparty exposure at counterparty default: E[D(0,τ)L_τ(V_τ)⁺1_{τ<T}], under a specified pricing measure. Here V is the default-free portfolio value and L is the fractional loss at default.

concepts.title: Unimodular locally compact group
concepts.description: A locally compact group whose left Haar measures are also right invariant.

concepts.title: Union of a family of sets
concepts.description: The set of elements belonging to at least one member of the family.

concepts.title: Unipotent affine algebraic group
concepts.description: An affine algebraic group that, after extension to an algebraic closure, has a faithful algebraic representation with all matrices upper triangular and every diagonal entry 1.

concepts.title: Unipotent radical of an algebraic group
concepts.description: The largest smooth connected normal unipotent subgroup of an algebraic group.

concepts.title: Unit normal field on an embedded surface
concepts.description: A smooth map n:M→S² perpendicular to T_xM at every x. A global choice fixes an orientation; such a choice is an additional assumption when it does not exist globally.

concepts.title: Unitary character of a topological group
concepts.description: A continuous homomorphism from a topological group to the unit circle inℂ under multiplication.

concepts.title: Unitary operator on a complex Hilbert space
concepts.description: A surjective complex linear map preserving the inner product.

concepts.title: Unitary representation of a topological group
concepts.description: A group homomorphism π from a topological group to the unitary operators of a complex Hilbert space, strongly continuous in the sense that g↦π(g)v is norm-continuous for each vector v.

concepts.title: Unitization of a complex Banach algebra
concepts.description: For a nonunital complex Banach algebra A, its unitization is A⊕ℂ with multiplication (a,λ)(b,μ)=(ab+λb+μa,λμ), identity (0,1), and norm ∥a∥+|λ|.

concepts.title: Universal enveloping algebra of a Lie algebra
concepts.description: The unital associative algebra U(g) with a linear map i:g→U(g) satisfying i([x,y])=i(x)i(y)−i(y)i(x), universal for such maps from g into associative algebras. Its universal property does not include an unproved assertion of injectivity.

concepts.title: Universal R-matrix
concepts.description: An invertible element R in a suitable completion of H⊗H that conjugates the coproduct to its opposite and satisfies the two coproduct compatibility identities; on modules, flip∘R gives a braiding.

concepts.title: Unperforated partially ordered abelian group
concepts.description: An ordered abelian group in which ng≥0 for a positive integer n implies g≥0.

concepts.title: Finite unramified extension of a nonarchimedean local field
concepts.description: A finite extension of a complete discretely valued field whose ramification index is one and whose residue-field extension is separable.

concepts.title: Up-and-in barrier option
concepts.description: A contingent claim activated only if the asset price reaches a specified upper barrier during the monitoring period; discrete and continuous monitoring are distinct contracts. A digital version pays a fixed amount upon activation.

concepts.title: Upper semicontinuous function
concepts.description: An extended-real-valued function f on a topological space is upper semicontinuous if {x:f(x)<a} is open for every real a.

concepts.title: Vague convergence of Radon measures
concepts.description: On a locally compact Hausdorff space, μ_n converge vaguely to μ if ∫f dμ_n→∫f dμ for every continuous compactly supported real function f.

concepts.title: Valuation ring of a discretely valued field
concepts.description: For a discrete valuation v on K, the ring O_v={x:v(x)≥0}; its maximal ideal is m_v={x:v(x)>0}.

concepts.title: Vandermonde determinant formula
concepts.description: The determinant of (xᵢ^{j−1})_{1≤i,j≤n} equals ∏_{i<j}(xⱼ−xᵢ).

concepts.title: Vector-valued convolution inequality in variable Lebesgue spaces
concepts.description: If p,q are globally log-Hölder with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and 1<q⁻≤q⁺<∞, then for m>n the kernels ηⱼ,m(x)=2ʲⁿ(1+2ʲ|x|)⁻ᵐ satisfy ∥(ηⱼ,m*fⱼ)ⱼ∥_{L^{p(·)}(ℓ^{q(·)})}≤C∥(fⱼ)ⱼ∥_{L^{p(·)}(ℓ^{q(·)})}.

concepts.title: Jensen estimate for variable-exponent local averages
concepts.description: For globally log-Hölder p with 1≤p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and k≥0, some β∈(0,1) gives (β avg_B|f|)^{p(x)}≤avg_B|f(y)|^{p(y)}+min(|B|^k,1)[(e+|x|)^{-k}+avg_B(e+|y|)^{-k}] for x∈B and ∥f∥_{p(·)}≤1. Here B is any ball; constants depend on the fixed exponent and k.

concepts.title: Modular of a variable-exponent Lebesgue space
concepts.description: For an exponent p(x)∈(0,∞), the modular is ρ_p(f)=∫|f(x)|^{p(x)}dx. The Luxemburg quasi-norm tests whether this modular becomes at most one after scaling f.

concepts.title: Variable-exponent Lebesgue space
concepts.description: For measurable p:ℝⁿ→(0,∞) with 0<ess inf p≤ess sup p<∞, L^{p(·)} consists of measurable functions of finite Luxemburg quasi-norm inf{λ>0:∫|f(x)/λ|^{p(x)}dx≤1}, modulo equality almost everywhere.

concepts.title: Triebel–Lizorkin-type space with variable exponents and cube weight
concepts.description: For bounded positive exponents p,q with globally log-Hölder reciprocals, bounded locally log-Hölder smoothness s, and a positive doubling/locally comparable cube weight φ, F^{s(·),φ}_{p(·),q(·)} consists of tempered distributions with finite sup_P φ(P)⁻¹∥(∑_{j≥max(0,−log₂ℓ(P))}(2^{js(·)}|ϕⱼ*f|)^{q(·)})^{1/q(·)}∥_{L^{p(·)}(P)}. Here P ranges over dyadic cubes and the admissible Schwartz family includes a low-frequency term at j=0.

concepts.title: Variance of a real random variable
concepts.description: If EX²<∞, then Var(X)=E[(X−EX)²].

concepts.title: Vector space
concepts.description: An abelian group with scalar multiplication by a field satisfying a(v+w)=av+aw, (a+b)v=av+bv, (ab)v=a(bv), and 1v=v.

concepts.title: Basis of a vector space
concepts.description: A linearly independent family of vectors whose linear span is the whole vector space.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Dimension of a vector space
concepts.description: The cardinality of a basis of the vector space; a finite basis with n vectors gives dimension n.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Dimension formula for sums of subspaces
concepts.description: For finite-dimensional subspaces U,W, dim(U+W)+dim(U∩W)=dim(U)+dim(W).
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Vector subspace
concepts.description: A subset of a vector space containing zero and closed under addition and scalar multiplication.
concepts.field: Linear algebra and additive number theory

concepts.title: Vector-valued maximal inequality with variable Lᵖ exponent and fixed sequence exponent
concepts.description: If p is globally log-Hölder with 1<p⁻≤p⁺<∞ and 1<q<∞ is constant, then ∥(∑_j|Mf_j|^q)^{1/q}∥_{p(·)}≤C∥(∑_j|f_j|^q)^{1/q}∥_{p(·)}.

concepts.title: Vector-valued Siegel modular form of finite-quotient type
concepts.description: A holomorphic map F:ℍ_g→V transforming by det(CZ+D)^kρ(M), where ρ is a representation of the integral symplectic group with finite-index kernel; its Fourier expansion satisfies the usual holomorphy condition.

concepts.title: Vitali covering lemma for balls
