concepts.description: From a family of Euclidean balls with bounded radii one can choose pairwise disjoint balls whose fivefold concentric dilations cover the union of the original family.

concepts.title: Vitali–Porter convergence theorem for holomorphic functions
concepts.description: A locally uniformly bounded sequence of holomorphic functions on a connected domain that converges pointwise on a set with an interior accumulation point converges uniformly on compact subsets to a holomorphic function.

concepts.title: von Mangoldt function
concepts.description: The arithmetic function Λ(n)=log p if n=p^k for a prime p and integer k≥1, and Λ(n)=0 otherwise.

concepts.title: Waring number g(k)
concepts.description: For k≥1, g(k) is the least s such that every nonnegative integer is a sum of s nonnegative integer k-th powers, allowing zero summands.

concepts.title: Weak continuity of surface area measure
concepts.description: If full-dimensional convex bodies K_j converge in Hausdorff distance to K, their surface area measures satisfy ∫f dS_{K_j}→∫f dS_K for every continuous function f on the unit sphere.

concepts.title: Weak convergence in a Banach space
concepts.description: A sequence xₙ converges weakly to x if ℓ(xₙ)→ℓ(x) for every bounded linear functional ℓ on the space.

concepts.title: Weak convergence of probability measures on a metric space
concepts.description: Measures μ_n converge weakly to μ if ∫f dμ_n→∫f dμ for every bounded continuous real function f on the space.

concepts.title: Weak Dirichlet Laplacian from H₀¹ to H⁻¹
concepts.description: The operator −Δ:H₀¹→H⁻¹ defined by ⟨−Δu,v⟩=∫∇u·∇v. On a bounded domain it is an isomorphism when H₀¹ carries its gradient norm; its inverse solves the weak zero-boundary Poisson equation.

concepts.title: Weak Jacobi form
concepts.description: An integer-weight, nonnegative integer-index scalar Jacobi form with the usual modular and elliptic transformation laws, whose Fourier expansion at every cusp has n≥0 but may have negative discriminant 4mn−ℓ². This weakens the Fourier-support condition of a holomorphic Jacobi form.

concepts.title: Weak Lᵖ space
concepts.description: For 0<p<∞ on a measure space, weak Lᵖ consists of measurable f with sup_{λ>0}λ μ({|f|>λ})^{1/p}<∞, modulo almost-everywhere equality.

concepts.title: Convergence of one-point laws for a random dynamical system
concepts.description: A random dynamical system has limiting one-point law μ from every initial state if Law(φ_t(·,x)) converges weakly to μ as t→∞ for every x. This is the paper’s “strongly mixing RDS” condition, distinct from mixing of the noise flow.

concepts.title: Weak partial derivative of a locally integrable function
concepts.description: A locally integrable v is the ith weak derivative of u on an open Ω⊆ℝⁿ if ∫Ω u ∂ᵢφ=−∫Ω vφ for every smooth compactly supported test function φ.

concepts.title: Weak point attractor for a random dynamical system
concepts.description: An invariant random compact set A such that for every fixed x, d(φ_t(θ_{−t}ω,x),A(ω))→0 in probability. Attraction of every deterministic compact set uniformly is a stronger condition.

concepts.title: Weak sequential compactness in a Banach space
concepts.description: A subset is weakly sequentially compact if every sequence in it has a weakly convergent subsequence whose limit belongs to that same subset.

concepts.title: Weak synchronization by noise
concepts.description: Existence of a weak point attractor consisting almost surely of one random point. Its invariance is φ_t(ω,a(ω))=a(θ_tω), and every deterministic initial state converges to it in pullback probability.

concepts.title: Weak time derivative of a Banach-valued function
concepts.description: An integrable X-valued v is the weak derivative of u on an interval if∫u(t)φ′(t)dt=−∫v(t)φ(t)dt as Bochner integrals for every compactly supported smooth scalar test function φ.

concepts.title: Weakly sequentially lower semicontinuous functional
concepts.description: An extended-real functional R satisfies R(x)≤liminfₙR(xₙ) whenever xₙ converges weakly to x.

concepts.title: Weierstrass theorem on locally uniform holomorphic limits
concepts.description: A locally uniform limit of holomorphic functions is holomorphic, and every order of derivative converges locally uniformly to the corresponding derivative of the limit.

concepts.title: Weighted holomorphic Dirichlet space
concepts.description: For a nonnegative integrable weight ω on the unit disk, Dω consists of holomorphic f with Dω(f)=∫D|f′(z)|²ω(z)dA(z)<∞. When Dω⊆H², its Hilbert norm is ∥f∥²H²+Dω(f), with normalized area measure dA.

concepts.title: Concavity of the weighted geometric mean
concepts.description: For β_i≥0 with ∑_iβ_i=1, the function (x_i)↦∏_ix_i^{β_i} is concave on the nonnegative orthant, with zero-weight factors omitted.

concepts.title: Weyl’s lemma for harmonic distributions
concepts.description: A distribution annihilated by the Euclidean Laplacian is represented by a smooth harmonic function.

concepts.title: White-noise random dynamical system
concepts.description: A filtered random dynamical system whose noise σ-algebras generated by cocycle increments on disjoint time intervals are independent, and transform with the time shifts of the base flow.

concepts.title: Wiener measure
concepts.description: The probability law of standard Brownian motion on continuous paths starting at zero, equipped with the Borel σ-algebra for uniform convergence on compact time intervals.

concepts.title: With high probability in an asymptotic random model
concepts.description: An event A_n holds with high probability if P(A_n)→1 as n→∞. Also called asymptotically almost surely; this does not itself assert almost-sure eventual occurrence on a common probability space.

concepts.title: Kernel of the genus-two Witt operator modulo p≥5
concepts.description: For an even integer k≥0 and prime p≥5, the kernel of the reduced Witt restriction on full-group genus-two forms over Z_(p) is X₁₀ times the reduced weight-(k−10) space.

concepts.title: Witt operators for genus-two Siegel modular forms
concepts.description: The restriction of a genus-two modular form to block-diagonal matrices and its first two normalized transverse Taylor coefficients: f([[τ₁,z],[z,τ₂]])=W(f)+2W′(f)(2πiz)+W″(f)(2πiz)²+O(z³). Their targets are tensor products of elliptic modular or quasimodular form spaces, with parity determined by the weight.

concepts.title: Young’s inequality for products
concepts.description: For a,b≥0 and p,q>1 with 1/p+1/q=1, ab≤aᵖ/p+bᑫ/q.

concepts.title: Population law of the binary Yule process
concepts.description: For one initial particle splitting into two at rateβ per particle without death, P(N_t=n)=e^{−βt}(1−e^{−βt})^{n−1} for n≥1. All integer moments are finite at every finite time.

concepts.title: Zagier's involution
concepts.description: For a prime p≡1 (mod 4), let Sₚ={(x,y,z)∈ℤ₊³:x²+4yz=p}. Send (x,y,z) to (x+2z,z,y−x−z) if x<y−z, to (2y−x,y,x−y+z) if y−z<x<2y, and to (x−2y,x−y+z,y) if x>2y. These cases exhaust Sₚ and define an involution with the unique fixed point (1,1,(p−1)/4).

concepts.title: Zero object in a category
concepts.description: An object 0 of a category such that for every object X there is exactly one morphism 0→X and exactly one morphism X→0.

concepts.title: Polymath’s smooth-modulus distribution theorem for primes
concepts.description: Put θ=1/2+7/300. Given ε>0 there is δ>0 such that, for every fixed A≥1 and any choice of a nonzero residue a_p modulo each prime p, ∑_{q≤x^(θ−ε), q squarefree and x^δ-smooth}|ψ(x;q,a_q)−x/φ(q)|≪_{A,ε,δ}x/(log x)^A, uniformly in those choices. Here a_q is the coherent Chinese-remainder residue of the a_p for p dividing q, and ψ is the von Mangoldt prime count.

concepts.title: Zonoid
concepts.description: A compact convex set that is a Hausdorff limit of finite Minkowski sums of line segments.

concepts.title: Zorn’s lemma
concepts.description: If every chain in a partially ordered set has an upper bound in that set, then the set has a maximal element.

existing_formalizations.title: Absolute Galois group

The exact database carrier Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) is directly expressible using Mathlib SeparableClosure, generic Gal and krullTopology; Galois/Profinite supplies its profinite structure. There is no assumption that K is perfect. existing_formalizations.title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for complex inner-product spaces
existing_formalizations.evidence: Inspected Mathlib at 26573066084e6e2aa8526ea358bc43b66d96f970. InnerProductSpace/Defs.lean:355–374 contains the completed discriminant proof; Basic.lean:280–282 exposes it for RCLike inner-product spaces, including complex spaces, without finite-dimensionality or completeness assumptions. Its real-valued bound ||inner x y||*||inner y x|| ≤ Re(inner x x)*Re(inner y y) is exactly the catalogue square-modulus inequality by norm_inner_symm (Basic:226) and real nonnegative diagonal identities (Basic:202–221).
